title.en: World Desk
title.zh: 全球焦点

strap.en: A fast view of global affairs, conflict, diplomacy, and human need.
strap.zh: 快速掌握国际局势、冲突、外交与人类处境。

title.en: Instagram boss says users will be ‘overwhelmed’ with brand content in algorithm-free world
title.zh: Instagram 负责人表示，在没有算法的世界里，用户将“不知所措”

summary.en: Instagram's chief executive, Adam Mosseri, has stated that a world without algorithms would lead to a worse user experience, with more brand content and less time spent on the app. This comes as the Australian government plans to introduce legislation requiring social media platforms to offer users a choice between...
summary.zh: Instagram 首席执行官 Adam Mosseri 表示，没有算法的世界将导致用户体验变差，看到更多品牌内容，并在应用上花费更少时间。此前，澳大利亚政府计划出台立法，要求社交媒体平台允许用户选择算法推荐或按时间顺序排列的动态信息。

body.en: Adam Mosseri says platform’s algorithm ‘feels like a black box’ but company trying to give users more control after Labor announces opt-out plan Instagram’s chief executive has said users will have a worse experience in an algorithm-free world, seeing more brand-related content, and spend less time on the app. The comments come as the Australian government plans to give users the option to opt out of algorithms , with the prime minister, Anthony Albanese, announcing plans on Tuesday to require social media platforms to prompt users to choose between a feed of algorithm-recommended content or a reverse chronological feed of the pages users follow. Labor also plans to introduce a range of measures designed to address online harm on the sites. Continue reading...
body.zh: Adam Mosseri 表示，平台的算法“感觉就像一个黑匣子”，但在工党宣布退出计划后，该公司试图给用户更多的控制权。Instagram 首席执行官表示，用户在没有算法的世界中将获得更糟糕的体验，看到更多与品牌相关的内容，并在应用上花费更少的时间。澳大利亚政府计划向用户提供退出算法的选项，澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞 (Anthony Albanese) 周二宣布，计划要求社交媒体平台提示用户在算法推荐的内容提要或用户关注的页面的反向时间提要之间进行选择。工党还计划推出一系列措施，旨在解决网站上的网络伤害问题。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In an age of information overload, the question of how we curate our digital consumption is paramount. Adam Mosseri's comments highlight the tension between algorithmic engagement and user control. Philippians 4:8 calls us to focus our minds on what is true, noble, right, pure, lovely, admirable, excellent, and praiseworthy. As we navigate social media, may...
reflection.zh: 在信息爆炸的时代，我们如何管理自己的数字消费至关重要。Adam Mosseri 的评论凸显了算法参与和用户控制之间的紧张关系。《腓立比书》4:8 呼吁我们将心思意念专注于真实、可敬、公义、清洁、可爱、有美名的事。当我们使用社交媒体时，愿我们有意识地寻求能振奋人心的内容，而不是让自己被嘈杂的信息所淹没。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: Trump implores voters to ‘pretend that I’m on the ballot’ as he tries to boost vulnerable Republicans ahead of midterms – live
title.zh: 特朗普在共和党全国代表大会上成为焦点，为中期选举冒险

summary.en: President Trump is set to deliver speeches on both days of an unprecedented gathering, which Republicans are framing as a 'midterm convention' to counteract his unpopularity. Meanwhile, Stefany Shaheen, daughter of a New Hampshire senator, has won the Democratic nomination for a House seat, facing accusations of...
summary.zh: 总统特朗普将在前所未有的集会的两天内都发表讲话，共和党人将其定位为“中期选举大会”，以对抗他的不受欢迎度。与此同时，新罕布什尔州参议员的女儿斯蒂芬妮·沙欣赢得了众议院席位的民主党提名，但面临初选对手关于裙带关系的指控。

body.en: Trump addresses crowd in first of two planned speeches during Republican midterm convention Republicans look to ‘midterm convention’ to overcome Trump unpopularity Sign up for US Breaking News email Stefany Shaheen, the daughter of a longtime New Hampshire senator and former governor, has won the Democratic nomination in the race for Chris Pappas’s former House seat. Stefany Shaheen’s mother Jeanne Shaheen is a former governor who has represented New Hampshire in the Senate since 2009. The younger Shaheen’s family ties to the Democratic establishment – and accusations of nepotism – became a point of attack by her opponent in the primary race. Continue reading...
body.zh: 总统将在这两天史无前例的聚会上发表演讲，共和党人希望通过“中期大会”来克服特朗普不受欢迎的情况。新罕布什尔州长期参议员和前州长的女儿史蒂芬妮·沙欣(Stefany Shaheen)在克里斯·帕帕斯(Chris Pappas)前众议院席位的竞选中赢得了民主党提名。斯蒂芬妮·沙欣 (Stefany Shaheen) 的母亲珍妮·沙欣 (Jeanne Shaheen) 是前州长，自 2009 年以来一直代表新罕布什尔州参议院。小沙欣的家庭与民主党建制派的关系 — — 以及裙带关系的指控 — — 成为她的对手在初选中攻击的一个焦点。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The political landscape often brings scrutiny to family ties and perceived advantages, as seen with Stefany Shaheen's nomination. The call to 'act justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God' reminds us to evaluate actions and motivations with integrity, seeking fairness and ethical conduct above all else, even amidst political maneuvering.
reflection.zh: 政治格局常常使家族关系和所谓的优势受到审视，正如斯蒂芬妮·沙欣的提名所示。‘行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心与你的雅伟同行’的呼召提醒我们，即使在政治操纵之中，也要以正直来评估行为和动机，将公平和道德行为置于一切之上。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: SMH columnist Peter FitzSimons tells Alan Jones trial alleged victim was ‘revolted’ by abuse
title.zh: SMH专栏作家彼得·菲茨西蒙斯在艾伦·琼斯审判中称，据称的受害者对虐待感到“厌恶”

summary.en: Columnist Peter FitzSimons testified in court that an alleged victim, referred to as complainant C, described unwanted sexual advances from broadcaster Alan Jones, stating Jones would touch his penis and she 'kept pushing it away.' The complainant reportedly sounded 'emotionally traumatised' when detailing the alleged...
summary.zh: 专栏作家彼得·菲茨西蒙斯在法庭上作证称，一位被称为“投诉人C”的据称受害者描述了2GB广播公司主持人艾伦·琼斯（Alan Jones）的性骚扰行为，称琼斯会触摸她的阴茎，而她“一直推开”。据报道，这位投诉人在详细描述所谓的袭击事件时听起来“情绪受到创伤”。

body.en: FitzSimons tells court that complainant C told him Jones, who has pleaded not guilty, would touch his penis and he ‘kept pushing it away’ Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Sydney Morning Herald columnist Peter FitzSimons has told the Alan Jones trial an alleged victim he spoke to in 2019 was “tearful” and sounded “emotionally traumatised” when detailing alleged assaults by the 2GB broadcaster. The commentator and author gave evidence in the Downing Centre local court on Thursday about a telephone call he had with the alleged victim known as complainant C in October 2019. Continue reading...
body.zh: FitzSimons 告诉法庭，原告 C 告诉他，已不认罪的琼斯会触摸他的阴茎，而他“一直把它推开”。 关注我们的澳大利亚新闻直播博客，了解最新动态 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 《悉尼先驱晨报》专栏作家 Peter FitzSimons 告诉艾伦·琼斯审判，他在 2019 年与一名据称受害人交谈时，在详细描述被指控的袭击者时，他“泪流满面”，听起来“受到了情感创伤” 2GB 广播器。周四，这位评论员兼作者在唐宁中心地方法院提供了证据，讲述了他在 2019 年 10 月与被称为受害者、原告 C 的一次电话通话。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The testimony of Peter FitzSimons brings to light the profound distress and trauma experienced by an alleged victim of sexual assault. Isaiah 1:17 calls us to 'seek justice, correct oppression; bring justice to the fatherless, plead the widow's cause.' This verse reminds us of the sacred duty to listen to, believe, and advocate for those who have been...
reflection.zh: 彼得·菲茨西蒙斯的证词揭示了一位性侵案受害者的深刻痛苦和创伤。《以赛亚书》1章17节呼吁我们：“你们要寻求公平，纠正压迫；为孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辩屈。”这节经文提醒我们，倾听、相信并为那些遭受不公和虐待的人辩护，确保他们的声音被听到并追求正义，是我们神圣的职责。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: Rhode Island’s Democratic governor loses primary amid anger over bridge
title.zh: 罗德岛州民主党州长因大桥问题在初选中落败

summary.en: Rhode Island's Democratic Governor Dan McKee lost his primary election to Helena Foulkes, becoming the first sitting governor to lose a primary in nearly a decade. Foulkes's campaign criticized McKee's handling of the Providence Washington Bridge, which is not expected to be completed until 2028.
summary.zh: 罗德岛州民主党州长丹·麦基在初选中败给了海伦娜·福尔克斯，成为近十年来首位在初选中落败的在任州长。福尔克斯的竞选活动批评了麦基对普罗维登斯华盛顿大桥的处理方式，该大桥预计要到2028年才能完工。

body.en: Helena Foulkes beats incumbent Dan McKee after criticizing handling of Providence’s Washington bridge, now expected to be completed in 2028 Rhode Island’s Dan McKee became the first sitting governor to lose a primary in nearly a decade, bested not by a more progressive challenger or a more youthful upset but by frustration over a bridge. McKee lost his Democratic primary to Helena Foulkes, a former longtime executive with Rhode Island-based retail pharmacy CVS, the Associated Press said on Wednesday. Continue reading...
body.zh: 海伦娜·福克斯 (Helena Foulkes) 在批评普罗维登斯华盛顿大桥的处理后击败了现任州长丹·麦基 (Dan McKee)，该大桥预计将于 2028 年竣工。罗德岛州的丹·麦基 (Dan McKee) 成为近十年来第一位在初选中落败的在任州长，击败他的不是更进步的挑战者或更年轻的不安，而是因为对桥梁的挫败感。美联社周三称，麦基在民主党初选中输给了罗德岛州零售药店 CVS 的前长期高管海伦娜·福克斯 (Helena Foulkes)。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Political fortunes can shift dramatically, as seen in Rhode Island where Governor McKee lost his primary bid. This event echoes the ancient wisdom that leadership is ultimately in divine hands, with the power to exalt and to humble. It serves as a reminder that even those in high office are subject to the unfolding purposes of Providence.
reflection.zh: 政治命运可能发生剧烈变化，正如罗德岛州州长麦基在初选中失利一样。这一事件呼应了古老的智慧，即领导权最终掌握在神圣的手中，祂有能力高举，也有能力降卑。这提醒我们，即使是身居高位者，也受制于雅伟的旨意。

verse.textEn: It is God who judges: He brings one down, he exalts another.
verse.textZh: 惟有神断定；他使这人降卑，使那人升高。

title.en: Australia politics live: Coalition rejects Labor’s ‘unacceptable’ plan to regulate harmful content on social media
title.zh: 马利纳斯警告阿尔巴尼斯不要追随一国党走上削减移民的歧途

summary.en: South Australian Premier Peter Malinauskas has warned Prime Minister Anthony Albanese against adopting the One Nation party's stance on cutting migration, arguing that Australia faces a housing crisis, not a migration crisis. He suggests that focusing on bringing in skilled workers for the construction industry is a...
summary.zh: 南澳大利亚州州长彼得·马利纳斯警告总理安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯，不要采纳一国党削减移民的立场，认为澳大利亚面临的是住房危机，而非移民危机。他建议，将重点放在引进建筑行业的熟练工人，是解决住房短缺问题的更有效途径。

body.en: Follow the day’s news live Labor introducing new laws to crack down on illegal tobacco Labor will introduce new laws to make it easier to prosecute criminals involved in the illicit tobacco trade, as the government fights an uphill battle against the exploding black market. The new laws think about it as a list of observable indicators, very simple, fact-based things like: is the tobacco appropriately packaged? Is it a menthol cigarette even hiding in plain packaging? Is it being concealed? Does it have paperwork at the border? Or my personal favourite: is the retail price of this packet of cigarettes less than the amount of excise and GST combined? If any of these facts are proven, just one of them, that establishes the reasonable suspicion of the criminal offence of importing, possession, or conveying. It’ll give powerful new tools to Border Force but every state and territory police force to go after the crooks. I said, look, my door’s open if you want to talk about this. I don’t know why he thinks I’m a liar. I don’t quite know why he believes I lied about it. I’m disappointed he thinks I’m a coward. I don’t know how he came to that opinion but that’s up to him. I don’t think he’s a traitor. I absolutely respect the services given to our nation, like my family, has given to the service of New Zealand and Australia. Democracy’s a robust thing. Continue reading...
body.zh: 关注当天的新闻直播 “我们需要解释澳大利亚没有移民危机”：马利瑙卡斯 Peter Malinaukas 表示，他理解澳大利亚人对澳大利亚移民和住房短缺的担忧，但答案是政客们需要解释正在发生的是住房危机，而不是移民危机。我们需要解释一下，澳大利亚真正面临的不是移民危机，而是住房危机。如果我们遇到住房危机，我们最好将技能政策的重点放在确保引进住房建筑行业所需的工人上。你知道，澳大利亚几乎所有行业都严重短缺。我认为每个人都承认这需要一个经过良好校准、平衡的移民计划。我的观点是，过去几年我们在这个国家的政治话语中没有看到太多支持移民的证据。只是看到许多针对移民的文化战争正在发生。我认为这是弄巧成拙的，我们有责任站起来反对它。最重要的是，[我们必须]保留我们强有力的移民计划……对反移民政治和民粹主义者的正确政治反应不是绥靖政策。更令人不安的是，主流政治可能会进入一场政治竞赛，看看谁能最大程度地减少移民数量。这并不不幸——这是疯狂。想象一下，如果我们对采矿业这样做，世界上每个电视台和手机上都会有一个广告，讲述我们如何杀鸡取卵。这太疯狂了。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The debate over migration in Australia highlights a tension between perceived crises and underlying realities. Premier Malinauskas urges a focus on the housing shortage, suggesting that skilled migration could be part of the solution rather than the problem. This calls for national discernment, seeking policies that build up rather than tear down, and...
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚关于移民的争论凸显了人们感知的危机与实际现实之间的紧张关系。州长马利纳斯敦促将重点放在住房短缺问题上，并认为技术移民可以成为解决方案的一部分，而不是问题本身。这需要国家具备辨别力，寻求能够建设而非破坏的政策，并以诚信的态度解决根本原因。

verse.textEn: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin condemns any people.
verse.textZh: 公义使邦国高举；罪恶是人民的羞辱。

title.en: Land in limbo: BBC visits West Bank village in area earmarked by Israel for settlement
title.zh: 土地悬而未决：BBC探访以色列计划建定居点的西岸村庄

summary.en: BBC's Middle East Correspondent Lucy Williamson visits the Palestinian community of Khan al Ahmar in the so-called E1 area, and the neighbouring Israeli settlement of Maale Admumim.
summary.zh: BBC中东记者露西·威廉姆森探访了位于所谓E1地区的巴勒斯坦社区汗·阿赫马尔，以及邻近的以色列定居点马阿莱·阿杜明。

body.en:
UK sanctions on illegal Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank have triggered a series of Israeli counter-measures against UK nationals and organisations.

The sanctions came after Israel opened up tenders for the construction of settlement homes in the strategically important so-called E1 area east of Jerusalem, plans that have drawn widespread international condemnation.

The development would in effect divide the West Bank in two, and isolate East Jerusalem.

The BBC's Middle East Correspondent Lucy Williamson has been to the Palestinian community of Khan al Ahmar in the E1 area, and also to the neighbouring Israeli settlement of Maale Admumim.
body.zh: 英国对被占领约旦河西岸的以色列非法定居点实施制裁，引发以色列针对英国国民和组织采取一系列反制措施。 此次制裁是在以色列为在耶路撒冷以东具有重要战略意义的所谓E1地区建造定居点进行招标之后实施的，该计划引起了国际社会的广泛谴责。 这一发展实际上会将西岸一分为二，并孤立东耶路撒冷。 BBC中东记者露西·威廉姆森走访了E1地区的巴勒斯坦社区Khan al Ahmar，以及邻近的以色列定居点Maale Admumim。

reflection.en: The village of Khan al Ahmar stands in an area earmarked for Israeli settlement expansion, raising concerns about the displacement of its Palestinian residents. In such situations, the vulnerable often lack a voice against powerful forces. The call to "open your mouth for the speechless, in the cause of all who are appointed to die" (Proverbs 31:8) reminds...
reflection.zh: 汗·阿赫马尔村位于以色列计划扩张定居点的区域，引发了对当地巴勒斯坦居民可能流离失所的担忧。在这样的情况下，弱势群体往往无力为自己发声。箴言31:8呼吁“你要为穷人敞开你的口，为所有孤苦无告的人伸冤”，提醒我们要为那些家园和未来充满不确定性的人们发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Why Donald Trump's latest map has the North Atlantic on edge
title.zh: 特朗普的最新地图为何让北大西洋紧张起来

summary.en: A map posted by United States President Donald Trump, showing the US extending to include Greenland and Iceland, has drawn sharp reactions from North Atlantic governments. The president offered no explanation for the 'disturbing' post, which follows months of comments about potentially annexing Canada and acquiring...
summary.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普发布的一张地图，显示美国领土延伸至格陵兰岛和冰岛，引起了北大西洋各国政府的强烈反应。总统未对此“令人不安”的帖子作出任何解释，此前他已就可能吞并加拿大和出于战略原因获取格陵兰岛发表了数月评论。

body.en:
A map posted by United States President Donald Trump has drawn sharp reactions from governments across the North Atlantic.

The image showed the US stretching across North America and extending north to include Greenland and Iceland.

But it came after months of comments about Canada becoming the 51st US state and repeated statements about taking control of Greenland, a self-governing territory within the Kingdom of Denmark.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Trump has repeatedly said the US should acquire Greenland, citing its strategic importance.

Greenland is geographically part of North America but politically linked to Europe through its relationship with Denmark. It has extensive self-government, while Denmark remains responsible for areas including foreign and defence policy.

The latest map prompted a strong response from Danish foreign minister Lars Løkke Rasmussen.

"It’s disturbing and, in many ways, completely inappropriate," he told Danish broadcaster DR on Wednesday.

He said the post showed that Trump still held what he described as a "maximalist vision" and added: "We need to rein that in."

Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen also stressed that Greenlanders had repeatedly said they did not want to become part of the US.

Iceland became part of the controversy after Trump repeatedly referred to Iceland instead of Greenland while discussing his plans.

The countries are relatively close geographically, with Iceland about 290km from Greenland, but Iceland is an independent country and a NATO member.

Iceland's foreign secretary Thorgerdur Katrín Gunnarsdóttir summoned US ambassador Billy Long after Trump's map was posted. According to Iceland's national broadcaster RÚV, she told him the post was unacceptable.

The controversy has also added to debate in Iceland over its relationship with Europe.

Its left-leaning coalition government put forward a referendum on whether to resume long-stalled EU membership negotiations, partly framed around strengthening ties with Europe amid geopolitical uncertainty.

Earlier this year, thousands of Icelanders signed a petition urging the government to reject him as ambassador after he joked about Iceland becoming the 52nd US state and himself becoming its governor.

His comments came as Trump was already drawing attention in the region with his repeated statements about Greenland and Canada.

Canada has also faced frequent comments from Trump about becoming part of the US.

The remarks have coincided with a trade war between Washington and Ottawa. Trump has also recently referred to Lake Ontario as "Lake America".

During the same weekend as his North American map...
body.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普发布的一张地图引起了北大西洋各国政府的强烈反应。 该图像显示美国横跨北美并向北延伸包括格陵兰岛和冰岛。 但此前几个月，有关加拿大成为美国第 51 个州的言论不断涌现，并多次声明要控制丹麦王国境内的自治领土格陵兰岛。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 特朗普多次表示，美国应该收购格陵兰岛，理由是其战略重要性。 格陵兰岛在地理上是北美的一部分，但在政治上通过与丹麦的关系与欧洲联系在一起。它拥有广泛的自治权，而丹麦仍然负责外交和国防政策等领域。 最新的地图引起了丹麦外交部长拉斯·洛克·拉斯穆森的强烈反应。 “这令人不安，而且在很多方面都是完全不合适的，”他周三告诉丹麦广播公司 DR。 他说，这篇帖子表明特朗普仍然持有他所说的“极简主义愿景”，并补充说：“我们需要控制这一点。” 丹麦首相梅特·弗雷德里克森也强调，格陵兰人曾多次表示，他们不想成为美国的一部分。 特朗普在讨论他的计划时多次提到冰岛而不是格陵兰岛后，冰岛成为争议的一部分。 两国地理位置较为接近，冰岛距离格陵兰岛约290公里，但冰岛是独立国家，也是北约成员国。 在特朗普的地图发布后，冰岛外交大臣索尔格杜尔·卡特林·古纳尔斯多蒂尔召见了美国大使比利·朗。据冰岛国家广播公司 RÚV 报道，她告诉他这个帖子是不可接受的。 这场争议也加剧了冰岛关于其与欧洲关系的争论。 其左倾联合政府就是否恢复长期停滞的欧盟成员资格谈判提出了公投，部分目的是在地缘政治不确定性的情况下加强与欧洲的关系。 今年早些时候，数千名冰岛人签署了一份请愿书，敦促政府拒绝他担任大使，因为他开玩笑说冰岛将成为美国第 52 个州，而他自己也将成为该州州长。 在他发表此番言论之际，特朗普多次就格陵兰岛和加拿大发表言论，已经引起了该地区的关注。 加拿大也经常面临特朗普关于成为美国一部分的评论。 此番言论恰逢华盛顿和渥太华之间的贸易战。特朗普最近还将安大略湖称为“美国湖”。 在他的北美地图的同一个周末......

reflection.en: The posting of a map that dramatically redraws national boundaries, without explanation, can stir anxieties and challenge established international relations. Such actions can be seen as a manifestation of pride or overreach, reminding us that "pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall."
reflection.zh: 一张未经解释就大幅重绘国家边界的地图的发布，可能会引发焦虑并挑战既有的国际关系。此类行为可被视为骄傲或越权的体现，提醒我们“骄傲在灭亡之前，狂心在跌倒之前。”

verse.textEn: Pride goes before destruction, a haughty spirit before a fall.
verse.textZh: 骄傲在败坏以先；狂心在跌倒之前。

title.en: Spanish intelligence warned of Ceuta mass crossing plans before surge
title.zh: 西班牙情报部门在涌入潮之前警告了塞塔大规模过境计划

summary.en: Declassified documents show that Spanish and Moroccan authorities were alerted to social media calls for a mass migrant crossing into Ceuta the day before tens of thousands of people entered the territory, contradicting Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez's claims that the events were unpredictable.
summary.zh: 解密文件显示，在数万人涌入休达边境的前一天，西班牙和摩洛哥当局就已收到社交媒体上关于大规模移民过境的呼吁，这与首相佩德罗·桑切斯声称事件无法预测的说法相矛盾。

body.en:
Spanish intelligence services warned of social media calls for a mass migrant crossing into Ceuta the day before tens of thousands of people entered the territory, newly released government documents show.

The revelations emerged in documents declassified by the Spanish government amid accusations it failed to give the full story of the migrant influx.

On 29 July, Spain's National Intelligence Service (CNI) told Moroccan and Ceuta authorities that social media groups were encouraging migrants to cross the following day.

Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez has insisted that the events of 30 July were impossible to predict, but opposition parties say the documents show the government misled Spaniards.

Sánchez had previously told parliament that there was "no information that conveyed the magnitude" of the "crisis we were going to suffer" on the last two days of July.

At least 72,000 migrants crossed from Morocco into Ceuta on 30 and 31 July. Most swam around a border fence and at least 100 people died during the crossing, according to figures from Ceuta's mayor.

Although most returned, as many as 5,000 remain in makeshift camps or are sleeping on the city's streets and beaches, leading to unrest in the autonomous Spanish city in North Africa. Locals have expressed safety concerns and some have destroyed shelters and blocked aid being supplied to the migrants .

In a note on 29 July, the CNI told Moroccan intelligence it had identified WhatsApp and Facebook groups promoting an attempt by migrants to reach the Spanish exclave the following day, "both swimming and via the [border] fence".

The CNI reported that around 180,000 people were receiving the messages, one of which read: "Whoever wants to cross has the last chance on Throne Day [30 July] at 8 the authorities will be distracted with the celebrations and parades."

It also warned, via text message, the central government's representation in Ceuta and the civil guard about the social media activity.

The messages are part of a tranche of more than 40 security documents linked to the Ceuta crossing that the government declassified following mounting pressure on Sánchez over his handling of the crisis and widespread allegations in Spain that Morocco had played a role in facilitating the crossings.

Earlier this month, a leaked Spanish police report seemed to implicate Moroccan police in the incident.

However, Sánchez has maintained that there is no evidence suggesting Moroccan complicity.

Shortly before the documents were released on Wednesday, he told Spanish television that "the mass arrival of migrants was not expected".

But opposition politicians said the newly released material contradict that claim.

"They had the information, they are directly responsible for the invasion of Ceuta and for...
body.zh: 新公布的政府文件显示，西班牙情报部门在数万人进入休达的前一天警告称，社交媒体呼吁大规模移民进入休达。 这些内容出现在西班牙政府解密的文件中，因为有人指责西班牙政府未能提供移民涌入的全部情况。 7 月 29 日，西班牙国家情报局 (CNI) 告诉摩洛哥和休达当局，社交媒体团体鼓励移民第二天越境。 西班牙首相佩德罗·桑切斯坚称 7 月 30 日发生的事件无法预测，但反对党称这些文件显示政府误导了西班牙人。 桑切斯此前曾向议会表示，“没有任何信息表明我们将在 7 月最后两天遭受的危机的严重程度”。 7 月 30 日至 31 日，至少有 72,000 名移民从摩洛哥越境进入休达。休达市长的数据显示，大多数人绕过边境围栏，至少有 100 人在穿越边境时死亡。 尽管大多数人已返回，但仍有多达 5,000 人留在临时营地或睡在城市的街道和海滩上，导致北非西班牙自治城市发生骚乱。当地人表达了安全担忧，一些人摧毁了避难所并阻止向移民提供援助。 在 7 月 29 日的一份报告中，CNI 告诉摩洛哥情报机构，它发现 WhatsApp 和 Facebook 群组宣传移民试图在第二天到达西班牙飞地，“无论是游泳还是通过[边境]围栏”。 CNI 报道称，约有 18 万人收到了这些信息，其中一条信息写道：“任何想要穿越的人都有最后一次机会，即在即位日（7 月 30 日）8 点，当局将因庆祝活动和游行而分心。” 它还通过短信警告中央政府在休达的代表和国民警卫队有关社交媒体活动的信息。 这些信息是与休达过境点相关的 40 多份安全文件的一部分，在桑切斯因处理危机而受到越来越大的压力以及西班牙广泛指控摩洛哥在便利过境点方面发挥了作用之后，政府解密了这些文件。 本月早些时候，一份泄露的西班牙警方报告似乎暗示摩洛哥警方参与了这起事件。 然而，桑切斯坚称，没有证据表明摩洛哥参与其中。 在周三公布这些文件前不久，他对西班牙电视台表示，“移民的大规模抵达是意料之外的”。 但反对派政界人士表示，新发布的材料与这一说法相矛盾。 “他们掌握了信息，他们对入侵休达负有直接责任……

reflection.en: The news reveals that Spanish intelligence had prior knowledge of the planned mass migrant crossing into Ceuta. This raises questions about governmental responsibility and the duty to protect vulnerable populations, both those seeking entry and those already within the territory. Jeremiah 22:3 calls rulers to 'execute justice and righteousness, and deliver...
reflection.zh: 新闻披露西班牙情报部门事先知晓了计划中的大规模移民过境休达事件。这引发了关于政府责任以及保护弱势群体的义务的问题，无论是寻求入境者还是已在境内的人们。耶利米书22:3呼吁统治者“施行公平和公义，拯救被欺压的脱离欺压者的手。”

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Zelenskyy's plane 'almost hit' by drone; Trump says Putin wants Ukraine deal
title.zh: 泽连斯基飞机险遭无人机袭击；特朗普称普京希望达成乌克兰协议

summary.en: Donald Trump stated that Russian President Vladimir Putin desires a peace deal, coinciding with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's visit to Oslo. Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre reported that Zelenskyy's plane was nearly struck by a drone while taking off from Moldova, though a Ukrainian presidency...
summary.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普表示，俄罗斯总统普京希望达成一项和平协议，这与乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基访问奥斯陆的事件同时发生。挪威首相约纳斯·加尔·斯特勒报告称，泽连斯基的飞机在摩尔多瓦起飞时险些被无人机击中，但乌克兰总统办公室的一位消息人士淡化了风险，称这一说法“被夸大了”，并将其归因于摩尔多瓦和罗马尼亚空域的无人机警报。

body.en:
Ukraine and Moldova have played down claims from Norway's prime minister that a plane carrying Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy was almost hit by a drone as it flew to Oslo.

Jonas Gahr Støre told Norwegian public broadcaster NRK on Thursday AEST that Zelenskyy's plane was "almost hit by a drone when it was taking off from Moldova".

But a source in the Ukrainian presidency described the claim that Zelenskyy was at risk as "exaggerated".

"It was an alert in Moldova when a Russian (drone) entered Moldovan and Romanian airspace," the source told the Agence France-Presse news agency (AFP).

In Chisinau, government spokesman Dumitru Ciorici said Moldova closed its airspace on Tuesday afternoon just after 4.30pm local time due to a Russian drone that entered from the direction of Ukraine.

"The airspace was closed to protect aircraft flying over Moldova at the time: three departures and four arrivals were delayed as a result," he added.

"After 1720 [5.20pm], the authorities confirmed that the drone had come down and exploded ... some 160km from Chisinau International Airport.

"Flight restrictions were then lifted. For the same reason, the plane of Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy took off ... later than scheduled."

Zelenskyy arrived in Oslo on Tuesday evening and held talks with Støre, finance minister Jens Stoltenberg and foreign minister Espen Barth Eide on Norwegian military aid, including air-defence support, and civilian assistance.

On Wednesday, he joined a host of other foreign dignitaries at the funeral of Norway's King Harald, who died on 28 August aged 89 .

US President Donald Trump said on Thursday that he had a "great" conversation ‌with Russian President Vladimir Putin earlier in the week and that the ‌Russian leader wanted to make a deal to end the Ukraine war.

"He is wanting to make a deal, and if Zelenskyy is wanting to make a deal, that'd be very nice," ‌Trump told ‌reporters ⁠before boarding Air Force One en route to Dallas for the Republican National Convention.

Trump spoke over the phone with Putin on Tuesday, shortly after US special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner returned from a diplomatic swing through Moscow and Kyiv.

⁠The duo, who are in ‌charge of most major peace negotiations for the US, discussed potential proposals to bring the ‌war to a close.

Last month, Central Intelligence Agency director John Ratcliffe met with intelligence officials in Moscow, in part to encourage Russian officials to end their invasion.

reflection.en: Amidst the ongoing conflict in Ukraine, reports surface of near-miss incidents involving President Zelenskyy's aircraft, juxtaposed with statements suggesting a potential for peace talks. This situation underscores the delicate balance between active hostilities and the persistent pursuit of diplomacy, reminding us to pray for wisdom and courage for leaders...

title.en: Saudi-led coalition and Houthis trade strikes as Yemen conflict deepens
title.zh: 沙特领导的联盟与胡塞武装交火，也门冲突加剧

summary.en: Renewed fighting between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis is raising fears of a return to broader conflict in the region. Hundreds have been killed in recent clashes near the Red Sea, with over 50 attacks targeting various regions in Yemen. Thousands have been displaced, with one individual describing the situation as a...
summary.zh: 沙特阿拉伯与胡塞武装之间的新一轮战斗加剧了该地区重返更广泛冲突的担忧。最近在红海附近的冲突已造成数百人死亡，超过50次袭击针对也门多个地区。数千人流离失所，其中一人形容局势为“一场灾难”。

body.en:
Houthi rebels and the Saudi-led coalition exchanged airstrikes overnight as daily attacks continued in a conflict that has reignited during the Middle East war, with hundreds of people killed in fighting near the Red Sea.

More than 50 attacks targeted several regions in Yemen, including the flashpoint areas of Taiz and Hodeida, the scene of fierce clashes between the Houthis and the Saudi-backed government, the rebels said.

"It's a catastrophe, and the attacks are ongoing," said Mohammed Khudairi, one of nearly 20,000 people who fled the fighting, according to the International Organization for Migration.

"We managed to leave, but others remain trapped there," he said at a displacement camp of wood-and-straw huts near Khokha, on the Red Sea coast.

The latest salvos in Yemen's previously dormant conflict come a day after the Houthis set oil sites ablaze and wounded 73 in their heaviest missile and drone attacks against Saudi Arabia in years.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The Saudi-led military coalition said the Iran-backed group had launched fresh attacks on the kingdom's south on Wednesday as the Houthis reported dozens of incoming salvoes from the kingdom.

The rebels' Al-Masirah TV channel reported on Wednesday the toll from Saudi strikes on a prison days earlier had climbed to 32 dead and seven injured as rescue and recovery efforts continued.

The fighting comes against the backdrop of the Middle East war, which erupted in late February with US-Israeli strikes on Iran .

The Middle East war has sucked in Yemen, the energy-rich Gulf and others across the region while roiling the world economy, as oil prices returned to $100 a barrel on Wednesday.

The fighting in Yemen has killed more than 500 people since the Houthis launched a major offensive last week to seize territory around the Bab al-Mandab strait, gateway to the Red Sea shipping route.

The rebels , who have been attacking Saudi oil tankers, are trying to tighten their squeeze on the shipments, analysts say — a lifeline for exports after Iran's closure of the Strait of Hormuz .

The Saudi-led coalition's spokesman Turki al-Maliki said the Houthis "launched several ballistic missiles and drones toward the cities of Khamis Mushait, Abha, and Jizan", without mentioning any casualties as a result of the attacks.

Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree had earlier said that "during the past 12 hours, the Saudi enemy's air force conducted 54 airstrikes targeting the provinces of Al-Jawf, Marib, Taiz, Hodeida and Saada".

Footage released by the group showed what it said were attacks on Saudi-backed forces on Al-Jawf province's frontlines, with missiles heard flying overhead...
