title.en: Two die at Moldovan border as Russia-Ukraine drone war rages
title.zh: 摩尔多瓦边境两人死亡，俄乌无人机战争仍在继续

summary.en: Five deaths are reported in Ukraine and four in Russia as both sides launch new drone strikes. Two people died when Russian drones hit a border crossing between Ukraine and Moldova, according to Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky. The Starokozache crossing was shut after the overnight attack. In Kyiv, a woman was...
summary.zh: 据报道，乌克兰有五人死亡，俄罗斯有四人死亡，双方都发动了新的无人机袭击。乌克兰总统泽连斯基表示，两名俄罗斯无人机袭击了乌克兰和摩尔多瓦之间的边境口岸，导致两人死亡。事发后，Starokozache口岸被关闭。在乌克兰首都基辅，一名妇女死亡，14人受伤，此前一架俄罗斯无人机击中了一栋九层居民楼。在俄罗斯，据当地官员称，在...

body.en:
Two people died when Russian drones hit a border crossing between Ukraine and Moldova, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has said.

The Starokozache crossing was shut after the overnight attack. Images from the scene show several burnt-out cars amid the debris.

In Kyiv, a woman was killed and 14 people, including two children, were injured after a Russian drone hit a nine-storey building, officials said, while in Sumy three people died after a drone struck a shopping centre.

In Russia, officials said four people, including a child, were killed in a Ukrainian drone attack on the Black Sea port of Novorossiysk, while a drone hit an industrial facility in the Arctic city of Novy Urengoy.

In the north-eastern city of Sumy, 20 people were also injured in the attack on the shopping mall on Wednesday evening, regional head Oleg Hryhorov said. He said efforts to deal with the aftermath were ongoing.

Russia and Ukraine recently stepped up long-range strikes, despite renewed diplomatic efforts to end the war.

Zelensky renewed calls for international support in the wake of the attack at the Starokozache road crossing, saying "the aggression must be stopped here and now before it spreads any further".

The crossing, about 500km (310 miles) south of Kyiv, was shut after the attack killed two people and injured three others, Odesa regional head Oleh Kiper said.

A Moldovan driver was also injured, according to the country's foreign ministry.

Moldova has increasingly found itself caught up in the conflict, with Prime Minister Vasile Tofan confirming that 17 drones struck Moldovan territory in August alone - more than during the whole of last year.

"Those who ignore or downplay these threats - and refuse to name the aggressor - are denying reality," he wrote on social media.

Russia's defence ministry said its forces had shot down 596 Ukrainian drones overnight.

Novorossiysk – in the south of the country - was hit hardest in what governor Veniamin Kondratiev described as a "massive overnight enemy drone attack".

As well as the four deaths, 29 people were injured, and damage was reported to residential buildings, a church and a preschool.

In Novy Urengoy, a drone attack on an "industrial facility" was repelled, regional governor Dmitry Artyukhov said.

He added that the falling drone wreckage had triggered a fire but no-one had been injured.

Ukraine's military said late on Wednesday that it had hit the Novourengoysky ZPKT - a major oil refinery located more than 3,000km from Ukraine's border.

It said the facility's petroleum products and gas condensate were being used by Russia to continue its war effort.

The strikes come a day after Russian President Vladimir Putin spoke to US President Donald Trump by phone about efforts to end the war.

The...
body.zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基表示，俄罗斯无人机袭击了乌克兰和摩尔多瓦之间的过境点，造成两人死亡。 夜间袭击后，斯塔科扎切过境点被关闭。现场图像显示，废墟中有几辆被烧毁的汽车。 官员称，在乌克兰首都基辅，一架俄罗斯无人机击中一栋九层住宅，导致一名妇女死亡，包括两名儿童在内的 14 人受伤。 俄罗斯官员称，在俄罗斯黑海港口新罗西斯克，乌克兰无人机袭击造成包括一名儿童在内的四人死亡，一架无人机袭击了距离乌克兰近 3,000 公里（1,864 英里）的北极城市新乌连戈伊的一处工业设施。 尽管俄罗斯和乌克兰为结束战争重新做出了外交努力，但最近还是加强了远程打击。 斯塔罗科扎切公路交叉口袭击事件发生后，泽连斯基再次呼吁国际社会提供支持，他表示“必须立即制止侵略行为，以免其进一步蔓延”。 敖德萨地区负责人奥莱·基佩尔表示，位于基辅以南约 500 公里处的过境点在袭击造成两人死亡、三人受伤后被关闭。 据摩尔多瓦外交部称，一名摩尔多瓦司机也受伤。 摩尔多瓦越来越多地陷入冲突，总理瓦西里·托凡证实，仅 8 月份就有 17 架无人机袭击了摩尔多瓦领土，比去年全年的数量还要多。 他在社交媒体上写道：“那些忽视或淡化这些威胁并拒绝说出侵略者姓名的人正在否认现实。” 俄罗斯国防部表示，俄罗斯军队一夜之间击落了 596 架乌克兰无人机。 位于该国南部的新罗西斯克在州长韦尼亚明·康德拉季耶夫 (Veniamin Kondratiev) 所说的“夜间大规模敌方无人机袭击”中受到的打击最为严重。 除 4 人死亡外，还有 29 人受伤，据报道住宅楼、一座教堂和一所幼儿园遭到损坏。 新乌连戈伊地区州长德米特里·阿秋霍夫 (Dmitry Artyukhov) 表示，无人机对“工业设施”的袭击被击退。 他补充说，坠落的无人机残骸引发了火灾，但没有人受伤。 袭击发生前一天，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普通电话，讨论了结束战争的努力。 特朗普政府一直敦促俄罗斯和乌克兰进行直接会谈，基辅表示可能于本月举行。然而，克里姆林宫表示，现在讨论日期或地点还为时过早。 周六，美国特使贾里德·库什纳、史蒂夫·威特科夫和普京在莫斯科举行了会谈，随后两人于周日前往基辅与乌克兰总统泽伦斯基会面。

reflection.en: The news from the Ukrainian-Moldovan border is a stark reminder of how conflict draws in more lives and lands. The cycle of retaliation, where each strike begets another, brings only further devastation. The call to overcome evil with good, rather than mirroring violence, remains a profound challenge in such times.
reflection.zh: 来自乌克兰-摩尔多瓦边境的新闻，令人痛心地提醒我们冲突如何牵连更多生命和土地。以暴制暴的报复循环只会带来进一步的毁灭。在这样的时代，‘以善胜恶’而非以恶报恶的呼吁，仍然是一个深刻的挑战。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Iran referred to UN Security Council for nuclear non-compliance
title.zh: 伊朗因核不合规问题被提交至联合国安理会

summary.en: The UN nuclear watchdog has referred Iran to the Security Council for "non-compliance" with its obligations under the non-proliferation treaty, marking the first such move in 20 years. The board cited a lack of information on Iran's nuclear material and insufficient access for inspectors. Tehran condemned the...
summary.zh: 联合国核监督机构已将伊朗“不遵守”核不扩散条约义务一事提交安理会，这是20年来首次采取此类行动。理事会指出，伊朗核材料信息不足，并且检查人员的准入受限。德黑兰谴责了这一决定，指责美国和以色列对其核设施的袭击扰乱了检查，但由于中国和俄罗斯可能行使否决权，新的制裁不太可能实施。

body.en:
The UN nuclear watchdog has referred Iran to the Security Council for "non-compliance" with its obligations under the non-proliferation treaty - the first such move in 20 years.

The board of governors of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) passed a resolution at a meeting in Vienna.

It cites a lack of information on Iran's nuclear material such as its stockpile of highly enriched uranium, and the lack of access to nuclear facilities for IAEA inspectors.

Tehran condemned the IAEA decision, blaming US and Israeli strikes on its nuclear facilities for disrupting inspections.

New sanctions are nonetheless unlikely because Iran's allies China and Russia have veto powers in the council.

The IAEA resolution - tabled by the UK, France, Germany and the US - was backed by 23 countries, with eight abstentions. China, Russia and Niger voted against.

The document , external asks IAEA chief Rafael Grossi to report Iran to the Security Council.

"They attack Iran's safeguarded nuclear facilities, disrupt the normal process of verification, and then use that very disruption as a pretext to issue a resolution," Iranian deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi wrote in a post on X.

The IAEA has not had access to Iran's nuclear facilities since Israel and the US carried out a number of strikes on those sites during a 12-day conflict in June 2025.

The sites were targeted again in the latest war, launched by Israel and the US on 28 February.

Iran says the attacks on its facilities, including uranium enrichment plants in Natanz and Fordo, are the reason it does not let IAEA inspectors visit these sites.

Tehran also wants such access to be part of a wider settlement with the US and Israel to end the war.

Iran has repeatedly stated that its nuclear programme is solely for peaceful purposes.

The US, Israel and a number of European countries have questioned this claim, amid concerns that Tehran is trying to build a nuclear weapon.

At the start of the latest US-Israel war against Iran, Tehran had roughly 440kg (970lb) of 60% enriched uranium, according to senior US officials.

The material can be fairly quickly enriched to the 90% threshold needed for weapons-grade uranium.
body.zh: 联合国核监督机构已将伊朗“不遵守”核不扩散条约义务的行为提交安理会，这是 20 年来的首次此类举动。 国际原子能机构（IAEA）理事会在维也纳举行的会议上通过了一项决议。 它指出缺乏有关伊朗核材料的信息，例如其高浓缩铀库存，以及国际原子能机构视察员无法进入核设施。 德黑兰谴责国际原子能机构的决定，指责美国和以色列对其核设施的袭击扰乱了检查。 尽管如此，新的制裁不太可能发生，因为伊朗的盟友中国和俄罗斯在安理会拥有否决权。 国际原子能机构的决议由英国、法国、德国和美国提出，得到 23 个国家的支持，8 票弃权。中国、俄罗斯和尼日尔投了反对票。 该文件对外要求国际原子能机构总干事拉斐尔·格罗西向安理会报告伊朗问题。 伊朗副外长卡泽姆·加里巴巴迪（Kazem Gharibabadi）在 X 上的一篇帖子中写道：“他们攻击伊朗受保障的核设施，扰乱正常的核查过程，然后利用这种破坏作为发布决议的借口。” 自以色列和美国在 2025 年 6 月为期 12 天的冲突期间对伊朗核设施进行多次袭击以来，国际原子能机构一直无法进入这些设施。 在以色列和美国于 2 月 28 日发动的最新战争中，这些地点再次成为攻击目标。 伊朗表示，对其设施的袭击，包括纳坦兹和福尔多的铀浓缩工厂，是其不允许国际原子能机构视察员访问这些地点的原因。 德黑兰还希望这种准入成为与美国和以色列结束战争的更广泛解决方案的一部分。 伊朗多次表示，其核计划仅用于和平目的。 由于担心德黑兰试图制造核武器，美国、以色列和一些欧洲国家对这一说法提出质疑。 据美国高级官员称，在最近的美以针对伊朗的战争开始时，德黑兰拥有大约 440 公斤（970 磅）的 60% 浓缩铀。 该材料可以相当快地浓缩至武器级铀所需的 90% 阈值。

reflection.en: The International Atomic Energy Agency's referral of Iran to the UN Security Council underscores the persistent global challenge of nuclear proliferation. This action, the first in two decades, speaks to the difficulty of maintaining trust and transparency in matters of international security. The prophetic vision of Isaiah offers a counterpoint,...
reflection.zh: 国际原子能机构将伊朗提交联合国安理会，凸显了核扩散这一持续存在的全球性挑战。这是二十年来首次采取此类行动，反映了在国际安全事务中维持信任和透明度的困难。以赛亚先知的异象提供了一个对照，描绘了一个未来武器将被转化为和平与农业工具的景象，这是各国仍在努力追求的希望。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: The countries showing Australia a way out of its 'miserable' classroom situation
title.zh: 澳大利亚可以从世界上一些最好的教育方法中学到什么

summary.en: Australia's neighbours are among the world's top-ranked education performers, while Australian schools are reportedly sliding backwards on key measures like literacy, maths, and science.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚的邻国在教育表现方面位居世界前列，而澳大利亚的学校在识字、数学和科学等关键指标上却据称正在滑坡。

body.en:
Heightened classroom disruption, gender divides, dwindling reading and maths scores — a major global student performance report shows Australian schools are continuing to slide backwards on key measures.

Every three years, the global Programme for International Student Assessment (PISA) measures student literacy in mathematics, reading, science and computational problem-solving.

The 2025 edition, which tested 15-year-olds from 91 OECD countries and economies, also measured the effects of gender divides, differences between high and low socio-economic status, and the impacts of technology and classroom disruption.

In the latest report, released on Tuesday, Australia's scores continued a 20-year decline, with maths and reading at Australia's lowest since testing began in 2000.

But Pasi Sahlberg, a Finnish education expert, author and professor at the University of Melbourne, says reports focusing on issues with the Australian school system were missing the big picture.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"The headline is that we have all-time-low results. I think it's absolutely astonishing that our mainstream media are saying this. The truth is every country in the OECD is showing all-time-low results in everything. Very few countries were able to improve their results in 2025," Sahlberg told SBS News.

In the global ranking, Australia moved up one place in reading to 11th, maintained its 17th place in maths, and fell one place in science to 11th. In the computational problem solving category, introduced in 2025, Australia ranked 8th globally. Australia's scores were well above the OECD average in all four key tests.

On Wednesday, in light of the results, federal Education Minister Jason Clare announced new reforms in reading, mathematics and science. He pointed to England's success — the country jumped three places in reading to reach the top 10, four places in maths to 10th place and seven places in science to rank at 8th in the 2025 PISA report — to illustrate a need for various reforms. This includes a focus on phonics, which is a method of teaching reading and writing that uses the sounds of spoken language, changes to the maths curriculum, and reforms to screen time.

"The UK results are impressive. It’s also hard-earned. It’s something almost 20 years in the making," Clare said in a statement.

He said that Australian schools that have been following English methods for a while are showing improvements but he wants a broader roll-out.

"We need to look beyond these rankings, because this data is also showing us a very alarming situation in Australia and many other countries when it comes to how young...
body.zh: 课堂混乱加剧、性别鸿沟、阅读和数学成绩下降——一份主要的全球学生成绩报告显示，澳大利亚学校在关键指标上继续倒退。 每三年，全球国际学生评估计划 (PISA) 都会衡量学生在数学、阅读、科学和计算问题解决方面的素养。 2025 年版本对来自 91 个经合组织国家和经济体的 15 岁青少年进行了测试，还衡量了性别鸿沟的影响、高低社会经济地位之间的差异以及技术和课堂干扰的影响。 在周二发布的最新报告中，澳大利亚的成绩持续20年来的下降，其中数学和阅读成绩处于澳大利亚自2000年开始测试以来的最低水平。 但芬兰教育专家、作家兼墨尔本大学教授帕西·萨尔伯格表示，关注澳大利亚学校系统问题的报告忽视了全局。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 萨尔伯格对 SBS 新闻表示：“头条新闻是我们的业绩创下历史新低。我认为我们的主流媒体这么说绝对令人惊讶。事实是，经合组织中的每个国家在所有方面的业绩都创下历史新低。很少有国家能够在 2025 年改善其业绩。” 在全球排名中，澳大利亚在阅读方面上升一位至第 11 位，在数学方面保持第 17 位，在科学方面下降一位至第 11 位。在 2025 年推出的计算问题解决类别中，澳大利亚在全球排名第八。澳大利亚在所有四项关键测试中的得分均远高于经合组织的平均水平。 周三，根据结果，联邦教育部长贾森·克莱尔宣布了阅读、数学和科学方面的新改革。他指出英国的成功——在 2025 年 PISA 报告中，该国在阅读方面跃升了 3 位，进入前 10 名；在数学方面跃升了 4 位，跃居第 10 位；在科学方面跃升了 7 位，跃居第 8 位——以说明进行各种改革的必要性。其中包括对自然拼读法（一种利用口语发音进行阅读和写作教学的方法）的关注、数学课程的改变以及放映时间的改革。 “英国的成绩令人印象深刻。这也是来之不易的。这是近 20 年来的成果，”克莱尔在一份声明中说。 他说，一段时间以来一直遵循英语教学法的澳大利亚学校正在取得进步，但他希望更广泛地推广。 “我们需要超越这些排名，因为这些数据还向我们展示了澳大利亚和许多其他国家的年轻人的情况非常令人震惊......

reflection.en: The PISA report indicates a concerning trend in Australian education, with declining scores in mathematics, reading, and science. This decline underscores the critical importance of how we shape and train the next generation, as Proverbs 22:6 advises, 'Train up a child in the way he should go; even when he is old he will not depart from it.' Investing in...
reflection.zh: PISA报告显示澳大利亚的教育趋势令人担忧，数学、阅读和科学成绩都在下滑。这一滑坡凸显了我们如何塑造和训练下一代至关重要，正如箴言22:6所建议的：“教养孩童，使他走当行的道，就是到老他也不偏离。” 投资于有效的教育方法，对于年轻人的未来福祉和国家至关重要。

verse.textEn: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.
verse.textZh: 教养孩童，使他走当行的道，就是到老他也不偏离。

title.en: China: English to be removed as a graded core subject?
title.zh: 中国：英语将不再是评分的核心科目？

summary.en: A university professor is advocating for English to be removed as a graded core subject in Chinese schools. Critics contend that in our interconnected world, English proficiency is advantageous for both national development and individual careers.
summary.zh: 一位大学教授呼吁在中国学校取消将英语作为评分的核心科目。批评者认为，在全球化的世界中，掌握英语对国家发展和个人职业生涯都有益。

body.en:
A university professor is calling for English to no longer be taught as a graded core subject in Chinese schools. Opponents argue that, in a globalized world, knowing English is beneficial for the country and career.

From business and academia to social media and entertainment — English is considered the dominant global language. One in five people on Earth actively uses this lingua franca. In China , a mathematics professor specializing in vector algebra is now challenging this dominance in no uncertain terms. Tang Jiafeng believes that English should be abolished as a core subject in elementary schools, secondary schools and universities.

Tang is convinced that no other country in the world has placed as much importance on English as China has.

"Our children desperately begin learning English even before they have properly mastered their native language. Yet we are a civilization that dates back thousands of years. English is just a tool. It's enough to be able to use it. The tradition of revering and emulating Western cultures must come to an end," Tang says in social media.

English is considered difficult in China, since the Chinese language does not use an alphabetic script. It is a required subject starting in third grade. It is graded on par with Chinese and mathematics on the entrance exam for secondary schools, the central exam after 9th grade, and the high school graduation exam. A maximum of 150 points can be earned on the latter.

"How many resources and how much time do our children, parents and schools invest in a subject that is completely irrelevant to the majority of people in their future professional lives?" the mathematician asks, explaining his position.

He became well-known because many of his students achieved full scores on state math exams; in the class of 2011, six students from a single class did so.

"Why cram for English when artificial intelligence can translate everything in seconds?" comments a user from Beijing.

Another suggestion from the southern province of Guangdong is to at least adjust the scoring — for example, to 120 points instead of 150 on the high school graduation exam.

Many parents invest in private tutoring that focuses specifically on exam questions. In addition, all bachelor's students must pass the English exam before being admitted to master's programs. Tang suspects that this could cause many young talents in the natural sciences to fail, even though they have great potential to become top researchers.

There is no question that English is also important for STEM subjects. Research on future-oriented topics is typically published in English. There are fears circulating online that cutting back on English instruction could lead to a decline in China's competitiveness. A prominent...
body.zh: 一位大学教授呼吁中国学校不再将英语作为分级核心科目来教授。反对者认为，在全球化的世界中，懂英语对国家和职业都有好处。 从商业和学术界到社交媒体和娱乐——英语被认为是全球主导语言。地球上五分之一的人积极使用这种通用语言。在中国，一位专门研究向量代数的数学教授现在正在毫不含糊地挑战这一主导地位。唐家峰认为，应该取消英语作为小学、中学和大学的核心科目。 唐坚信，世界上没有哪个国家像中国一样重视英语。 唐在社交媒体上表示：“我们的孩子在还没有真正掌握母语之前就拼命地开始学习英语。但我们是一个有着数千年历史的文明。英语只是一种工具，能够使用它就足够了。尊重和效仿西方文化的传统必须结束。” 英语在中国被认为很难，因为中文不使用字母文字。这是从三年级开始的必修科目。中学入学考试、九年级后的集中考试和高中毕业考试的成绩与语文和数学同等。后者最多可获得 150 点积分。 “我们的孩子、家长和学校在一个与大多数人未来职业生涯完全无关的主题上投入了多少资源和时间？”数学家问道，并解释了他的立场。 他之所以出名，是因为他的许多学生在州数学考试中取得了满分。 2011届的一个班有六名学生这样做了。 “当人工智能可以在几秒钟内翻译所有内容时，为什么还要死记硬背英语呢？”北京网友评论。 来自南方省份广东省的另一项建议是至少调整分数——例如，高中毕业考试的分数从150分调整为120分。 许多家长投资专门针对考试问题的私人辅导。此外，所有学士学生必须通过英语考试才能进入硕士课程。唐怀疑这可能会导致许多自然科学领域的年轻人才失败，尽管他们有成为顶尖研究人员的巨大潜力。 毫无疑问，英语对于 STEM 科目也很重要。面向未来的主题的研究通常以英文发表。网上流传着这样的担忧：削减英语教学可能会导致中国竞争力下降。一位杰出的...

reflection.en: This debate over English in Chinese education touches on what knowledge is most essential. While practical skills are important, the ancient wisdom of Proverbs reminds us that the foundation of all true learning is a reverence for the divine. This perspective calls us to consider the ultimate purpose behind our educational choices.
reflection.zh: 关于中国英语教育的这场辩论触及了什么知识最为重要的问题。虽然实用技能很重要，但古老的箴言提醒我们，所有真正学习的基础是对雅伟的敬畏。这一观点促使我们思考教育选择的最终目的。

verse.textEn: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and instruction.
verse.textZh: 敬畏雅伟是知识的开端；愚妄人藐视智慧和训诲。

title.en: Trump gave $45,000 cash gifts to Natalie Harp and two other aides, public records show
title.zh: 特朗普向哈珀和其他两名助手赠送45,000美元现金礼物，公开记录显示

summary.en: President Donald Trump gave sizable cash gifts to four White House staffers, including $45,000 (£33,000) to his close aide Natalie Harp, financial disclosures released by his administration show. Two staff members received the same amount as Harp, while his longtime aide Walt Nauta received $22,000. The White House...
summary.zh: 根据其政府公布的财务披露，特朗普总统向四名白宫工作人员赠送了丰厚的现金礼物，其中包括给他的亲密助手娜塔莉·哈珀的45,000美元（33,000英镑）。另外两名工作人员收到的金额与哈珀相同，而他长期担任助手兼椭圆形办公室运营主管的沃尔特·诺塔则收到了22,000美元。白宫将这些礼物描述为个人性质且合法。

body.en:
President Donald Trump gave sizable cash gifts to four White House staffers, including $45,000 (£33,000) to his close aide Natalie Harp, financial disclosures released by his administration show.

Two staff members got the same amount as Harp, while his longtime aide and director of Oval Office Operations, Walt Nauta, received $22,000.

No other White House staffer has declared any gifts from the president, the documents show. Federal employees are prohibited from receiving outside compensation for their duties.

The White House has described the gifts as personal in nature, unrelated to the staffers' work and legal under US law.

In a statement provided to the BBC, a White House official said that the president "has a longstanding practice of giving Christmas gifts to people in his orbit, including at times employees and aides, both in government and in his time in the private sector".

"The gifts at issue here have nothing to do with any of these individuals' official government duties, and are entirely permissible under relevant legal and ethical standards," the official added.

The cash gifts, totalling $157,000, are marked as a "cash gift for the holidays" for Nauta, Harp and two other officials: communications advisor Margo Martin and Chamberlain Harris, a White House aide who serves as Trump's executive assistant.

The White House did not answer a separate query from the BBC on why the other 91 listed staff members - including other top aides and First Lady Melania Trump's top advisors - did not receive gifts.

The four recipients of the cash gifts are among those widely considered as close to the US president.

Harp, 35, is among Trump's longest-serving and most loyal aides. She is often trusted with typing out his frequent Truth Social posts, among other responsibilities.

Last month, she was thrust into the national spotlight after she was named as one of a small number of people who stayed with Trump as he secretly swapped planes leaving Turkey last month.

Nauta, a US Navy veteran, has also long been at Trump's side. He served as a White House military valet to the president in his first term, and later joined him as an assistant at his Mar-a-Lago estate in Florida after he left office.

In June 2023, he was indicted alongside Trump on charges that he mishandled national security documents. The case was ultimately dismissed.

The third recipient, Margo Martin, is well known for documenting Trump's activities on social media.

While the final recipient, 26-year-old Chamberlain Harris, officially serves as the president's executive assistant. In February, she was also appointed to the US Commission of Fine Arts which oversees the construction of the White House ballroom and other Trump-directed projects in Washington.

Cassandra Burke...
body.zh: 特朗普政府公布的财务披露显示，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普向四名白宫工作人员赠送了大笔现金礼物，其中包括送给他的亲密助手娜塔莉·哈普的 45,000 美元（33,000 英镑）。 两名工作人员获得了与 Harp 相同的金额，而他的长期助手兼椭圆形办公室运营总监 Walt Nauta 获得了 22,000 美元。 文件显示，没有其他白宫工作人员申报过来自总统的任何礼物。禁止联邦雇员因其职责而接受外部报酬。 白宫称这些礼物属于个人性质，与工作人员的工作无关，并且根据美国法律是合法的。 在向英国广播公司提供的一份声明中，一名白宫官员表示，总统“长期以来一直向他身边的人赠送圣诞礼物，有时包括政府部门和私营部门的雇员和助手”。 这位官员补充说：“这里所涉及的礼物与这些人的任何官方政府职责无关，并且在相关法律和道德标准下是完全允许的。” 这些现金礼物总计 157,000 美元，被标记为送给诺塔、哈普和另外两名官员的“节日现金礼物”：通讯顾问玛戈·马丁和担任特朗普行政助理的白宫助手张伯伦·哈里斯。 白宫没有回答 BBC 的另一项询问，即为什么其他 91 名名单上的工作人员——包括其他高级助手和第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普的高级顾问——没有收到礼物。 现金礼物的四位接受者被广泛认为与美国总统关系密切。 35 岁的哈普是特朗普任职时间最长、最忠诚的助手之一。她经常被信任负责打印他经常发布的真相社会帖子，以及其他职责。 上个月，当特朗普上个月秘密换乘飞机离开土耳其时，她被列为少数留下来的人之一，她因此成为全国关注的焦点。 诺塔是美国海军退伍军人，也长期站在特朗普一边。他在第一个任期内担任总统的白宫贴身侍卫，后来在总统离任后，在他位于佛罗里达州的海湖庄园担任助理。 2023 年 6 月，他与特朗普一起被起诉，罪名是不当处理国家安全文件。该案最终被驳回。 第三位获奖者玛戈·马丁(Margo Martin)因记录特朗普在社交媒体上的活动而闻名。 而最后一位获奖者、26岁的张伯伦·哈里斯则正式担任总统的行政助理。今年二月，她还被任命为美国美术委员会成员，负责监督白宫宴会厅和特朗普在华盛顿指导的其他项目的建设。 卡桑德拉·伯克...

reflection.en: The news that President Trump gave substantial cash gifts to aides, totaling tens of thousands of dollars, prompts reflection on the ethical standards expected of public servants. Micah 6:8 reminds us that true service involves acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with Yahweh, principles that should guide all who hold positions of influence....
reflection.zh: 特朗普总统向助手赠送数万美元现金礼物的消息，促使人们反思公职人员应有的道德标准。弥迦书6:8提醒我们，真正的侍奉在于行公义、好怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行，这些原则应指导所有身居要职的人。这些礼物虽然被描述为个人性质，但却引发了对资源恰当使用以及政府中潜在的不当行为的审视。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Germany's connection to the September 11, 2001 attacks
title.zh: 德国与“9·11”袭击事件的联系

summary.en: The 9/11 attacks were partly planned in Hamburg by the so-called Hamburg cell, whose members played key roles in the plot. This event prompted a significant shift in Germany's approach to national security.
summary.zh: “9·11”袭击事件的部分计划是在汉堡通过所谓的“汉堡小组”进行的，其成员在阴谋中扮演了关键角色。这一事件促使德国在国家安全方面采取了重大转变。

body.en:
The 9/11 attacks were partly planned in Hamburg, via the so-called Hamburg cell, whose members played key roles in the plot. A look back at a day that shook up Germany’s approach to national security.

"This day has changed the world," German President Johannes Rau said. He had watched in shock as the burning Twin Towers of the World Trade Center collapsed in New York.

Nearly 3,000 people were killed on September 11, 2001, when Islamist terrorists hijacked four passenger planes and turned them into deadly weapons.

Germany’s head of state struggled to find the right words: "We do not know what political or social consequences what happened today will have — what we have watched unfold on our television screens in shock, barely able to comprehend or even reflect on it."

It soon emerged that the victims include people from 92 countries, among them 11 Germans.

The following day, a rapidly spreading rumor was confirmed: Three of the four suspected hijackers had recently lived in Hamburg. The Islamist terrorists were thought to have been led by Egyptian-born Mohammed Atta, who had come to the northern German city in the early 1990s to study.

At some point, the young man became radicalized, particularly at Hamburg's Al-Quds Mosque, which was later closed by German security authorities. He spent the final three years of his life in an apartment shared with two other suspected attackers in the Harburg district.

The so-called Hamburg terrorist cell was believed to have included six men, among them Moroccan national Mounir al-Motassadeq. He was charged as an accomplice in the world's first trial related to the September 11, 2001, attacks . In 2003, the Hanseatic Higher Regional Court sentenced him to the maximum 15-year prison term for aiding and abetting thousands of murders and for membership in a terrorist organization.

After serving his sentence, al-Motassadeq was deported to his native Morocco. Another suspected attacker from the circle around pilot Mohammed Atta was Ramzi Binalshibh, who was born in Yemen and had been held without trial at the US detention facility at Guantanamo Bay since 2006.

The United States detained hundreds of suspects at the prison, which human rights groups and international bodies have described as contrary to international law. Among them was Murat Kurnaz , who was born in Bremen. He was released in August 2006 after nearly five years without evidence establishing his involvement in the terrorist attacks.

Kurnaz later recounted his experience in a book that was adapted into a film in 2013 .

Meanwhile, investigative committees in the German Bundestag sought to determine why Kurnaz and other suspects had wrongly come under the scrutiny of American and German intelligence...
body.zh: 9/11 袭击的部分计划是在汉堡通过所谓的汉堡小组策划的，该小组的成员在该阴谋中发挥了关键作用。回顾改变德国国家安全方针的一天。 “这一天改变了世界，”德国总统约翰内斯·劳说道。他震惊地看着纽约世贸中心双子塔燃烧着倒塌。 2001 年 9 月 11 日，伊斯兰恐怖分子劫持了四架客机并将其变成致命武器，造成近 3,000 人死亡。 德国国家元首努力寻找合适的措辞：“我们不知道今天发生的事情会产生什么政治或社会后果——我们震惊地看到电视屏幕上发生的事情，几乎无法理解，甚至无法反思。” 很快就有消息称，遇难者包括来自 92 个国家的人，其中包括 11 名德国人。 第二天，一个迅速传播的谣言得到证实：四名劫机嫌疑人中的三人最近住在汉堡。伊斯兰恐怖分子被认为是由埃及出生的穆罕默德·阿塔领导的，他于 20 世纪 90 年代初来到这座德国北部城市学习。 在某个时候，这位年轻人变得激进，特别是在汉堡的圣城清真寺，该清真寺后来被德国安全当局关闭。他在哈尔堡区与另外两名袭击嫌疑人合住的公寓里度过了生命的最后三年。 据信，所谓的汉堡恐怖分子组织包括六名男子，其中包括摩洛哥国民穆尼尔·莫塔萨德克(Mounir al-Motassadeq)。在世界上首例与 2001 年 9 月 11 日袭击有关的审判中，他被指控为共犯。 2003年，汉萨地区高等法院以协助和教唆数千起谋杀案以及恐怖组织成员身份判处他最高15年的监禁。 刑满释放后，穆塔萨德被驱逐回祖国摩洛哥。飞行员穆罕默德·阿塔周围的另一名疑似袭击者是拉姆齐·比纳尔什布 (Ramzi Binalshibh)，他出生于也门，自 2006 年以来未经审判就被关押在美国关塔那摩湾拘留所。 美国在该监狱拘留了数百名嫌疑人，人权组织和国际机构称此举违反了国际法。其中包括出生于不莱梅的穆拉特·库尔纳兹 (Murat Kurnaz)。近五年来，没有证据证明他参与了恐怖袭击，他于 2006 年 8 月被释放。 库尔纳兹后来在一本书中讲述了他的经历，该书于2013年被改编成电影。 与此同时，德国联邦议院的调查委员会试图确定为什么库尔纳兹和其他嫌疑人错误地接受了美国和德国情报部门的审查……

reflection.en: The 9/11 attacks, with roots in Hamburg, serve as a stark reminder of how acts of terror can reshape a nation's security posture and global outlook. The challenge remains to respond to such evil not with mirroring violence, but with a commitment to justice and peace, embodying the principle of overcoming evil with good.
reflection.zh: “9·11”袭击事件，其根源可追溯至汉堡，是恐怖行为如何重塑国家安全态势和全球视野的严峻警示。挑战依然在于，我们如何不以同等的暴力回应邪恶，而是以对公正与和平的承诺来克服邪恶，践行以善胜恶的原则。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Serbia, the conflicted EU candidate
title.zh: 塞尔维亚，这个陷入冲突的欧盟候选国

summary.en: Serbia has officially pursued EU membership for years, but its accession process has stalled significantly. The recent state-supported funeral for convicted war criminal Ratko Mladic in Belgrade has highlighted the deep disconnect between Serbia's actions and European values, raising questions about its commitment to...
summary.zh: 塞尔维亚多年来正式寻求加入欧盟，但其入盟进程已严重停滞。最近在贝尔格莱德为被判刑的战犯拉特科·姆拉迪奇举行的国家支持的葬礼，凸显了塞尔维亚的行为与欧洲价值观之间的深刻脱节，并对其加入欧盟的承诺及其政治方向提出了质疑。

body.en:
On paper, Belgrade has pursued EU membership for years. But accession has long been stalled. The hero's farewell given to war criminal Mladic exposed just how far Serbia has alienated itself from Europe.

The  state-supported funeral of Ratko Mladic in Belgrade this week has raised a pressing question in Brussels: Can a country seek EU membership while giving a hero's farewell to a convicted war criminal? For many , the event has shown that Serbia's accession process has not merely stalled. It has largely lost its political drive.

"For too long, the EU has kept treating Serbia  as a normal candidate country," Engjellushe Morina of the European Council on Foreign Relations told DW, despite Belgrade's continued backsliding on democracy and the rule of law.

Naim Leo Besiri of Serbia's Institute for European Affairs adds: "The ruling majority in Serbia has not performed anything that was promised on the reform agenda during the last five years."

Both experts point out that Belgrade has refused to join EU sanctions against Russia . Democratic standards have deteriorated under nationalist President Aleksandar Vucic , while relations with Kosovo remain tense.

Despite having been sentenced to life imprisonment by a UN court for genocide, crimes against humanity and war crimes,  Ratko Mladic was buried in Belgrade on Monday with military honors and the participation of government representatives. President Vucic stayed away, but facilitated and defended the public mourning.

Brussels reacted unusually strongly. European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen called the images shocking. European Council President Antonio Costa condemned the glorification of war criminals. Enlargement Commissioner Marta Kos canceled a visit to Serbia.

But both Morina and Besiri say that this is not enough. They believe Vucic has been given too much room to maneuver for too long. In their perception,  he has been treated as an indispensable partner who could secure stability in the Western Balkans and keep Serbia anchored to the West, despite disregarding basic European values.

Besiri says Serbian civil society had warned Brussels for years about attacks on media freedom, the rule of law and democratic institutions. But, he adds, the EU largely turned a blind eye.

Economic relations demonstrate the strong ties between the EU and Serbia. The bloc is Serbia's largest trading partner, investor and financial donor. Politically, however, Serbia has developed a close partnership with Moscow.

A common argument for continuing relations with Serbia is therefore based on the concern that greater pressure could push the country further towards Russia or China.

Morina accepts that isolating Serbia would be dangerous, but sees other options between...
body.zh: 从表面上看，贝尔格莱德多年来一直在寻求加入欧盟。但加入进程却长期停滞不前。这位英雄与战犯姆拉迪奇的告别暴露了塞尔维亚与欧洲的疏远程度。 本周在贝尔格莱德举行的由国家支持的拉特科·姆拉迪奇葬礼在布鲁塞尔引发了一个紧迫的问题：一个国家能否在寻求加入欧盟的同时，向一名被定罪的战犯进行英雄般的告别？对于许多人来说，这一事件表明塞尔维亚的入盟进程不仅停滞不前。它在很大程度上已经失去了政治动力。 欧洲外交关系委员会的莫里纳（Engjellushe Morina）对德国之声表示：“长期以来，欧盟一直将塞尔维亚视为正常的候选国。”尽管贝尔格莱德在民主和法治方面持续倒退。 塞尔维亚欧洲事务研究所的纳伊姆·利奥·贝西里 (Naim Leo Besiri) 补充道：“塞尔维亚的执政多数派在过去五年中没有履行改革议程上的任何承诺。” 两位专家都指出，贝尔格莱德拒绝加入欧盟对俄罗斯的制裁。在民族主义总统亚历山大·武契奇的领导下，民主标准有所恶化，而与科索沃的关系仍然紧张。 尽管拉特科·姆拉迪奇因种族灭绝罪、反人类罪和战争罪被联合国法院判处无期徒刑，但他仍于周一在贝尔格莱德以军事荣誉和政府代表的参与下葬。武契奇总统没有出席，但为公众哀悼提供了便利和辩护。 布鲁塞尔的反应异常强烈。欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩称这些图像令人震惊。欧洲理事会主席安东尼奥·科斯塔谴责美化战犯的行为。扩大事务专员玛尔塔·科斯取消了对塞尔维亚的访问。 但莫里纳和贝西里都表示这还不够。他们认为武契奇长期以来被给予了太多的回旋余地。在他们看来，他被视为不可或缺的合作伙伴，可以确保西巴尔干地区的稳定，并使塞尔维亚锚定在西方，尽管他无视欧洲的基本价值观。 贝西里表示，塞尔维亚民间社会多年来一直就针对媒体自由、法治和民主机构的攻击向布鲁塞尔发出警告。但他补充道，欧盟基本上对此视而不见。 经济关系体现了欧盟与塞尔维亚之间的牢固联系。该集团是塞尔维亚最大的贸易伙伴、投资者和财政捐助者。然而，在政治上，塞尔维亚与莫斯科建立了密切的伙伴关系。 因此，继续与塞尔维亚保持关系的一个常见理由是担心更大的压力可能会促使该国进一步向俄罗斯或中国靠拢。 莫里纳承认孤立塞尔维亚是危险的，但他认为还有其他选择……

reflection.en: The news from Serbia presents a stark image of a nation at a crossroads, its aspirations for European integration complicated by the honoring of a convicted war criminal. This situation raises profound questions about leadership and national identity. When a nation's leaders and public sentiment elevate those who have committed atrocities, it signals a deep...
reflection.zh: 塞尔维亚的新闻描绘了一个处于十字路口国家的鲜明图景，其对欧洲一体化的渴望因对被判刑的战犯的尊崇而变得复杂。这种情况引发了关于领导力和国家认同的深刻问题。当一个国家的领导人和公众舆论推崇犯下暴行的人时，这标志着在追求正义与和平方面存在着深刻的裂痕，阻碍了其迈向更统一、更公正未来的步伐。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

title.en: Iran tightens social control with crackdown on cafes
title.zh: 伊朗因担心助长反政府情绪而加强对咖啡馆的社会管控

summary.en: Iranian authorities have recently intensified their scrutiny of cafes in Tehran, viewing them as potential hubs for fostering anti-government sentiment and facilitating protests. On July 19 alone, at least seven cafes and restaurants were reportedly shut down for non-compliance with mandatory hijab regulations,...
summary.zh: 伊朗当局近期加强了对首都德黑兰咖啡馆的审查，认为它们可能助长反政府情绪并促进抗议活动。据人权组织HRANA称，仅在7月19日，就有至少七家咖啡馆和餐馆因未能遵守强制性头巾规定而被勒令关闭。

body.en:
Authorities are keeping a close eye on cafes, fearing they could play a role in fostering anti-government sentiment.

Iranian authorities have launched a clampdown on cafes in the capital, Tehran, in recent months, suspecting them of fostering anti-government sentiment and facilitating protests.  

According to the human rights organization HRANA, at least seven cafes and restaurants were shut down on July 19 alone for allegedly failing to comply with mandatory hijab rules.

Previously, some media outlets, including Javan , a newspaper affiliated with the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) , have described cafes as "gathering places for protesters" who, in their view, pose a threat to "national security."

Most recently, the "Vanak Park" cafes in Tehran were sealed, resulting in at least 200 people losing their jobs.

Authorities believe cafes, because of their widespread presence and popularity, could play a role in organizing mass protests.

The government's fears are rooted in the latest wave of protests in Iran, which began on December 28, 2025, and grew into the country's largest uprising since the 1979 Islamic Revolution.

Saediniya, a well-known cafe chain with 10 branches in Iran, closed its branches on this day in support of calls for strikes. It was subsequently accused of engaging in "propaganda against the state."

Iran's Supreme Court has now upheld the sentence of Sadegh Saedinia, the owner of the cafe chain, to 12 years and six months in prison, along with the confiscation of his assets.

He was arrested over his support for the protests, and all branches of his cafe chain were confiscated and shut down by judicial order.

Other cafes, including "Lamiz" and "Voria," faced a broadly similar fate. Voria is owned by a prominent Iranian footballer. Both were sealed by judicial order because of their indirect support for calls to protest. Cafe closures have not been confined to periods of protest, however, and the practice continues.

Tehran has seen a surge in the number of cafes over the past decade, rising from around 300 in the early 2010s to as many as 4,000 now, according to various estimates. 

Some experts attribute the growing number to changes in urban lifestyles in recent years. They see this as more than the expansion of a particular type of business and describe it as a sign of wider social and cultural changes within Iranian society.

"The explosive growth of cafes in society can, to some extent, be seen as a social response to living in a state of chronic crisis," Saba Alaleh, a clinical psychologist and psychoanalyst whose work focuses on political and social issues, told DW's Persian service.

"In such circumstances, people are not simply looking to consume or be entertained. They are looking for a...
body.zh: 当局正在密切关注咖啡馆，担心它们可能会助长反政府情绪。 近几个月来，伊朗当局对首都德黑兰的咖啡馆进行了取缔，怀疑它们煽动反政府情绪并为抗议活动提供便利。 据人权组织 HRANA 称，仅 7 月 19 日，就有至少 7 家咖啡馆和餐馆因涉嫌未遵守强制性头巾规定而被关闭。 此前，包括伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）下属报纸《爪哇报》在内的一些媒体将咖啡馆描述为“抗议者的聚集地”，他们认为抗议者对“国家安全”构成威胁。 最近，德黑兰“瓦纳克公园”咖啡馆被查封，导致至少200人失业。 当局认为，咖啡馆因其广泛存在和受欢迎而可以在组织大规模抗议活动中发挥作用。 政府的担忧源于伊朗最近一波抗议活动，该抗议活动始于2025年12月28日，并发展成为该国自1979年伊斯兰革命以来最大规模的起义。 在伊朗拥有10家分店的知名连锁咖啡馆Saediniya在这一天关闭了分店，以支持罢工的呼声。随后它被指控从事“反国家宣传”。 伊朗最高法院现已维持这家咖啡馆连锁店老板 Sadegh Saedinia 的刑期，判处 12 年零 6 个月监禁，并没收其资产。 他因支持抗议活动而被捕，他的咖啡馆连锁店的所有分店都被司法命令没收和关闭。 其他咖啡馆，包括“Lamiz”和“Voria”，也面临着大致相似的命运。 Voria 的所有者是一位著名的伊朗足球运动员。两人均因间接支持抗议呼吁而被司法命令封存。然而，咖啡馆关闭并不局限于抗议时期，而且这种做法仍在继续。 根据各种估计，过去十年德黑兰的咖啡馆数量激增，从 2010 年代初期的约 300 家增加到现在的 4,000 家之多。 一些专家将这一数字的增加归因于近年来城市生活方式的变化。他们认为这不仅仅是特定类型企业的扩张，并将其描述为伊朗社会内部更广泛的社会和文化变革的标志。 专注于政治和社会问题的临床心理学家和精神分析师萨巴·阿拉勒 (Saba Alaleh) 告诉德国之声波斯语频道：“社会上咖啡馆的爆炸式增长在某种程度上可以被视为对长期危机状态的社会反应。” “在这种情况下，人们不仅仅是为了消费或娱乐。他们正在寻找......

reflection.en: In Tehran, cafes are being targeted by authorities, with at least seven shut down for failing to enforce hijab rules. This action highlights a tension between state control and personal expression, raising questions about justice and freedom. The prophet Amos declared, 'Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!' May we...
reflection.zh: 在德黑兰，咖啡馆正成为当局的目标，至少有七家因未能执行头巾规定而被关闭。这一行动凸显了国家控制与个人表达之间的紧张关系，并引发了对公正和自由的疑问。先知阿摩司曾宣告：“惟愿公平如大水滚滚，公义如江河滔滔！”愿我们祈祷，公正与自由能为所有人民带来繁荣。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: China Desk
title.zh: 中国观察

strap.en: Policy signals, social change, and national developments inside China.
strap.zh: 聚焦中国内部政策走向、社会变化与国家动态。

title.en: China: English to be removed as a graded core subject?
title.zh: 中国：英语将不再是评分的核心科目？

summary.en: A university professor is calling for English to no longer be taught as a graded core subject in Chinese schools. Opponents argue that, in a globalized world, knowing English is beneficial for the country and career.
summary.zh: 一位大学教授呼吁在中国学校不再将英语作为评分的核心科目。反对者认为，在全球化的世界中，掌握英语对国家和个人职业发展都有益。

body.en:
A university professor is calling for English to no longer be taught as a graded core subject in Chinese schools. Opponents argue that, in a globalized world, knowing English is beneficial for the country and career.

From business and academia to social media and entertainment — English is considered the dominant global language. One in five people on Earth actively uses this lingua franca. In China , a mathematics professor specializing in vector algebra is now challenging this dominance in no uncertain terms. Tang Jiafeng believes that English should be abolished as a core subject in elementary schools, secondary schools and universities.

Tang is convinced that no other country in the world has placed as much importance on English as China has.

"Our children desperately begin learning English even before they have properly mastered their native language. Yet we are a civilization that dates back thousands of years. English is just a tool. It's enough to be able to use it. The tradition of revering and emulating Western cultures must come to an end," Tang says in social media.

English is considered difficult in China, since the Chinese language does not use an alphabetic script. It is a required subject starting in third grade. It is graded on par with Chinese and mathematics on the entrance exam for secondary schools, the central exam after 9th grade, and the high school graduation exam. A maximum of 150 points can be earned on the latter.

"How many resources and how much time do our children, parents and schools invest in a subject that is completely irrelevant to the majority of people in their future professional lives?" the mathematician asks, explaining his position.

He became well-known because many of his students achieved full scores on state math exams; in the class of 2011, six students from a single class did so.

"Why cram for English when artificial intelligence can translate everything in seconds?" comments a user from Beijing.

Another suggestion from the southern province of Guangdong is to at least adjust the scoring — for example, to 120 points instead of 150 on the high school graduation exam.

Many parents invest in private tutoring that focuses specifically on exam questions. In addition, all bachelor's students must pass the English exam before being admitted to master's programs. Tang suspects that this could cause many young talents in the natural sciences to fail, even though they have great potential to become top researchers.

There is no question that English is also important for STEM subjects. Research on future-oriented topics is typically published in English. There are fears circulating online that cutting back on English instruction could lead to a decline in China's competitiveness. A prominent...
body.zh: 一位大学教授呼吁中国学校不再将英语作为分级核心科目来教授。反对者认为，在全球化的世界中，懂英语对国家和职业都有好处。 从商业和学术界到社交媒体和娱乐——英语被认为是全球主导语言。地球上五分之一的人积极使用这种通用语言。在中国，一位专门研究向量代数的数学教授现在正在毫不含糊地挑战这一主导地位。唐家峰认为，应该取消英语作为小学、中学和大学的核心科目。 唐坚信，世界上没有哪个国家像中国一样重视英语。 唐在社交媒体上表示：“我们的孩子在还没有真正掌握母语之前就拼命地开始学习英语。但我们是一个有着数千年历史的文明。英语只是一种工具，能够使用它就足够了。尊重和效仿西方文化的传统必须结束。” 英语在中国被认为很难，因为中文不使用字母文字。这是从三年级开始的必修科目。中学入学考试、九年级后的集中考试和高中毕业考试的成绩与语文和数学同等。后者最多可获得 150 点积分。 “我们的孩子、家长和学校在一个与大多数人未来职业生涯完全无关的主题上投入了多少资源和时间？”数学家问道，并解释了他的立场。 他之所以出名，是因为他的许多学生在州数学考试中取得了满分。 2011届的一个班有六名学生这样做了。 “当人工智能可以在几秒钟内翻译所有内容时，为什么还要死记硬背英语呢？”北京网友评论。 来自南方省份广东省的另一项建议是至少调整分数——例如，高中毕业考试的分数从150分调整为120分。 许多家长投资专门针对考试问题的私人辅导。此外，所有学士学生必须通过英语考试才能进入硕士课程。唐怀疑这可能会导致许多自然科学领域的年轻人才失败，尽管他们有成为顶尖研究人员的巨大潜力。 毫无疑问，英语对于 STEM 科目也很重要。面向未来的主题的研究通常以英文发表。网上流传着这样的担忧：削减英语教学可能会导致中国竞争力下降。一位杰出的...

reflection.en: The debate in China over English as a core subject highlights a tension between national identity and global connection. Proverbs 18:15 reminds us that the pursuit of knowledge is valuable, suggesting that wisdom involves discerning how best to acquire and apply learning in a complex world. Balancing national interests with the benefits of international...
reflection.zh: 中国关于英语作为核心科目的争论，凸显了国家认同与全球联系之间的紧张关系。箴言 18:15 提醒我们，追求知识是有价值的，这表明智慧在于辨别如何在复杂的世界中最好地获取和应用所学知识。平衡国家利益与国际交流的好处，是一项需要深思熟虑的挑战。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: EU unveils ‘buy European’ public procurement rules to counter China
title.zh: 欧盟公布“购买欧洲”公共采购规则以对抗中国

summary.en: European authorities and public bodies will be encouraged to buy more domestic goods and services when spending public money, as part of the EU's latest effort to counter China's economic might. The European Commission has proposed a significant overhaul of EU public procurement rules, aiming to boost European...
summary.zh: 作为欧盟最新对抗中国经济实力的举措的一部分，欧洲当局和公共机构在花费公共资金时将被鼓励购买更多国内商品和服务。欧盟委员会已提议对欧盟公共采购规则进行重大改革，旨在提振欧洲产业。

body.en: Authorities and public bodies to be urged to buy goods and services from Europe, but without binding quotas European authorities will be encouraged to buy more domestic goods and services when they spend public money under the EU latest effort to counter China’s economic might. In a further “Buy European” plan, the European Commission published proposals on Wednesday for a sweeping overhaul of EU public procurement rules. Continue reading...
body.zh: 敦促当局和公共机构从欧洲购买商品和服务，但没有约束性配额。根据欧盟对抗中国经济实力的最新举措，欧洲当局在花费公共资金时将被鼓励购买更多国内商品和服务。在进一步的“购买欧洲”计划中，欧盟委员会周三公布了对欧盟公共采购规则进行全面改革的提案。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Nations often seek to bolster their own economies through trade policies. The EU's new 'Buy European' initiative aims to strengthen domestic industries by directing public spending towards European goods and services. This highlights the complex interplay of national economies and the desire for self-sufficiency, a dynamic that calls for wisdom and fairness...
reflection.zh: 各国常常试图通过贸易政策来支撑本国经济。欧盟新的“购买欧洲”倡议旨在通过将公共支出导向欧洲商品和服务来加强国内产业。这凸显了国家经济之间复杂的相互作用，以及对自给自足的渴望，这种动态呼吁在所有交易中都要有智慧和公平。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: Yuja review – portrait of star pianist who is intellectually curious and deeply musically attuned
title.zh: Yuja乐评——这位求知欲强、音乐造诣深厚的钢琴家画像

summary.en: Musician is also rattled to find her appearance gets far more attention than her playing in this reflective documentary from Lorna Tucker As well as her film about her own difficult teenage years, British director Lorna Tucker is probably best known for her documentaries on famous women with big personalities:...
summary.zh: 在这部由洛娜·塔克执导的反思性纪录片中，音乐家发现自己的外表比演奏更受关注，这让她感到不安。除了她关于自己艰难青少年时期的电影外，英国导演洛娜·塔克可能最出名的是她拍摄的关于个性鲜明的名人的纪录片：薇薇恩·韦斯特伍德（ Westwood: Punk, Icon, Activist ）、凯瑟琳·赫本（ Call Me...

body.en: Musician is also rattled to find her appearance gets far more attention than her playing in this reflective documentary from Lorna Tucker As well as her film about her own difficult teenage years , British director Lorna Tucker is probably best known for her documentaries on famous women with big personalities: Vivienne Westwood ( Westwood: Punk, Icon, Activist ), Katharine Hepburn (Call Me Kate) and Greta Garbo ( Garbo: Where Did You Go? ). Her latest subject, pianist Yuja Wang, is another high-achiever – but not someone with quite the same name recognition unless you’re a devotee of classical music, a field in which she is ranked among the very best alive. Wang certainly has a flamboyant side, expressed in her highly expressive, virtuoso performances and her sartorial style on stage. In fact some shocking pull quotes illustrate how her dress sense has been bizarrely over-examined in the press; she has been likened to a stripper for her outfits, and the New Yorker, of all publications, once described her as “fat” , which hardly seems germane to any discussion of her ability to play Tchaikovsky or Ligeti. But Wang’s biography and the texture of her daily life are very different from that of Tucker’s previous subjects. She was a child prodigy from an artistic Beijing family who came of age just in time to break records for views on YouTube. Sure, her life here looks glamorous in one way, with a lush New York apartment she barely ever sees because she’s constantly on the road. But her life is also one of perpetual practice and striving for perfection, the loneliness of the long-distance soloist. It’s a regimen that leaves almost no time for relationships or family, or even many friendships with peers who understand what she is going through – apart from a few mentors or collaborators such as fellow pianist Emanuel Ax or composer Teddy Abrams, with whom she recently won a Grammy. Still, she comes across as an effervescent character, intellectually curious and deeply attuned to the music she plays. Continue reading...
body.zh: 音乐家还惊讶地发现，在洛娜·塔克 (Lorna Tucker) 的这部反思性纪录片中，她的外表比她的演奏受到更多关注。除了她关于自己艰难的青少年时期的电影外，英国导演洛娜·塔克 (Lorna Tucker) 最出名的可能是她关于具有大个性的著名女性的纪录片：维维安·韦斯特伍德 (维维安·韦斯特伍德) (韦斯特伍德：朋克、偶像、激进分子)、凯瑟琳·赫本 (叫我凯特) 和葛丽泰·嘉宝 (嘉宝：你去哪儿了？)。她最新的对象钢琴家王羽佳是另一位成就斐然的人，但除非你是古典音乐的爱好者，否则她的知名度不会很高，而她在古典音乐领域被列为当今最优秀的音乐爱好者之一。王确实有华丽的一面，这体现在她极具表现力、精湛的表演和舞台上的服装风格上。事实上，一些令人震惊的引述说明了媒体如何奇怪地过度审视了她的着装品味。她因服装而被比作脱衣舞娘，所有出版物中的《纽约客》曾将她描述为“胖子”，这似乎与她扮演柴可夫斯基或利盖蒂的能力的任何讨论都没有关系。但王的传记和她的日常生活质感与塔克之前的主题有很大不同。她是来自北京一个艺术家庭的神童，成年后正好打破了 YouTube 上的观看次数记录。当然，她在这里的生活在某种程度上看起来很迷人，她几乎从未见过纽约的一套豪华公寓，因为她经常在路上。但她的生活也是一种不断练习和追求完美的生活，一种长距离独奏者的孤独。这种生活方式几乎没有时间留给人际关系或家庭，甚至没有时间与理解她正在经历的事情的同龄人建立友谊——除了一些导师或合作者，比如钢琴家伊曼纽尔·阿克斯(Emanuel Ax)或作曲家泰迪·艾布拉姆斯(Teddy Abrams)，她最近与他们一起赢得了格莱美奖。尽管如此，她仍然给人一种热情洋溢的感觉，求知欲强，对她演奏的音乐有着深刻的理解。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary offers a glimpse into the life of pianist Yuja Wang, showcasing her intense dedication and intellectual curiosity in the demanding world of classical music. Her commitment to mastering her art, even when facing external distractions like undue attention to her appearance, speaks to a deep-seated passion for her calling. Colossians 3:23...
reflection.zh: 这部纪录片让我们得以一窥钢琴家王羽佳的生活，展现了她在古典音乐这个要求严苛的领域中，她那份强烈的奉献精神和求知欲。即使面对外表受到不当关注等外部干扰，她仍致力于精进技艺，这体现了她对自己使命的深切热情。 歌罗西书 3:23 提醒我们：“无论做什么，都要从心里去做，像是为主做的，不像为人做的。”...

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Hong Kong's first leader after British handover dies
title.zh: 香港首任特首、英国移交后首位领导人董建华逝世

summary.en: Tung Chee-hwa, the first chief executive of Hong Kong after its handover from British to Chinese rule, has died at the age of 89. His time in office, from 1997 to 2005, was characterized by significant challenges including the Asian Financial Crisis, two epidemics, and major protests.
summary.zh: 香港首任行政长官董建华（在英国将香港移交中国后）于周二晚逝世，享年89岁。他在1997年至2005年任职期间，经历了亚洲金融危机、两次重大疫情以及大规模抗议活动等严峻挑战。

body.en:
Tung Chee-hwa, Hong Kong's first leader after the city returned to Chinese rule, has died at the age of 89.

The former shipping scion took over the reins from the last British Governor Chris Patten in July 1997 when the UK handed Hong Kong back to China , ending more than 150 years of British control.

Tung's rocky tenure was marked by the Asian Financial Crisis, two major epidemics, and historic protests which attracted criticism of his administration. He eventually resigned in 2005.

Tung died on Tuesday night surrounded by loved ones, local media reported. His office described him as a man "devoted to his country and its people".

Born in Shanghai in 1937, Tung graduated with a mechanical engineering degree from Liverpool University in the UK before moving to the US, where he worked at General Electric for almost a decade.

In 1969, he moved to Hong Kong and worked in his father's shipping conglomerate, the Orient Overseas, eventually taking over the reins in 1979.

His political career began in 1992 when he was appointed a member of Patten's executive council.

Despite having little political experience, Tung was believed to be handpicked by Beijing to lead Hong Kong after the handover. He was seen as a loyalist, especially after China's state-run banks helped rescue his family business during a global slump in the mid-1980s.

During a reception at the Great Hall of the People in January 1996, China's then-president Jiang Zemin walked across a packed room to shake Tung's hands – a widely photographed gesture that at the time famously signalled Beijing's backing of Tung for the top job.

The Asian Financial Crisis hit shortly after Tung took over, which sent home prices diving. His administration was also beset by a series of public health challenges, including a bird flu outbreak from 1997 to 2002 and the 2003 outbreak of Sars, also known as Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome.

But Tung's biggest political challenge took place in July 2003 during his second term, when half a million Hongkongers took to the streets to protest against a proposed national security law they feared would threaten their civic rights.

His administration abandoned the proposed legislation following the massive outcry, which also contributed to Tung stepping down in March 2005.

At the time his declining health was cited as a reason - but some said he was pressured by Beijing to step down.

Beijing ultimately imposed a national security law on Hong Kong in 2020, which authorities have argued is necessary to maintain stability. Critics however have called it "the end of Hong Kong" and say it has created a climate of fear in the city.

Tung's last public outing was in July 2021, at an event marking the 100th anniversary of the founding of the Chinese Communist Party. He...
body.zh: 香港回归中国后的首任领导人董建华去世，享年89岁。 1997 年 7 月，英国将香港交还给中国，结束了英国 150 多年的控制，这位前航运业子弟从最后一任英国总督彭定康 (Chris Patten) 手中接过了权力。 亚洲金融危机、两次重大流行病以及引发对其政府批评的历史性抗议活动，标志着董建华的任期充满坎坷。他最终于2005年辞职。 据当地媒体报道，董于周二晚上在亲人的陪伴下去世。他的办公室形容他是一个“献身于他的国家和人民”的人。 董先生 1937 年出生于上海，毕业于英国利物浦大学，获得机械工程学位，随后移居美国，在通用电气工作了近十年。 1969年，他移居香港，在其父亲的航运集团东方海外工作，最终于1979年接手大权。 他的政治生涯始于1992年，当时他被任命为彭定康行政委员会成员。 尽管董建华缺乏政治经验，但据信是北京精心挑选的，在香港回归后领导香港。他被视为忠诚者，特别是在 20 世纪 80 年代中期全球经济衰退期间，中国国有银行帮助拯救了他的家族企业之后。 1996 年 1 月，在人民大会堂举行的招待会上，时任中国国家主席江泽民走过挤满人的房间，与董建华握手，这一举动被广泛拍照，在当时标志着北京支持董建华担任国家主席。 董建华上任后不久，亚洲金融危机袭来，房价暴跌。他的政府还受到一系列公共卫生挑战的困扰，包括1997年至2002年爆发的禽流感和2003年爆发的非典（又称严重急性呼吸系统综合症）。 但董建华最大的政治挑战发生在他的第二个任期内的 2003 年 7 月，当时 50 万香港人走上街头抗议一项拟议的国家安全法，他们担心这会威胁到他们的公民权利。 在遭到强烈抗议后，他的政府放弃了拟议的立法，这也导致董建华于 2005 年 3 月下台。 当时他的健康状况恶化被认为是一个原因，但也有人说他是受到北京方面的压力才下台的。 北京最终于 2020 年对香港实施了国家安全法，当局认为这是维持稳定所必需的。然而，批评者称其为“香港的终结”，并称这在这座城市造成了恐惧气氛。 董建华最后一次公开露面是在 2021 年 7 月的中国共产党成立 100 周年纪念活动上。他...

reflection.en: The news of Tung Chee-hwa's passing invites reflection on leadership and public service. Micah 6:8 calls for acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with God. Leaders, like Tung, face immense pressures and complex decisions, and the measure of their tenure often lies in how they sought to balance these divine imperatives amidst crises.
reflection.zh: 董建华先生的逝世，引人深思领导力与公共服务。弥迦书6章8节呼吁我们行公义、好怜悯、存谦卑的心与雅伟同行。像董先生这样的领导者，在任期内面临巨大的压力和复杂的抉择，他们任职期间的成效，往往体现在如何在危机中努力平衡这些神圣的原则。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: How Mao Zedong's legacy still shapes China 50 years on
title.zh: 毛泽东的遗产如何至今仍在塑造中国

summary.en: Fifty years after Mao Zedong's death, China has undergone significant transformation. However, his legacy persists, influencing current leadership under Xi Jinping and fueling a resurgence of Maoist nostalgia among younger generations.
summary.zh: 毛泽东逝世五十年来，中国发生了翻天覆地的变化。然而，他的遗产依然存在，影响着习近平领导下的当今政权，并在年轻一代中引发了对毛泽东时代的新怀旧潮。

body.zh: 毛泽东逝世50年来，中国发生了翻天覆地的变化。但他的遗产依然存在——从习近平的统治到中国年轻人新一轮的毛泽东怀旧浪潮。 1976年9月9日，毛泽东逝世。 这位领导中国共产党夺取政权、建立中华人民共和国的革命领袖，留下了极其矛盾的历史遗产。 他塑造了革命、国家建设和民族独立的叙事，但也因连续的政治运动和迫害而留下了巨大的社会创伤。 毛泽东去世时，中国仍然是一个贫穷且相对孤立的共产主义国家。如今，它是世界第二大经济体，深深嵌入全球资本主义的供应链和价值链，拥有庞大的私营部门、庞大的城市中产阶级和高度数字化的社会。 巴黎塞尔吉大学教授张伦表示，毛泽东留下了四大政治遗产：专制和高度集权的政治制度；依靠革命和政治运动来解决社会问题的治理模式；以反精英主义和反理性主义为标志的民粹主义倾向；以及平等主义和道德主义的乌托邦愿景。 张向德国之声表示，从政治遗产的角度来看，中国过去50年最根本的变化是“去毛化”，而最大的挑战是这一过程从未完全完成。 毛泽东的名字仍然写进了中国共产党的党章，他的思想仍然是中国官方意识形态的一部分，他的肖像仍然悬挂在北京天安门广场上。 苏黎世大学教授吉恩·克里斯托弗·米特尔施塔特 (Jean Christopher Mittelstaedt) 表示，毛泽东帮助建立了中国共产党，几十年来，他坚持党对国家和社会的至高无上一直是一项基本原则。 资深记者、时事评论员常平对此表示赞同，并补充道，真正经久不衰的是“党领导一切”的制度核心，服务于“集中资源办好大事”的国家愿景。 他说，中共可以“不惜一切代价”追求这些目标——这意味着为了维护政权，可以最大限度地牺牲普通民众的利益。 在现任领导人习近平的领导下，一些与毛泽东时代相关的政治理念和执政方式——例如思想统一和“斗争”精神——再次引起人们的关注。 习近平的行动包括取消国家主席任期限制、加强他的个人权威以及纳入他的政治...

reflection.en: Mao Zedong's death 50 years ago marked a turning point for China, yet his ideological and political shadow continues to shape the nation. This enduring influence, from state narratives to popular nostalgia, speaks to the profound and often complex impact of historical figures. The story prompts reflection on how legacies, whether positive or negative, can...
reflection.zh: 毛泽东逝世五十周年标志着中国的一个转折点，但他的意识形态和政治影响至今仍在塑造着这个国家。这种从国家叙事到大众怀旧的持久影响，体现了历史人物深刻而复杂的作用。这个故事促使我们反思，无论正面还是负面，遗产如何能够持续并塑造现在，并提醒我们，不受约束的权力和野心可能带来长远甚至意想不到的后果。

verse.textEn: Pride goes before destruction, a haughty spirit before a fall.
verse.textZh: 骄傲在败坏以先；狂心在跌倒之前。

title.en: Another Australian found alive nearly two weeks after Nepal-Tibet floods
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪水过后近两周，又一名澳大利亚人被发现生还

summary.en: An Australian citizen, previously unaccounted for after catastrophic flooding in Nepal, has been confirmed safe. This news brings relief to families anxiously awaiting word of their loved ones, though 35 Australians remain missing following the disaster last month which killed at least 1,399 people and left over 5,400...
summary.zh: 一名在尼泊尔失联的澳大利亚公民在灾难性洪水过后已被确认安全。这一消息为焦急等待亲人消息的家庭带来了宽慰，尽管上个月的灾难已造成至少1399人死亡、超过5400人失踪，仍有35名澳大利亚人下落不明。

body.en:
An Australian citizen who was in Nepal has been confirmed safe in the wake of the catastrophic flooding that swept through the region nearly two weeks ago.

The Australian was uncontactable but has today confirmed they are safe and well and do not require consular assistance, SBS News understands.

At least 1,399 people were killed by the 26 August mudslide and flooding in Nepal and Tibet and more than 5,400 are missing, including around 800 foreigners.

A group of Australian families with missing loved ones released a statement on Sunday, calling for greater transparency from tour groups and authorities.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

They expressed gratitude to the Australian Federal Police and search teams working to find missing Australians, but criticised the Australian government for what they said was its failure to provide answers.

The federal government has sent a disaster assistance response team and other specialist resources to Kathmandu to assist with the search.

It has also committed $11 million to support the disaster response, which Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said on Monday was of national importance.

Hundreds of hydropower workers are among the missing, but the rescue of three of them from deep inside tunnels — two Nepalis on Friday and a Chinese man on Saturday — have buoyed hopes that more could still be alive.

At least 11 hydropower projects were engulfed when a glacier collapsed into a river on the Nepal-China border on August 26, burying the entrances to the tunnels of these projects under debris and mud and cutting off those trapped inside.

Authorities said Tuesday that rescuers in Nepal are focusing on three hydropower project tunnels where they believe dozens of workers could be trapped.

"Our search operation is focussed on finding survivors, including in tunnels. Our bigger focus is on the Chilime hydroelectric project, where we believe people are trapped, because there was a canteen, residency and arrangements for food," Dharma Raj Upreti, chief of the country's disaster authority, told Reuters.

Australian tunnel rescue expert Arnold Dix, who is advising Nepali teams, has said the operation presents an unprecedented challenge.

"Not one rescue, but multiple potential rescues, unfolding at the same time, in different places, each with its own dangers, uncertainties, and lives that may still be saved."

body.zh: 近两周前席卷该地区的灾难性洪水后，一名身在尼泊尔的澳大利亚公民已被确认安全。 据 SBS 新闻了解，这名澳大利亚人无法联系上，但今天确认他们安全无恙，不需要领事协助。 8月26日尼泊尔和西藏发生的泥石流和洪水造成至少1,399人死亡，5,400多人失踪，其中包括约800名外国人。 一群失踪亲人的澳大利亚家庭周日发表声明，呼吁旅游团和当局提高透明度。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 他们对澳大利亚联邦警察和寻找失踪澳大利亚人的搜救队表示感谢，但批评澳大利亚政府未能提供答案。 联邦政府已派出救灾响应小组和其他专业资源前往加德满都协助搜寻。 它还承诺提供 1100 万美元来支持救灾，总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞周一表示，这对国家具有重要意义。 数百名水电工人失踪，但其中三人从隧道深处获救——周五是两名尼泊尔人，周六是一名中国男子——这让人们燃起了更多生还的希望。 8月26日，尼泊尔和中国边境的一座冰川崩塌成河，至少11个水电项目被吞没，这些项目的隧道入口被瓦砾和泥土掩埋，并切断了被困人员的通道。 当局周二表示，尼泊尔的救援人员正在重点关注三个水电项目隧道，他们认为那里可能有数十名工人被困。 “我们的搜索行动主要是寻找幸存者，包括在隧道中寻找幸存者。我们更关注的是 Chilime 水力发电项目，我们相信那里有人被困，因为那里有食堂、住所和食物安排，”该国灾害管理局局长 Dharma Raj Upreti 告诉路透社。 为尼泊尔救援队提供咨询的澳大利亚隧道救援专家阿诺德·迪克斯表示，这次行动带来了前所未有的挑战。 “这不是一次救援，而是多次潜在的救援，在不同的时间、不同的地点同时展开，每一次都有自己的危险、不确定性和仍然可以挽救的生命。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: In the midst of devastating floods that claimed many lives and left others missing, the news of a found Australian offers a beacon of hope. This story echoes the Psalmist's declaration that weeping may last for a night, but joy comes in the morning. For the families who feared the worst, this reunion is a profound answer to prayer and a testament to...
reflection.zh: 在夺走许多生命并导致多人失踪的毁灭性洪水灾难中，一名澳大利亚人被找到的消息带来了希望的曙光。这个故事呼应了诗篇作者的宣告：哭泣虽可过夜，但早晨必带来欢欣。对于那些曾恐惧最坏情况的家庭来说，这次重逢是对祷告的深刻回应，也是坚韧不拔的证明。

verse.textEn: Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
verse.textZh: 一宿虽然有哭泣，早晨便必欢呼。

title.en: How the Nepal-Tibet disaster became the latest victim of China’s ‘Clean Internet’ campaign
title.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏灾难如何成为中国“净网”运动的最新牺牲品

summary.en: The online campaign, which used to focus on tackling cybercrime and hacking, has since expanded to suppress information that differs from official narratives. Tsering Phuntsok watched news of the Nepal-Tibet flood unfold from thousands of miles away in southern India. The 46-year-old Tibetan in exile has missing...
summary.zh: 这场网络运动曾专注于打击网络犯罪和黑客攻击，但现已扩大到压制与官方叙述不同的信息。46岁的藏族流亡者丹增·普措（Tsering...

body.en: The online campaign used to focus on tackling cybercrime and hacking but has since expanded to suppress information that differs from official narratives Tsering Phuntsok watched news of the Nepal-Tibet flood unfold from thousands of miles away in southern India. The 46-year-old Tibetan in exile has missing family members on both sides of the border; those in Nepal are named in official government lists, but in Tibet he has received no information. “I have started praying for the lost ones now. I have to accept they will not return [because] … I’m not getting any information.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 这场在线运动过去的重点是打击网络犯罪和黑客攻击，但后来扩大到压制与官方叙述不同的信息。次仁平措在千里之外的印度南部观看了尼泊尔西藏洪水的新闻。 46岁流亡藏人在边境两侧都有家人失踪；尼泊尔的那些人被列入政府官方名单，但在西藏，他没有收到任何信息。 “我现在开始为失踪的人祈祷。我必须接受他们不会回来的事实，[因为]……我没有得到任何信息。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the wake of the Nepal-Tibet disaster, Tsering Phuntsok faces a double tragedy: the potential loss of family members and the silencing of information. His inability to confirm their fate due to China's 'Clean Internet' campaign leaves him in agonizing uncertainty. This situation calls to mind the ancient call to 'speak up for those who cannot speak for...
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔-西藏灾难之后，丹增·普措面临着双重悲剧：可能失去家人以及信息被噤声。由于中国“净网”运动，他无法确认家人的命运，这让他陷入痛苦的不确定之中。这种情况令人想起古老的呼吁：“为那些不能说话的人辩护，为所有贫困者伸张正义”（箴言31:8-9），敦促我们为那些声音被故意压制的人们发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Weather tracker: Typhoon Saudel causes mass evacuations in south-east China
title.zh: 台风“苏德罗”导致中国东南部大规模疏散

summary.en: Typhoon Saudel brought days of torrential rain to south-east China last week, causing widespread damage and forcing mass evacuations. The city of Putian recorded 416.5mm of rain in 24 hours, leading to the evacuation of almost 600,000 people in Fujian province and affecting thousands more in other provinces.
summary.zh: 上周，台风“苏德罗”给中国东南部带来了数日的倾盆大雨，造成大范围破坏并导致大规模疏散。福建省莆田市在24小时内记录到416.5毫米的降雨量，迫使福建省近60万人撤离，另有数千人受到江西等省份的影响。

body.en: Torrential rain causes widespread damage; while north-west South Africa hit by thunderstorms and central-southern US faces oppressive heat Typhoon Saudel brought days of torrential rain to Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Fujian and Guangdong provinces in south-east China last week. The city of Putian, in Fujian province, recorded 416.5mm of rain in a 24-hour period between Thursday and Friday, with surrounding villages recording more than 500mm in the same period. In Fujian, authorities estimate that almost 600,000 people were evacuated from high-risk, flood-prone areas. A further 128,000 people in 53 counties were also affected across Jiangxi, with emergency evacuations affecting 9,000 people. Flooding, landslips and infrastructure damage were reported widely in the region. More than 2,500 teachers and students were trapped in a school compound in the Zhejiang city of Wenzhou on Wednesday after extreme rainfall caused flash floods in low-lying areas. At least 1,260 people reportedly had to be rescued in Putian after a river embankment collapsed on Thursday, flattening 100 homes. On Saturday, a landslip in a village of Suichuan county, in Jiangxi province, killed three people and nine others remaining missing. Continue reading...
body.zh: 暴雨造成大面积破坏；南非西北部遭遇雷暴袭击，美国中南部遭遇酷热，台风“萨德尔”上周给中国东南部的浙江、江西、福建和广东省带来连日暴雨。福建省莆田市周四至周五24小时内降雨量达416.5毫米，周边村庄同期降雨量超过500毫米。在福建，当局估计近 60 万人从高风险、洪水易发地区撤离。江西53个县12.8万人受灾，紧急疏散9000人。据报道，该地区发生了洪水、山体滑坡和基础设施损坏。周三，极端降雨导致低洼地区山洪暴发，2500多名师生被困在浙江温州一所学校大院内。据报道，莆田市周四河堤崩塌，夷为平地，至少有 1,260 人需要救援。周六，江西省遂川县一个村庄发生山体滑坡，造成三人死亡，另有九人失踪。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Typhoon Saudel's torrential rains and subsequent evacuations in China underscore the harsh realities of natural disasters. In times of devastation, the human spirit is tested, yet the biblical narrative offers a path through suffering. Romans 5:3-4 reminds us that hardship can produce perseverance, character, and hope, even amidst overwhelming loss.
reflection.zh: 台风“苏德罗”带来的倾盆大雨和中国随后的大规模疏散，凸显了自然灾害的严酷现实。在毁灭性的灾难面前，人类的精神受到考验，但圣经的叙事提供了一条穿越苦难的道路。罗马书5:3-4提醒我们，即使在巨大的损失中，艰难困苦也能磨炼出忍耐、品格和盼望。

verse.textEn: We also glory in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance; perseverance, character; and character, hope.
verse.textZh: 就是在患难中也是欢欢喜喜的；因为知道患难生忍耐，忍耐生老练，老练生盼望。

title.en: The US now has access to more than half Australia’s military bases – could it drag the country unwillingly into war?
title.zh: 美国现在可以进入澳大利亚一半以上的军事基地——这是否可能将该国不情愿地拖入战争？

summary.en: Exclusive reports reveal that US-controlled weapons corporations and forces have control or access to over 100 facilities across Australia. Some analysts liken this extensive presence to a 'colonisation' of Australia's military capabilities, with new data mapping the significant US militarisation on Australian soil.
summary.zh: 独家报道披露，美国控制的武器公司和部队在澳大利亚拥有超过100个设施的控制权或使用权。一些分析人士将这种广泛的存在比作对澳大利亚军事力量的“殖民化”，新的数据显示了澳大利亚本土美国军事化的程度。

body.en: Exclusive: US-controlled weapons corporations and forces have control or access to more than 100 facilities across the continent, which some analysts describe as a ‘colonisation’ of Australia’s military. Find a map of them here US military presence in Australia, mapped – video Why can the US access so many Australian military bases? – podcast US military interests control or have access to more than 100 defence facilities on Australian soil, in what some analysts describe as a “saturation” – even a “colonisation” – of the Australian continent. New data compiled by the Nautilus Institute and published by Guardian Australia maps the extent of US militarisation. The US military controls 17 facilities on mainland Australia and has access to 75 more Australian-run military installations. US defence corporations have access to an additional 18. Gathering intelligence, accessing satellite data for targeting information and communications intercepts. Training, including for 2,500 marines on dry-season rotation in the Northern Territory. Pre-positioning warfighting assets such as Osprey aircraft. Logistics hubs holding weapons, munitions and fuel, stored in case of a war in the Pacific. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家：美国控制的武器公司和部队控制或进入了整个非洲大陆的 100 多个设施，一些分析人士将其描述为澳大利亚军队的“殖民化”。在这里找到它们的地图 美国在澳大利亚的军事存在，已绘制 - 视频 为什么美国可以进入如此多的澳大利亚军事基地？ – 播客 美国军事利益集团控制或有权使用澳大利亚领土上的 100 多个防御设施，一些分析人士将其描述为澳大利亚大陆的“饱和”，甚至是“殖民化”。鹦鹉螺研究所编制并由澳大利亚卫报发布的新数据绘制了美国军事化的程度。美国军方控制着澳大利亚大陆的 17 个设施，并有权使用另外 75 个澳大利亚管理的军事设施。美国国防公司可以使用额外的 18 个卫星数据来收集情报、访问卫星数据以进行目标信息和通信拦截。训练，包括为 2,500 名海军陆战队员在北领地进行旱季轮换训练。预先部署鱼鹰飞机等作战资产。储存武器、弹药和燃料的后勤中心，以防太平洋发生战争。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The extensive US military presence across Australia, with access to over 100 facilities, raises profound questions about national sovereignty and the potential for entanglement in distant conflicts. Isaiah's vision of nations beating swords into plowshares offers a counterpoint, a hope for a world where military might is transformed into instruments of...
reflection.zh: 美国在澳大利亚广泛的军事存在，拥有超过100个设施的使用权，引发了关于国家主权和卷入遥远冲突的潜在问题的深刻疑问。以赛亚关于列国将刀打成犁头的异象提供了一个对照，一个关于军事力量被转化为和平与生产力工具的世界的希望。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: EU faces 300,000 factory job cuts as China ‘colonises’ supply chains, industry warns
title.zh: 欧盟面临30万个工厂工作岗位流失，行业警告中国“殖民”供应链

summary.en: An industry trade body has warned that job losses in EU manufacturing will increase significantly unless Brussels addresses the "colonisation" of industry by Chinese component manufacturers. Eurometal forecasts 300,000 manufacturing job losses by the end of 2026 due to escalating competition from China, which...
summary.zh: 一家行业贸易机构警告称，除非布鲁塞尔解决中国零部件制造商对工业的“殖民”问题，否则欧盟制造业的失业人数将急剧增加。欧洲金属公司预测，到2026年底，由于来自中国的竞争加剧，制造业将损失30万个工作岗位，而中国目前与欧盟的贸易顺差已达到创纪录的每日10亿欧元。

body.en: Protest using 10 coffins to symbolise struggling manufacturing industry to take place in Brussels Job losses in EU manufacturing will rapidly increase unless Brussels stops the “colonisation” of industry by Chinese component manufacturers, a leading industry trade body has warned. Eurometal predicts 300,000 job losses in manufacturing in the rest of 2026 because of expanding competition from China, which is now enjoying a record €1bn-a-day trade surplus with the bloc. Continue reading...
body.zh: 一家领先的行业贸易机构警告说，除非布鲁塞尔停止中国零部件制造商对工业的“殖民化”，否则布鲁塞尔将举行用十具棺材象征陷入困境的制造业的抗议活动，否则欧盟制造业的失业人数将迅速增加。欧洲金属网预计，由于来自中国的竞争不断加剧，2026 年剩余时间制造业将有 30 万个就业岗位流失，而中国目前与欧盟的贸易顺差每天达到创纪录的 10 亿欧元。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The warning of 300,000 job losses in the EU manufacturing sector due to intense competition from China raises profound questions about economic justice and fairness. The prophet Amos declared, "Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!" This call for justice echoes in the concerns of workers facing displacement and...
reflection.zh: 由于来自中国的激烈竞争，欧盟制造业可能损失30万个工作岗位的警告，引发了关于经济公正和公平的深刻问题。先知阿摩司曾宣告：“惟愿公平如大水滚滚，公义如江河滔滔！”（阿摩司书5:24）这种对公正的呼唤，在面对失业和经济困境的工人们的担忧中得到了回响。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: Australia Desk
title.zh: 澳洲栏目

strap.en: Public life, policy, and community stories shaping Australia now.
strap.zh: 关注正在影响澳洲公共生活、政策与社区的新闻。

title.en: Australia politics live: Coalition rejects Labor’s ‘unacceptable’ plan to regulate harmful content on social media
title.zh: 马利纳斯警告阿尔巴尼斯不要追随一国党走上削减移民的歧途

summary.en: South Australian Premier Peter Malinauskas has warned Prime Minister Anthony Albanese against adopting the One Nation party's stance on cutting migration, arguing that Australia faces a housing crisis, not a migration crisis. He suggests that focusing on bringing in skilled workers for the construction industry is a...
summary.zh: 南澳大利亚州州长彼得·马利纳斯警告总理安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯，不要采纳一国党削减移民的立场，认为澳大利亚面临的是住房危机，而非移民危机。他建议，将重点放在引进建筑行业的熟练工人，是解决住房短缺问题的更有效途径。

body.en: Follow the day’s news live Labor introducing new laws to crack down on illegal tobacco Labor will introduce new laws to make it easier to prosecute criminals involved in the illicit tobacco trade, as the government fights an uphill battle against the exploding black market. The new laws think about it as a list of observable indicators, very simple, fact-based things like: is the tobacco appropriately packaged? Is it a menthol cigarette even hiding in plain packaging? Is it being concealed? Does it have paperwork at the border? Or my personal favourite: is the retail price of this packet of cigarettes less than the amount of excise and GST combined? If any of these facts are proven, just one of them, that establishes the reasonable suspicion of the criminal offence of importing, possession, or conveying. It’ll give powerful new tools to Border Force but every state and territory police force to go after the crooks. I said, look, my door’s open if you want to talk about this. I don’t know why he thinks I’m a liar. I don’t quite know why he believes I lied about it. I’m disappointed he thinks I’m a coward. I don’t know how he came to that opinion but that’s up to him. I don’t think he’s a traitor. I absolutely respect the services given to our nation, like my family, has given to the service of New Zealand and Australia. Democracy’s a robust thing. Continue reading...
body.zh: 关注当天的新闻直播 “我们需要解释澳大利亚没有移民危机”：马利瑙卡斯 Peter Malinaukas 表示，他理解澳大利亚人对澳大利亚移民和住房短缺的担忧，但答案是政客们需要解释正在发生的是住房危机，而不是移民危机。我们需要解释一下，澳大利亚真正面临的不是移民危机，而是住房危机。如果我们遇到住房危机，我们最好将技能政策的重点放在确保引进住房建筑行业所需的工人上。你知道，澳大利亚几乎所有行业都严重短缺。我认为每个人都承认这需要一个经过良好校准、平衡的移民计划。我的观点是，过去几年我们在这个国家的政治话语中没有看到太多支持移民的证据。只是看到许多针对移民的文化战争正在发生。我认为这是弄巧成拙的，我们有责任站起来反对它。最重要的是，[我们必须]保留我们强有力的移民计划……对反移民政治和民粹主义者的正确政治反应不是绥靖政策。更令人不安的是，主流政治可能会进入一场政治竞赛，看看谁能最大程度地减少移民数量。这并不不幸——这是疯狂。想象一下，如果我们对采矿业这样做，世界上每个电视台和手机上都会有一个广告，讲述我们如何杀鸡取卵。这太疯狂了。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The debate over migration in Australia highlights a tension between perceived crises and underlying realities. Premier Malinauskas urges a focus on the housing shortage, suggesting that skilled migration could be part of the solution rather than the problem. This calls for national discernment, seeking policies that build up rather than tear down, and...
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚关于移民的争论凸显了人们感知的危机与实际现实之间的紧张关系。州长马利纳斯敦促将重点放在住房短缺问题上，并认为技术移民可以成为解决方案的一部分，而不是问题本身。这需要国家具备辨别力，寻求能够建设而非破坏的政策，并以诚信的态度解决根本原因。

verse.textEn: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin condemns any people.
verse.textZh: 公义使邦国高举；罪恶是人民的羞辱。

title.en: Instagram boss says users will be ‘overwhelmed’ with brand content in algorithm-free world
title.zh: Instagram 负责人表示，在无算法的世界里，用户将充斥品牌内容

summary.en: Instagram's CEO, Adam Mosseri, has stated that a world without algorithms would lead to a worse user experience, with more brand content and less time spent on the app. This comes as the Australian government plans to introduce legislation requiring social media platforms to offer users a choice between algorithmic...
summary.zh: Instagram 的首席执行官 Adam Mosseri 表示，一个没有算法的世界将导致用户体验变差，看到更多品牌内容，并在应用上花费更少时间。此前，澳大利亚政府正计划立法，要求社交媒体平台向用户提供算法推荐和按时间倒序排列的两种信息流选择。

body.en: Adam Mosseri says platform’s algorithm ‘feels like a black box’ but company trying to give users more control after Labor announces opt-out plan Instagram’s chief executive has said users will have a worse experience in an algorithm-free world, seeing more brand-related content, and spend less time on the app. The comments come as the Australian government plans to give users the option to opt out of algorithms , with the prime minister, Anthony Albanese, announcing plans on Tuesday to require social media platforms to prompt users to choose between a feed of algorithm-recommended content or a reverse chronological feed of the pages users follow. Labor also plans to introduce a range of measures designed to address online harm on the sites. Continue reading...
body.zh: Adam Mosseri 表示，平台的算法“感觉就像一个黑匣子”，但在工党宣布退出计划后，该公司试图给用户更多的控制权。Instagram 首席执行官表示，用户在没有算法的世界中将获得更糟糕的体验，看到更多与品牌相关的内容，并在应用上花费更少的时间。澳大利亚政府计划向用户提供退出算法的选项，澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞 (Anthony Albanese) 周二宣布，计划要求社交媒体平台提示用户在算法推荐的内容提要或用户关注的页面的反向时间提要之间进行选择。工党还计划推出一系列措施，旨在解决网站上的网络伤害问题。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In an age of information overload, social media platforms often feel like 'black boxes,' shaping our perceptions in ways we don't fully understand. The desire for more control over our feeds, as discussed in Australia's proposed legislation, echoes a deeper need to curate our mental environment. Philippians 4:8 reminds us to focus our minds on what is true,...
reflection.zh: 在信息爆炸的时代，社交媒体平台常常感觉像一个“黑箱”，以我们不完全理解的方式塑造着我们的认知。正如澳大利亚提议的立法所讨论的，人们对更多地控制信息流的需求，呼应了我们对管理自己精神环境的更深层需要。《腓立比书》4:8 提醒我们要将心思意念集中在真实、可敬、公义、清洁、可爱、有美名的事上，这一原则同样适用于我们在线上和线下的生活。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: SMH columnist Peter FitzSimons tells Alan Jones trial alleged victim was ‘revolted’ by abuse
title.zh: SMH专栏作家彼得·菲茨西蒙斯称，艾伦·琼斯案的所谓受害者对虐待感到“厌恶”

summary.en: Independent senator Jacqui Lambie has called Pauline Hanson a 'coward' over a One Nation cartoon that labeled Liberal MP Andrew Hastie a 'traitor' for providing evidence against former SAS soldier Ben Roberts-Smith. The cartoon has drawn widespread condemnation, with even fellow One Nation senator Barnaby Joyce...

body.en:
Independent senator Jacqui Lambie has branded Pauline Hanson a "coward" over a One Nation cartoon labelling Liberal MP Andrew Hastie a "traitor" for giving evidence against former SAS soldier Ben Roberts-Smith.

Hanson's cartoon has drawn condemnation from across the political spectrum, with even fellow One Nation senator Barnaby Joyce saying he did not consider defence veteran Hastie a traitor.

The video is part of a political cartoon series created by One Nation titled Please Explain, which periodically targets politicians from various parties while promoting One Nation.

"She should remove that one of Hastie down right now today," Lambie told ABC Radio National on Thursday morning.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"Any veteran out there thinking about voting for One Nation or standing for them, I tell you what, you had better think twice."

Hastie was among several former SAS soldiers who gave evidence during Roberts-Smith's defamation case in 2022, which the decorated former soldier ultimately lost.

On Wednesday, he told News24 that Hanson should "own" the cartoon, acknowledge it called him a "traitor" and remove it.

In an interview on Wednesday evening, Hanson refused to take down the video and accused Hastie of making a "mountain out of a molehill".

Hastie has called on Hanson and One Nation MP Barnaby Joyce "lying cowards" and has challenged the party to remove the video.

"It shows her to be weak and glass-jawed. I gave the opportunity to either own her words publicly, or to take it down, she chose neither," he told ABC Radio on Thursday.

He accused the party of politicising the court proceedings of Roberts-Smith and "trashing" his own service record.

Hastie said the video amounted to a broader attack on veterans who testified in the case.

"It's actually an attack on veterans, not just an attack on me, because you've got to remember more than 20-plus SAS combat veterans were called to give evidence in the Federal Court. Are they traitors too?," he said.

Joyce said he was not aware of the One Nation cartoon but respected Hastie's military service.

"I'm disappointed he thinks I'm a coward. I don't know how he came to that opinion, but that's up to him. I don't think he's a traitor," Joyce told reporters outside of parliament on Thursday.

Opposition defence spokesperson James Paterson said Hanson was weak for failing to take responsibility for the video.

"She refused to take responsibility for a cartoon, which is pinned to the top of her X page, which she authorises, which she provides the voiceover for … she refused to take responsibility," he told News24.
