title.en: The countries showing Australia a way out of its 'miserable' classroom situation
title.zh: 澳大利亚可以从世界上一些最好的教育方法中学到什么

summary.en: Australia's neighbours are among the world's top-ranked education performers, while Australian schools are reportedly sliding backwards on key measures like literacy, maths, and science.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚的邻国在教育表现方面位居世界前列，而澳大利亚的学校在识字、数学和科学等关键指标上却据称正在滑坡。

body.en:
Heightened classroom disruption, gender divides, dwindling reading and maths scores — a major global student performance report shows Australian schools are continuing to slide backwards on key measures.

Every three years, the global Programme for International Student Assessment (PISA) measures student literacy in mathematics, reading, science and computational problem-solving.

The 2025 edition, which tested 15-year-olds from 91 OECD countries and economies, also measured the effects of gender divides, differences between high and low socio-economic status, and the impacts of technology and classroom disruption.

In the latest report, released on Tuesday, Australia's scores continued a 20-year decline, with maths and reading at Australia's lowest since testing began in 2000.

But Pasi Sahlberg, a Finnish education expert, author and professor at the University of Melbourne, says reports focusing on issues with the Australian school system were missing the big picture.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"The headline is that we have all-time-low results. I think it's absolutely astonishing that our mainstream media are saying this. The truth is every country in the OECD is showing all-time-low results in everything. Very few countries were able to improve their results in 2025," Sahlberg told SBS News.

In the global ranking, Australia moved up one place in reading to 11th, maintained its 17th place in maths, and fell one place in science to 11th. In the computational problem solving category, introduced in 2025, Australia ranked 8th globally. Australia's scores were well above the OECD average in all four key tests.

On Wednesday, in light of the results, federal Education Minister Jason Clare announced new reforms in reading, mathematics and science. He pointed to England's success — the country jumped three places in reading to reach the top 10, four places in maths to 10th place and seven places in science to rank at 8th in the 2025 PISA report — to illustrate a need for various reforms. This includes a focus on phonics, which is a method of teaching reading and writing that uses the sounds of spoken language, changes to the maths curriculum, and reforms to screen time.

"The UK results are impressive. It’s also hard-earned. It’s something almost 20 years in the making," Clare said in a statement.

He said that Australian schools that have been following English methods for a while are showing improvements but he wants a broader roll-out.

"We need to look beyond these rankings, because this data is also showing us a very alarming situation in Australia and many other countries when it comes to how young...
body.zh: 课堂混乱加剧、性别鸿沟、阅读和数学成绩下降——一份主要的全球学生成绩报告显示，澳大利亚学校在关键指标上继续倒退。 每三年，全球国际学生评估计划 (PISA) 都会衡量学生在数学、阅读、科学和计算问题解决方面的素养。 2025 年版本对来自 91 个经合组织国家和经济体的 15 岁青少年进行了测试，还衡量了性别鸿沟的影响、高低社会经济地位之间的差异以及技术和课堂干扰的影响。 在周二发布的最新报告中，澳大利亚的成绩持续20年来的下降，其中数学和阅读成绩处于澳大利亚自2000年开始测试以来的最低水平。 但芬兰教育专家、作家兼墨尔本大学教授帕西·萨尔伯格表示，关注澳大利亚学校系统问题的报告忽视了全局。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 萨尔伯格对 SBS 新闻表示：“头条新闻是我们的业绩创下历史新低。我认为我们的主流媒体这么说绝对令人惊讶。事实是，经合组织中的每个国家在所有方面的业绩都创下历史新低。很少有国家能够在 2025 年改善其业绩。” 在全球排名中，澳大利亚在阅读方面上升一位至第 11 位，在数学方面保持第 17 位，在科学方面下降一位至第 11 位。在 2025 年推出的计算问题解决类别中，澳大利亚在全球排名第八。澳大利亚在所有四项关键测试中的得分均远高于经合组织的平均水平。 周三，根据结果，联邦教育部长贾森·克莱尔宣布了阅读、数学和科学方面的新改革。他指出英国的成功——在 2025 年 PISA 报告中，该国在阅读方面跃升了 3 位，进入前 10 名；在数学方面跃升了 4 位，跃居第 10 位；在科学方面跃升了 7 位，跃居第 8 位——以说明进行各种改革的必要性。其中包括对自然拼读法（一种利用口语发音进行阅读和写作教学的方法）的关注、数学课程的改变以及放映时间的改革。 “英国的成绩令人印象深刻。这也是来之不易的。这是近 20 年来的成果，”克莱尔在一份声明中说。 他说，一段时间以来一直遵循英语教学法的澳大利亚学校正在取得进步，但他希望更广泛地推广。 “我们需要超越这些排名，因为这些数据还向我们展示了澳大利亚和许多其他国家的年轻人的情况非常令人震惊......

reflection.en: The PISA report indicates a concerning trend in Australian education, with declining scores in mathematics, reading, and science. This decline underscores the critical importance of how we shape and train the next generation, as Proverbs 22:6 advises, 'Train up a child in the way he should go; even when he is old he will not depart from it.' Investing in...
reflection.zh: PISA报告显示澳大利亚的教育趋势令人担忧，数学、阅读和科学成绩都在下滑。这一滑坡凸显了我们如何塑造和训练下一代至关重要，正如箴言22:6所建议的：“教养孩童，使他走当行的道，就是到老他也不偏离。” 投资于有效的教育方法，对于年轻人的未来福祉和国家至关重要。

verse.textEn: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.
verse.textZh: 教养孩童，使他走当行的道，就是到老他也不偏离。

title.en: I became a grandparent at 37 when our other kids were in primary school. We felt guilty
title.zh: 37岁成为祖父母，其他孩子还在上小学。我们感到内疚

summary.en: Matt and Esther Acton say that being young grandparents comes with unexpected difficulties but also benefits.
summary.zh: 马特和埃丝特·阿克顿说，年轻的祖父母身份带来了意想不到的困难，但也带来了好处。

body.en:
What does grandparenting look like today? Insight explores whether the demands on modern-day grandparents are keeping them physically fit and mentally well, or if the younger generations' wants and needs are being prioritised to the detriment of grandparents. Watch Insight episode Grandparenting on SBS On Demand.

I love telling people I'm a grandfather at 39, then immediately stopping to leave dead silence between us.

Their eyes widen, and you see them do calculations in their head — wondering if they should ask the follow-up question: "How old were you when you had your first child?"

After a few seconds, I explain how my wife and I met when I was 18, and she was 22 and already had a three-year-old, Ethan. And Ethan and his wife, Maddy, had a child named Illyria when he was 22 years old — almost two years ago now.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

One minute, I'm doing school pickup or coaching our second son Zander's U12 rugby team.

The next, my wife Esther asks if I remembered to put our two-year-old granddaughter Illyria's car seat in the car to pick her up for a sleepover.

We threw all our baby stuff out the moment our youngest Eden was too big for it five years ago. We weren't expecting to need it so soon — only three years later.

Arguably, most older grandparents have children who are all grown up and they are retired — or close to it — and have the free time to put more energy into their grandchildren.

And sometimes, I feel a pang of jealousy for these older grandparents. I'm not jealous because it's a competition, but because they're at a stage of life with extra time to help their children.

We have more energy (we like to think) and remember what it was like to have a baby in the house. I mean, it was only six years ago that Eden, 9, was a toddler.

She and our granddaughter absolutely adore each other, and their relationship is somewhat unconventional, with just a seven-year age gap.

Eden is known as 'Yaunty' (young aunty), and her duties look more like a sister's duties. I love watching her play with her niece and getting the experience of having a little sister. 

Grandparenting episode • Insight • News And Current Affairs • 51m And watching our 23-year-old Ethan become a dad has been the next best thing to becoming one myself.

He's not just attentive as a father, but he gives his heart fully to his wife and daughters. (I should mention they've just had another baby, Ananyah, who is one week old as I write this.)

He and I were extremely close when he was little, and we had a bit more distance when he was a teenager, becoming his own man, which is a normal and healthy rite of passage...
body.zh: 今天的祖父母是什么样子的？ 《洞察》探讨了对现代祖父母的要求是否使他们保持身体健康和心理健康，或者是否优先考虑了年轻一代的需求，而损害了祖父母的利益。观看 SBS On Demand 的《Insight》剧集《祖父母》。 我喜欢在 39 岁时告诉别人我已经是祖父了，然后立即停下来，让我们之间陷入死一般的沉默。 他们睁大眼睛，你会看到他们在脑子里进行计算——想知道他们是否应该问后续问题：“你生第一个孩子的时候多大了？” 几秒钟后，我解释了我和妻子是如何在我 18 岁时认识的，当时她 22 岁，已经有了一个三岁的孩子伊森 (Ethan)。伊森 (Ethan) 和他的妻子麦迪 (Maddy) 在他 22 岁时生了一个孩子，名叫伊利里亚 (Illyria)——差不多是两年前的事了。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 前一分钟，我正在学校接送或指导我们的二儿子 Zander 的 U12 橄榄球队。 接下来，我的妻子埃丝特问我是否记得将我们两岁的孙女伊利里亚的汽车座椅放在车里，以便接她去过夜。 五年前，当我们最小的伊甸园太大而无法容纳婴儿时，我们就把所有婴儿用品都扔掉了。我们没想到这么快就需要它——仅仅三年后。 可以说，大多数年长的祖父母都有已经长大的孩子，他们已经退休——或者接近退休——并且有空闲时间把更多的精力放在孙辈身上。 有时，我对这些年长的祖父母感到一阵嫉妒。我嫉妒不是因为这是一场比赛，而是因为他们正处于人生的一个阶段，有额外的时间来帮助他们的孩子。 我们有更多的精力（我们喜欢思考）并且记得在家里生孩子的感觉。我的意思是，仅仅六年前，9 岁的伊登还是个蹒跚学步的孩子。 她和我们的孙女非常相爱，而且他们的关系有些非传统，年龄差距只有七岁。 伊甸园被称为“Yaunty”（年轻的阿姨），她的职责看起来更像是姐妹的职责。我喜欢看她和她的侄女一起玩耍，并获得有一个小妹妹的经历。 祖父母剧集• 洞察• 新闻与时事• 51m 看着我们23 岁的Ethan 成为一名父亲，是仅次于我自己成为一名父亲的最好的事情。 他不仅是一个父亲，更是全心全意地照顾妻子和女儿。 （我应该提一下，他们刚刚生了另一个孩子，Ananyah，在我写这篇文章时他已经一周大了。） 当他小的时候，我和他关系非常亲密，而当他十几岁的时候，我们的距离就远了一些，成为了自己的男人，这是一个正常而健康的成人仪式……

reflection.en: The news story touches on the unique experience of becoming a grandparent at a young age, highlighting both the challenges and joys. Psalm 127:3 reminds us that children are a gift from Yahweh, a blessing that transcends age and circumstance. This perspective can help reframe the 'guilt' mentioned by the parents, seeing their role not as a burden, but as a...
reflection.zh: 这则新闻报道触及了年轻时成为祖父母的独特经历，既强调了挑战，也强调了乐趣。诗篇127:3提醒我们，儿女是雅伟所赐的产业，是一份超越年龄和环境的祝福。这种视角有助于重新定义父母提到的“内疚感”，将他们的角色视为神圣的托付，而非负担。

verse.textEn: Children are a heritage from Yahweh, offspring a reward from him.
verse.textZh: 儿女是雅伟所赐的产业。

title.en: ‘Lying cowards’: Hastie lashes Hanson and Joyce over cartoon dispute
title.zh: “撒谎的懦夫”：哈斯蒂抨击汉森和乔伊斯关于漫画的争端

summary.en: Liberal MP Andrew Hastie has demanded One Nation leader Pauline Hanson remove a cartoon video he claims smeared his military service, calling her and Barnaby Joyce "lying cowards" amid an intensifying row over an accused war criminal.
summary.zh: 自由党议员安德鲁·哈斯蒂要求一国党领袖宝琳·汉森删除一幅他声称诽谤其军旅生涯的漫画视频，并称她和巴纳比·乔伊斯为“撒谎的懦夫”，此前围绕一名被指控的战争罪犯的争执愈演愈烈。

body.en:
Pauline Hanson and Barnaby Joyce have been labelled "lying cowards" by a federal Liberal MP as a row over an alleged war criminal intensifies.

Liberal MP Andrew Hastie claimed in an email to supporters this week that Hanson had branded him a traitor, following a cartoon video posted to the One Nation leader's X account.

The nine-minute video, posted on 23 July, remained pinned at the top of the senator's X account.

There has been tension between Hastie, an SAS veteran, and Hanson since he spoke out against accused war criminal Ben Roberts-Smith.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The row heightened when Hastie was subpoenaed to testify in court against Roberts-Smith.

Hanson's closest supporter, billionaire Gina Rinehart, has backed Roberts-Smith and has named a planned housing complex for veterans in his honour.

But Hanson denied suggesting Hastie was a traitor, telling The Nightly newspaper she would define him as "a w****r".

"I dearly hope that nobody is threatening Andrew or his family, and certainly not premising (threats) on anything to do with One Nation,'' he told reporters.

Hastie branded Hanson and Joyce, his former coalition colleague, as "lying cowards", speaking to News24 on Wednesday.

The WA MP accused the party of politicising the Roberts-Smith court proceedings and "trashing" his own service record.

"I would say that Pauline Hanson and Barnaby Joyce are lying cowards, and I'll say it again so there's no ambiguity,'' he said.

"And then: On July 23, at the top of her X account, she posted a cartoon ... I'm called a traitor eight times ... when you start calling me a traitor to my own country, then we have a big, big problem."

"I stand with a lot of Australians who believe in the rule of law, who believe that Australian soldiers should be held to high standards of battlefield conduct," Hastie said.

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: 随着围绕一名战犯的争吵愈演愈烈，宝琳·汉森（Pauline Hanson）和巴纳比·乔伊斯（Barnaby Joyce）被一名联邦自由党议员称为“撒谎的胆小鬼”。 自由党议员安德鲁·哈斯蒂本周在给支持者的一封电子邮件中声称，在一国党领导人的 X 账户上发布了一段卡通视频后，汉森将他称为叛徒。 这段 9 分钟的视频于 7 月 23 日发布，仍然固定在参议员 X 帐户的顶部。 自从汉森公开反对被指控的战犯本·罗伯茨-史密斯以来，SAS退伍军人哈斯蒂和汉森之间的关系一直紧张。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 当哈斯蒂被传唤出庭作证指控罗伯茨-史密斯时，争吵加剧。 汉森最亲密的支持者、亿万富翁吉娜·莱因哈特支持罗伯茨·史密斯，并以他的名字命名了一个计划中的退伍军人住宅区。 但汉森否认暗示哈斯蒂是叛徒，并告诉《晚间报》，她将把他定义为“一个w****r”。 他对记者说：“我衷心希望没有人威胁安德鲁或他的家人，当然也不要以与一国党有关的任何事情为前提（威胁）。” 周三，哈斯蒂在接受 News24 采访时，将汉森和他的前联盟同事乔伊斯称为“撒谎的胆小鬼”。 这位西澳议员指责该党将罗伯茨-史密斯法庭诉讼政治化，并“毁掉”了他自己的服务记录。 “我想说宝琳·汉森和巴纳比·乔伊斯都是撒谎的胆小鬼，我会再说一遍，这样就不会含糊不清了，”他说。 “然后：7月23日，在她的X账户顶部，她发布了一幅漫画……我被称为叛徒八次……当你开始称我为祖国的叛徒时，我们就有了一个很大很大的问题。” 哈斯蒂说：“我与许多相信法治的澳大利亚人站在一起，他们认为澳大利亚士兵应该遵守高标准的战场行为。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: Words carry immense power, capable of building up or tearing down reputations and lives. The exchange between MP Hastie and Senator Hanson, involving accusations and a controversial cartoon, demonstrates how language can escalate conflict and inflict deep wounds. May we be mindful of the impact of our words, choosing truth and respect even in disagreement,...
reflection.zh: 言语拥有巨大的力量，既能建设也能摧毁声誉和生命。哈斯蒂议员和汉森参议员之间的争执，涉及指控和一幅有争议的漫画，表明语言如何加剧冲突并造成深刻的伤害。愿我们铭记言语的影响力，即使在意见不合时也选择真理和尊重，体现“生死在舌头的权下”的智慧。

verse.textEn: The tongue has the power of life and death, and those who love it will eat its fruit.
verse.textZh: 生死在舌头的权下；喜爱它的，必吃它所结的果子。

title.en: How an NFL match in Melbourne came to be, and its historic links
title.zh: NFL在墨尔本的比赛如何实现，及其历史渊源

summary.en: A century before the NFL arrived for its anticipated match at the MCG, American football had already reached Melbourne.
summary.zh: 在NFL抵达墨尔本板球场进行备受期待的比赛一个世纪前，美式足球早已传入墨尔本。

body.en:
The San Francisco 49ers take on the Los Angeles Rams at the Melbourne Cricket Ground on Friday morning in what will be the league's first regular-season game in Australia, and just the second game overall of the 2026 season.

The match kicks off on Friday at 10.35am and is geared around the Thursday night TV audience in the US. Kick-off time will be 5.35pm on the US West Coast and 8.35pm on the East Coast.

The NFL has a four-year contract with Victoria to host at least two games in Melbourne, with an option for a third, and is part of the NFL’s International Series, which started in 2007 at London's Wembley Stadium.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The Victorian government beat out serious bids from both NSW and Western Australia to host these games, and is thought to be paying the NFL about $15 million per game.

The match at the MCG will be one of nine international matches scheduled this season — including matches in Paris, Rio de Janeiro, Munich, Madrid, and London. NFL commissioner Roger Goodell has expressed interest in having every team play once in a foreign market each season.

While exhibition games between NFL teams have been played beyond US borders since 1969, some countries, like England, took time to build a following, while others, like Mexico, embraced it immediately.

In fact, the largest crowd in NFL history is 112,376 at the Azteca Stadium in Mexico City in 1994 when the Houston Oilers beat the Dallas Cowboys.

Other stadiums have also hosted NFL regular-season games outside the United States, including the Bernabéu in Madrid, Croke Park in Dublin, Twickenham in London, plus stadiums in Berlin, Munich, Frankfurt and São Paulo in Brazil.

The NFL has ramped up international efforts in recent times by inviting teams to apply for international marketing rights for various countries.

As of Wednesday afternoon, only one of the two teams playing on Friday — the San Francisco 49ers — has arrived in Australia.

"This has been such a cool experience," said 49ers running back Christian McCaffrey.

"There were question marks when we heard we were playing in Australia. Since we got here, it has been so cool. The people are unbelievable, the food's incredible, the coffee is great. The atmosphere, you can already feel it, it's been so much fun and we are super fired up we're here."

Four teams have been given the rights to Australia and New Zealand — the Los Angeles Rams, Philadelphia Eagles, Las Vegas Raiders, and the reigning Super Bowl champions, the Seattle Seahawks.

title.en: Blanche d'Alpuget, acclaimed writer and wife of Bob Hawke, dies at 82
title.zh: 著名作家、鲍勃·霍克遗孀布兰奇·达尔普吉去世，享年82岁

summary.en: Blanche d'Alpuget, an acclaimed Australian writer and widow of former Prime Minister Bob Hawke, has passed away at the age of 82. Her family remembered her as a vibrant individual who "lived life on her own terms," characterized by her vitality, generosity, and curiosity.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚著名作家、前总理鲍勃·霍克的遗孀布兰奇·达尔普吉（Blanche d'Alpuget）去世，享年82岁。她的家人回忆她是一位充满活力、慷慨大方、好奇心强的人，她“按照自己的意愿生活”。

body.en:
Blanche d'Alpuget, the Australian writer and widow of former prime minister Bob Hawke, has died.

In a statement, d'Alpuget's family remembered her as someone who lived "entirely on her own terms".

"She was full of vitality, generosity and curiosity, with an extraordinary appetite for beauty, ideas, history, new places and spirited conversation. She refused to be confined by convention or by other people's expectations of who she should be," they said.

"We will miss her force, her humour, her curiosity and her love beyond measure."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

They shared the words d'Alpuget lived by: “Our highest calling and greatest achievement is love, the rule of life. Love one another."

Having never lost her appetite for life, d'Alpuget refused to be confined by convention or by other people's expectations of who she should be, the family said.

Just two years before her death, at age 80, she swam with whale sharks in Indonesia and a year later published her final novel, a murder mystery entitled The Bunny Club.

She is survived by her son, artist and sculptor Louis Pratt, daughter-in-law Brianna and granddaughter Sienna.

The author married Hawke in 1995 after a tumultuous on-again, off-again affair that ran throughout the tenure of his prime ministership.

The pair, who met at a party in 1970, remained together for 24 years until his death in 2019.

Hawke controversially divorced his first wife, the popular Hazel, in 1994, which caused great family upheaval. She died in 2013.

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has shared his condolences, saying Australia has lost "a true one-off".

"As a writer, she was at home in fiction as she was in non-fiction, working in each realm with a keen eye for every telling detail that opened up the humanity of her subject to her readers," he said.

"Blanche’s novels were compelling works of verve and originality, and her biographies comprehensive and definitive – most famously those she wrote of Bob Hawke, who became her great love and ultimately her husband."

Born in Sydney on January 3, 1944, d'Alpuget was shaped by early travels in Indonesia, Malaysia and Europe with first husband and diplomat, Tony Pratt, with whom she had her son.

She began a more than six-decade career as a writer at The Daily Mirror and Woman's Day in Sydney and later at the News of the World in London.

Gaining literary acclaim for her fictional works, d'Alpuget was also a lauded biographer, including a 1982 book on her later husband titled, Robert J. Hawke: A Biography.

She met Hawke in Jakarta in 1970, but reconnected later in life — taking a job writing his biography, work that would later cement...
body.zh: 澳大利亚作家、前总理鲍勃·霍克的遗孀布兰奇·达尔普盖特去世。 在一份声明中，达普吉特的家人记得她是一个“完全按照自己的方式生活”的人。 他们说：“她充满活力、慷慨和好奇心，对美、思想、历史、新地方和充满活力的谈话有着非凡的兴趣。她拒绝受传统或其他人对她应该成为什么样的人的期望的限制。” “我们会怀念她的力量、她的幽默、她的好奇心和她无法估量的爱。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 他们分享了 d'Alpuget 的人生格言：“我们最高的使命和最大的成就是爱，是生活的准则。彼此相爱。” 澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞表达了哀悼，称澳大利亚失去了“真正的一次性”。 他说：“作为一名作家，她既擅长小说，也擅长非小说类作品，在每个领域都以敏锐的眼光关注每一个细节，向读者展示她的主题的人性。” “布兰奇的小说是充满活力和独创性的引人入胜的作品，她的传记全面而明确——最著名的是她写的鲍勃·霍克的传记，鲍勃·霍克成为了她的挚爱，并最终成为她的丈夫。” 20 多岁时，她开始从事新闻事业，并与第一任丈夫托尼·普拉特 (Tony Pratt) 一起环游世界。 她在印度尼西亚、马来西亚和欧洲旅行和生活过，然后在 30 多岁时返回澳大利亚。 1970 年，她在雅加达遇见了霍克，但后来又重新建立了联系——接受了为霍克撰写传记的工作，这份工作后来巩固了她作为一名获奖作家的地位。 两人于 1995 年结婚，在霍克于 2019 年去世之前，他们共同生活了二十多年。 她的家人说：“80岁时，她回到印度尼西亚水域，与四王群岛的鲸鲨一起游泳。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: Blanche d'Alpuget, known for her vibrant spirit and living life on her own terms, has died at 82. Her passing reminds us of the universal human appointment with death, a reality that touches every life, regardless of how fully it is lived. As Hebrews 9:27 states, death comes to all, a shared human experience that calls us to reflect on the brevity and...
reflection.zh: 布兰奇·达尔普吉，这位以其充满活力的精神和“按照自己的意愿生活”而闻名的作家，已于82岁辞世。她的离世提醒我们，死亡是全人类的定数，无论生命多么精彩，这都是一个触及每个人的现实。正如希伯来书9:27所说，人人都有一死，这是人类共同的经历，促使我们反思生命的短暂与宝贵。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: Social media must join the fight against teen suicides

summary.en: Suicide remains a leading cause of death among young people globally, with over 720,000 deaths annually. In Hong Kong, the Jockey Club Centre for Suicide Research and Prevention estimates the suicide rate at 13.0 per 100,000.
summary.zh: 自杀仍然是全球年轻人死亡的主要原因，每年有超过72万人死于自杀。在香港，赛马会防止自杀研究中心估计去年的自杀率为每10万人中有13.0人。

body.en: As we observe World Suicide Prevention Day on September 10, the global community reflects on a sobering reality: suicide remains a leading cause of death among young people. Every year, more than 720,000 people die by suicide – each life a story cut short, a family shattered, a community left to grapple with unbearable loss. In Hong Kong, the Jockey Club Centre for Suicide Research and Prevention (CSRP) at the University of Hong Kong estimates last year’s suicide rate at 13.0 per 100,000 in the...
body.zh: 在 9 月 10 日庆祝世界预防自杀日之际，国际社会反思了一个发人深省的现实：自杀仍然是年轻人死亡的主要原因。每年，超过 720,000 人死于自杀——每一个生命都被缩短，一个家庭破碎，一个社区面临难以承受的损失。在香港，香港大学赛马会自杀研究及预防中心 (CSRP) 估计，去年香港的自杀率为每 10 万人中有 13 人自杀。

reflection.en: The news of rising teen suicides is a stark reminder of the profound despair that can grip young hearts. It is a call for greater awareness and support, acknowledging that in moments of deepest anguish, Yahweh draws near to those whose hearts are breaking. May we extend compassion and seek ways to offer genuine help.
reflection.zh: 青少年自杀率上升的消息，令人痛心地提醒我们，年轻人心中可能充满多么深的绝望。这呼吁我们提高认识并提供更多支持，并认识到在最痛苦的时刻，雅伟靠近心碎的人。愿我们伸出援手，并寻求提供真正帮助的方法。

verse.textEn: Yahweh is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.
verse.textZh: 雅伟靠近伤心的人，拯救灵性痛悔的人。

body.en: Hong Kong leader John Lee has joined a chorus of senior politicians and local grandees paying tribute to Tung Chee-hwa, the city’s first leader after its 1997 handover to China. Tung Chee-hwa signing a bill as the chief executive in 1997. File Photo: GovHK. In a statement published on Wednesday, Lee praised Tung for steering Hong Kong through the 1997 Asian financial crisis and helping the city overcome various other challenges over his almost eight tumultuous years as chief executive from 1997 to 2005. “With visionary foresight,” Lee said, Tung “instituted mechanisms to promote economic and trade ties and co-ordinated development between Hong Kong and the Mainland, laying a solid foundation for Hong Kong’s enduring competitiveness.” Lee said Tung “dedicated his life to serving Hong Kong and the country.” Tung Chee-hwa. Photo: Our Hong Kong Foundation. Tung’s immediate successor as Hong Kong chief executive, Donald Tsang, paid tribute to Tung’s “approachable, refined manner, as well as his broad mind and visionary outlook.” In a Chinese-language statement issued on his behalf by the government, Tsang said that Tung was “never discouraged” in the face of challenges such as the financial crisis and the 2003 SARS outbreak, which killed close to 300 people in Hong Kong. Then-Chief Executive Leung Chun-ying (second-left, front row) and his wife Regina sit with former leaders Tung Chee-Hwa (far left) and Donald Tsang (far right) on July 1, 2012. Photo: Richard A. Brooks/AFP. He said that Tung, whom he served as financial secretary and second-in-command before assuming the top job, would be remembered for his “elegant smile, indomitable perseverance, long-term view of governance, and profound love for the nation and Hong Kong.” Leung Chun-ying, who took over as chief executive from 2012 to 2017, wrote in a Chinese-language Facebook post that Tung enjoyed a high level of trust from Beijing, and “was benevolent and kind, persuasive through reason, and an exemplar for our generation.” Then-chief executive Tung Chee-hwa officiates at the groundbreaking ceremony for Hong Kong Disneyland at Penny’s Bay, Lantau Island, in 2003. Photo: GovHK. Carrie Lam, chief executive from 2017 to 2022 and Tung’s director of social welfare, said in a letter to Tung’s office that her predecessor “led the city on its new journey under One Country, Two Systems.” ‘A caring and far-sighted leader’ Other notable Hongkongers also joined Tung’s fellow chief executives in paying tribute to the shipping scion turned senior statesman. Then-chief executive Tung Chee-hwa meets with medical staff during the 2003 SARS epidemic. File Photo: GovHK....
body.zh: 香港领导人李家超与高级政界人士和当地显贵一起向香港 1997 年回归中国后的首任领导人董建华致敬。 1997年，董建华作为行政长官签署法案。资料图片：香港政府一站通。李在周三发表的一份声明中赞扬董建华在1997年至2005年担任行政长官近八年的动荡岁月中，带领香港度过了1997年的亚洲金融危机，并帮助香港克服了各种挑战。李说，董建华“高瞻远瞩，建立了促进香港与内地经贸关系和协调发展的机制，为香港持久的竞争力奠定了坚实的基础。”李说，董建华“毕生致力于服务香港和国家”。董建华.照片：我们的香港基金会。董建华的直接继任者、香港特首曾荫权对董建华“平易近人、儒雅的举止、以及他宽广的胸怀和远见卓识”表示敬意。曾荫权在政府代表他发表的一份中文声明中表示，面对金融危机和2003年非典爆发等挑战，董建华“从未气馁”，该疫情导致香港近300人死亡。 2012 年 7 月 1 日，时任行政长官梁振英（前排左二）和他的妻子雷吉娜与前领导人董建华（最左）和曾荫权（最右）坐在一起。照片：Richard A. Brooks/法新社。他表示，在担任最高职务之前担任财政司司长和二把手的董建华，将因其“优雅的微笑、顽强的毅力、长远的施政视野以及对国家和香港的深厚热爱”而被人们铭记。 2012年至2017年接任行政长官的梁振英在脸书中文版帖子中写道，董建华受到北京的高度信任，“为人仁慈、有理有据，是我们这一代人的榜样”。 2003 年，时任行政长官董建华在大屿山竹篙湾主持香港迪士尼乐园奠基仪式。图片：香港政府一站通。 2017年至2022年特首、董建华社会福利总监林郑月娥在给董建华办公室的一封信中表示，她的前任“在一个国家、两种制度下带领香港踏上新征程”。 “一位有爱心、有远见的领导人” 其他著名的香港人也与董建华的其他行政长官一起向这位航运业子孙转型为高级政治家表示敬意。 2003年非典期间，时任行政长官董建华会见医护人员。资料图：香港政府一站通......

reflection.en: As Hong Kong's first post-handover leader, Tung Chee-hwa is remembered for navigating significant economic and political challenges. The tributes highlight his 'visionary foresight' in fostering development. This calls to mind the prophet Micah's enduring words: 'What does Yahweh require of you but to do justice, and to love kindness, and to walk humbly...
reflection.zh: 作为香港回归后的首任领导人，董建华因成功应对重大的经济和政治挑战而被铭记。致敬者强调了他促进发展的“远见卓识”。这让人想起先知弥迦不朽的话语：“雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的雅伟同行。”真正的领导力，无论在哪个时代，不仅以远见来衡量，更以其在服务中对公义、怜悯和正直的承诺来衡量。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

Proverbs 29:2 reminds us that the character of leadership profoundly impacts a society: "When the righteous rule, the people rejoice; but when the wicked rule, the people groan." The hope for any leader is to govern with wisdom and integrity,...
reflection.zh: 随着香港领导人准备概述未来计划，焦点不可避免地转向治理的本质。箴言29:2提醒我们，领导者的品格对社会有着深远的影响：“义人掌权，百姓喜乐；恶人掌权，百姓叹息。”任何领导人的希望都是以智慧和正直来治理，营造一个让公民能够蓬勃发展的环境。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

title.en: Susquehanna latest to pick up larger office space in Hong Kong’s Central, sources say
title.zh: 消息人士称，苏斯奎汉纳是最新一家在香港中环购置更大办公空间的公 司

summary.en: US investment firm Susquehanna International Group has agreed to lease more than 4,808 square metres (51,762 square feet) of office space at the Cheung Kong Center II, a prime office skyscraper developed by CK Asset Holdings in Hong Kong’s main business zone of Central, according to market sources.
summary.zh: 据市场消息人士称，美国投资公司苏斯奎汉纳国际集团已同意在长江中心二期租赁超过4808平方米（51762平方英尺）的办公空间。该中心是长实集团在香港主要商业区中环开发的一座顶级写字楼。

body.en: US investment firm Susquehanna International Group has agreed to lease more than 4,808 square metres (51,762 square feet) of office space at the Cheung Kong Center II, a prime office skyscraper developed by CK Asset Holdings in Hong Kong’s main business zone of Central, according to market sources. Neither Susquehanna nor CK Asset immediately replied to the South China Morning Post’s requests for comments. The new space would span three floors of the property, according to the...
body.zh: 据市场消息人士透露，美国投资公司海纳国际集团已同意在长江实业中心二期租赁超过4,808平方米（51,762平方英尺）的办公空间，长江实业集团是长实集团在香港中环主要商业区开发的优质办公摩天大楼。萨斯奎哈纳和长实集团均未立即回复《南华早报》的置评请求。据...的说法，新空间将跨越该物业的三层楼。

reflection.en: The decision by Susquehanna International Group to lease a substantial office space in Hong Kong's Central district represents a significant business undertaking. Such ventures, whether large or small, are opportunities to entrust plans and efforts to divine guidance, seeking wisdom and blessing in their execution. May their endeavors be marked by integrity...
reflection.zh: 苏斯奎汉纳国际集团决定在香港中环租赁大片办公空间，这代表着一项重大的商业举措。此类事业，无论大小，都是将计划和努力托付于神圣指引的机会，在执行中寻求智慧和祝福。愿他们的事业以正直和目标为标志。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Two unlicensed tour guides arrested by authorities
title.zh: 两名无证导游被当局逮捕

summary.en: A mainland Chinese man and woman were arrested by immigration authorities on suspicion of working as unlicensed tour guides, violating their visa conditions. The Travel Industry Authority (TIA) conducted a joint operation with the Immigration Department, targeting unlicensed guides in Sai Kung. The TIA stated it would...
summary.zh: 一名内地男女因涉嫌担任无证导游而被入境事务处拘捕，违反了他们的逗留条件。旅游业监管局（TIA）与入境事务处联合执法，在西贡一带针对无证导游进行打击。该局表示，如证实两人违反了《旅游业条例》及相关规例，将对其提出检控。随着国庆黄金周临近，旅监局称将加强与其他部门的联合巡查，严厉执法。

body.en: A mainland man and woman have been arrested by immigration authorities on suspicion of working as unlicensed tour guides, in breach of their conditions of stay. In a statement, the Travel Industry Authority (TIA) said it conducted a joint operation with the Immigration Department on Monday and Tuesday, targeting unlicensed tour guides across Sai Kung's East Dam and Central. The industry watchdog added that it would also press charges if the pair is found to have breached the Travel Industry Ordinance and related regulations. With the National Day Golden Week holiday approaching, the TIA said it will step up joint inspections with other agencies to strictly enforce the Travel Industry Ordinance and protect the rights and interests of visitors. The authority also warned that anyone providing tour guide services without a valid licence faces a maximum fine of HK$50,000 and up to one year in prison. Edited by Raymond Yeung
body.zh: 一名内地男子和一名女子因涉嫌违反逗留条件从事无证导游工作而被移民当局逮捕。旅游业监管局（TIA）在一份声明中表示，周一和周二与入境处联合采取行动，针对西贡东坝和中环的无证导游。该行业监管机构补充说，如果发现两人违反《旅游业条例》及相关法规，该行业监管机构也会提出指控。随着国庆黄金周假期临近，旅游局表示将与有关部门加强联合检查，严格执行《旅游业条例》，保障旅客权益。当局还警告称，任何没有有效执照而提供导游服务的人最高可被罚款5万港元及最高一年监禁。杨雷蒙编辑

reflection.en: The arrest of two individuals for working as unlicensed tour guides underscores the importance of operating within established rules and regulations. This situation calls to mind the prophet Micah's timeless instruction: 'He has shown you, O mortal, what is good. And what does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with...
reflection.zh: 两名无证导游被捕的事件，凸显了遵守既定规章制度的重要性。这让人想起先知弥迦的永恒教导：“世人啊，雅伟已指示你何为善。他要求你的是什么呢？是要行公义，好怜悯，谦卑地与你的雅伟同行。” 维护公义意味着尊重那些旨在公平交易和保护所有相关人员的法律。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Consultants and contractors charged over Wang Fuk fire
title.zh: 王福火灾事故：顾问和承包商被控

summary.en: The Buildings Department has filed 259 charges against two companies and four individuals connected to last year's fire at Wang Fuk Court, which resulted in 168 fatalities. The firms involved are Will Power Architects Company and Prestige Construction & Engineering, along with four individuals, who face charges for...
summary.zh: 屋宇署周三表示，已对与去年王福庭火灾有关的两家公司和四名个人提出259项控罪，该火灾造成168人死亡。涉事公司为王福庭的翻新项目顾问公司Will Power Architects Company，以及总承建商Prestige Construction & Engineering。被起诉的四名个人包括Will...

body.en: The Buildings Department on Wednesday said it has laid 259 charges against two companies and four individuals linked to last year's fire at Wang Fuk Court, which took 168 lives. The two firms facing charges are Will Power Architects Company, the consultancy firm for the estate's renovation project, and Prestige Construction & Engineering, the main contractor. The four individuals prosecuted are Wong Hap-yin, director of Will Power; Ng Yeuk, the registered inspector engaged by the company; as well as Prestige directors Hau Wa-kin and Ho Kin-yip. They're charged with allegedly permitting or authorising the use of defective materials or materials that do not comply with the provisions of the Buildings Ordinance in the carrying out of building works. The parties are also accused of permitting or authorising the building works to be carried out in a manner that caused injury to persons or property damage. The Buildings Department said it has stepped up regulation, inspection, and enforcement since the Wang Fuk Court inferno, while a special operation was launched to inspect scaffold nets and fire safety measures at about 400 buildings undergoing large-scale repair works across Hong Kong. Meanwhile, the Labour Department said it has prosecuted a project contractor, a consultant and an individual over the deaths of five workers in the Wang Fuk Court fire. It has instigated 25 charges for breaches of the general duty provisions under the Factories and Industrial Undertakings Ordinance. Edited by Raymond Yeung
body.zh: 屋宇署周三表示，已对与去年宏福苑火灾有关的两家公司和四名个人提出 259 项指控，该火灾导致 168 人丧生。面临指控的两家公司是该庄园改造项目的咨询公司 Will Power Architects Company 和主承包商 Prestige Construction & Engineering。被检控的四人分别是Will Power董事黄合贤、 Ng Yeuk，该公司聘请的注册检验员；以及Prestige董事侯华健及何建业。他们被控涉嫌允许或授权在进行建筑工程时使用有缺陷的材料或不符合《建筑物条例》规定的材料。双方还被指控允许或授权以造成人身伤害或财产损失的方式进行建筑工程。屋宇署表示，宏福苑大火事件发生后，已加强监管、巡查和执法，并开展特别行动，检查全港约400栋正在进行大规模修葺工程的大厦的脚手架网和消防安全措施。与此同时，劳工处表示，已就宏福苑火灾导致五名工人死亡一事起诉一名工程承包商、一名顾问和一名个人。该局已就违反《工厂及工业经营条例》下的一般责任条文提出 25 项指控。杨雷蒙编辑

reflection.en: The charges brought against the companies and individuals involved in the Wang Fuk Court fire underscore the critical importance of accountability in construction and renovation projects. When safety standards are compromised, the consequences can be devastating, as seen in the tragic loss of 168 lives. This situation calls for a commitment to justice and...
reflection.zh: 对王福庭火灾事故所涉公司和个人提出的指控，凸显了在建筑和翻新工程中问责制的重要性。当安全标准受到损害时，后果可能是毁灭性的，正如168人生命的悲惨损失所示。这种情况呼唤对公正和道德实践的承诺，确保责任人受到追究，并防止此类可避免的悲剧重演。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Buildings Dep’t launches 259 prosecutions over works at fire-hit Wang Fuk Court, 9 months after fatal blaze
title.zh: 王福苑火灾后九个月，屋宇署就失修单位展开259项检控

summary.en: Hong Kong's Buildings Department has initiated 259 prosecutions against four individuals and two companies responsible for renovation works at the fire-stricken Wang Fuk Court. The charges, filed over nine months after a deadly blaze killed 168 people, cite the use of substandard materials and inadequate supervision...
summary.zh: 香港屋宇署已对负责火灾中的王福苑单位翻新工程的四名个人和两家公司提起259项检控。这些指控在致命火灾造成168人死亡九个多月后提出，涉及使用劣质材料和翻新期间监督不力。

body.en: Hong Kong’s Buildings Department (BD) has launched more than 200 prosecutions against four individuals and two companies that oversaw renovation works at the fire-hit Wang Fuk Court. Wang Fuk Court. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The 259 charges, covering the use of defective or substandard materials and failure to adequately supervise renovation works, were initiated on Wednesday – more than nine months after the fire broke out. The prosecutions were launched after a joint investigation by the BD and the Housing Bureau’s Independent Checking Unit (ICU), the Wednesday statement said. The blaze at Wang Fuk Court, a government-subsidised housing estate in Tai Po, killed 168 people and displaced thousands of residents in November last year. Nine months on “The investigation revealed that the Registered Inspector (RI) employed by the project consultant failed to properly supervise the prescribed repair works and failed to ensure that the building was safe or had been rendered safe,” the department said on Wednesday “Meanwhile, during the course of the works, the main contractor and the project consultant allegedly permitted or authorised the use of non-fire-retardant scaffold netting and tarpaulins, as well as non-fire-retardant styrofoam boards to cover windows,” it continued. A tender analysis report signed off by Will Power director Wilson Ng in August 2023. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Fireproof windows along the emergency fire escape stairwell were also removed to create temporary access openings, causing smoke and fire to pour into the buildings and “ultimately resulting in 168 fatalities and 79 injuries,” the statement read. The two prosecuted companies are Will Power Architects, consultants for the estate’s HK$330 million renovation project, and the main contractor, Prestige Construction & Engineering. The four prosecuted individuals are Will Power’s director Wong Hap-yin and the inspector employed by the company, Wilson Ng, as well as Prestige’s two directors Hau Wa-kin and Ho Kin-yip. The same four people were also charged with a slew of offences in June, with Wong, Ng, Ho, and the two companies they represent facing manslaughter charges. ‘Widespread systemic issues’ Similar findings have previously been detailed in evidentiary hearings set up by an independent committee to probe the cause of the fire and its rapid spread. In March, the committee heard that the blaze revealed “ widespread systemic issues ” ranging from potential collusive tendering to rubber-stamp inspections and unauthorised proxy votes. The companies and the four individuals were discussed extensively at the hearings, though they did not testify in person. The blackened exterior of an apartment block in Wang Fuk Court, Tai Po, on November 27, 2025, with what appears...
body.zh: 香港屋宇署 (BD) 对负责监督遭受火灾的宏福苑翻修工程的四名个人和两家公司提起了 200 多项起诉。宏福苑.照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。这 259 项指控是在火灾发生九个多月后于周三发起的，涉及使用有缺陷或不合格的材料以及未能充分监督翻修工程。周三的声明称，屋宇署和房屋局独立审查组（ICU）联合调查后提出检控。去年11月，大埔政府资助住宅小区宏福苑发生火灾，造成168人死亡，数千居民流离失所。九个月后，该部门周三表示，“调查显示，项目顾问聘用的注册检验员（RI）未能适当监督规定的维修工程，未能确保建筑物安全或已达到安全状态。”“与此同时，在工程过程中，总承包商和项目顾问据称允许或授权使用非阻燃脚手架网和防水油布，以及非阻燃聚苯乙烯泡沫板来覆盖窗户，”该部门继续说道。 Will Power 董事 Wilson Ng 于 2023 年 8 月签署的招标分析报告。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。声明称，紧急逃生楼梯间沿线的防火窗也被拆除，以形成临时通道，导致烟雾和火灾涌入建筑物，“最终导致 168 人死亡、79 人受伤”。两家被起诉的公司分别是该屋村耗资3.3亿港元翻新工程的顾问公司Will Power Architects，以及总承包商Prestige Construction & Engineering。四名被检控人士分别为Will Power董事黄合贤、该公司聘用的督察吴伟信，以及Prestige两名董事侯华健及何建业。六月，这四人还被指控犯有一系列罪行，其中黄、吴、何以及他们代表的两家公司面临过失杀人罪指控。 “广泛的系统性问题”此前，一个独立委员会为调查火灾原因及其迅速蔓延而设立的证据听证会详细介绍了类似的调查结果。今年三月，委员会听说火灾暴露了“广泛的系统性问题”，从潜在的串通投标到橡皮图章检查和未经授权的代理投票。尽管这些公司和这四人没有亲自作证，但他们在听证会上进行了广泛讨论。 2025 年 11 月 27 日，大埔宏福苑一栋公寓楼的外墙被熏黑，看上去……

reflection.en: The tragedy at Wang Fuk Court, which claimed 168 lives, highlights a profound failure in accountability. The subsequent launch of 259 prosecutions points to a system grappling with the consequences of negligence and the use of substandard materials. This situation calls us to reflect on the importance of integrity and diligence in all our undertakings,...
reflection.zh: 王福苑的悲剧夺走了168条生命，这暴露了问责制的严重缺失。随后发起的259项检控表明，相关系统正在应对疏忽大意和使用劣质材料所带来的后果。这种情况促使我们反思，在所有事业中，尤其是在那些影响他人安全和福祉的事业中，诚信和勤勉的重要性。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Washington accuses Chinese AI firms of ‘systematic’ theft
title.zh: 华盛顿指控中国人工智能公司“系统性”盗窃

summary.en: Washington accused top Chinese artificial intelligence labs, including DeepSeek and Moonshot AI, of systematically stealing the capabilities of American models on Tuesday, amidst a race for technological supremacy between the two countries. This advisory from the US cyber defense agency precedes a potential meeting...
summary.zh: 周二，华盛顿指控包括 DeepSeek 和 Moonshot AI...

body.en: Washington accused top Chinese artificial intelligence labs including DeepSeek and Moonshot AI of systematically stealing the capabilities of American models on Tuesday as the two countries race for tech supremacy. Chinese startup DeepSeek’s AI assistant. File photo: Kelly Ho/HKFP. The advisory from the US cyber defense agency comes ahead of an expected meeting this month between President Donald Trump and his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping at the White House, where AI could be an important discussion topic. It follows several previous accusations of Chinese AI theft through a process known as distillation, levelled by the US government and American AI companies. “China-based artificial intelligence (AI) companies are conducting systematic extraction of proprietary functionalities and capabilities of US AI companies’ models,” Tuesday’s advisory read. They are doing so “through industrial-scale knowledge distillation campaigns that form the core — not merely a supplement — of their AI development strategy”, it said. OpenAI, the creator of ChatGPT. Photo: Levart_Photographer/Unsplash. Distillation is where an AI model is trained to mimic the output of a larger, more capable one. The method is widely used across the industry, but Washington says Chinese firms have deployed it at scale to illicitly copy American systems. Chinese companies that adopt this strategy “see significantly shorter AI development timelines and reduced financial expenditures in training a frontier model”, the advisory said. It detailed how DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, Alibaba, MiniMax, StepFun, and Z.AI allegedly used millions of exchanges and requests to steal the capabilities of US models from the likes of OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and xAI. These actions, taken “likely with Chinese government awareness”, have taken place since at least late 2024, it said. AFP contacted the Chinese companies apart from StepFun which was not immediately reachable. Moonshot AI declined to comment. ‘Smearing China’ Trump is under pressure to respond to the increasing success of Chinese AI models that many companies prefer to the more powerful, but pricier, US versions from Anthropic or OpenAI. In July, dozens of startups wrote a letter to the Trump administration urging it to think twice against any outright ban or strict curbs on foreign-made AI models, saying this should only be considered for government use of the technology. That month, Beijing also turned the tables by accusing US AI of using Chinese examples to train their models. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Beijing, China. Photo: Wikicommons. Asked about the accusations at a regular briefing Wednesday, Chinese foreign ministry spokeswoman Mao Ning said...
body.zh: 周二，在两国争夺技术霸主之际，华盛顿指责 DeepSeek 和 Moonshot AI 等中国顶尖人工智能实验室系统性窃取美国模型的能力。中国初创公司 DeepSeek 的人工智能助手。资料照片：Kelly Ho/HKFP。美国网络防御机构的这一建议是在唐纳德·特朗普总统和中国国家主席习近平预计本月在白宫举行会议之前发布的，人工智能可能成为重要的讨论话题。在此之前，美国政府和美国人工智能公司曾多次指控中国通过“蒸馏”过程盗窃人工智能。周二的咨询报告称：“中国的人工智能（AI）公司正在系统地提取美国人工智能公司模型的专有功能和能力。”报告称，他们正在“通过工业规模的知识提炼活动来实现这一目标，这些活动构成了其人工智能发展战略的核心，而不仅仅是补充”。 OpenAI，ChatGPT 的创建者。照片：Levart_Photographer/Unsplash。蒸馏是训练人工智能模型来模仿更大、能力更强的模型的输出。该方法在整个行业广泛使用，但华盛顿表示，中国公司已大规模部署该方法来非法复制美国系统。该咨询称，采用这一策略的中国公司“发现人工智能开发时间明显缩短，培训前沿模型的财务支出也减少了”。它详细介绍了 DeepSeek、Moonshot AI、阿里巴巴、MiniMax、StepFun 和 Z.AI 据称如何利用数百万次交换和请求从 OpenAI、Anthropic、谷歌和 xAI 等公司窃取美国模型的功能。报告称，这些行动“可能是在中国政府意识到的情况下”采取的，至少自 2024 年底以来就已采取。法新社联系了除StepFun之外的其他中国公司，但未能立即联系上。 Moonshot AI 拒绝置评。 “抹黑中国” 特朗普面临着应对中国人工智能模型日益成功的压力，许多公司更喜欢中国人工智能模型，而不是 Anthropic 或 OpenAI 的更强大但价格更高的美国版本。今年 7 月，数十家初创公司写信给特朗普政府，敦促其三思而后行，反对对外国制造的人工智能模型的任何彻底禁令或严格限制，并表示只有政府使用该技术才应考虑这样做。当月，北京还指责美国人工智能使用中国的例子来训练他们的模型，从而扭转了局势。位于中国北京的外交部。照片：维基共享资源。中国外交部发言人毛宁在周三的例行吹风会上被问及这些指控时表示……

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, as highlighted by accusations of capability theft between nations, speaks to a time when 'knowledge will increase' (Daniel 12:4). This technological race, while fraught with ethical concerns and competition, also represents humanity's relentless pursuit of understanding and innovation. May we seek wisdom to...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，如国家间关于能力窃取的指控所示，正应验了“知识将增添”（但以理书 12:4）的预言。这场技术竞赛虽然充满伦理担忧和竞争，但也代表了人类对理解和创新的不懈追求。愿我们寻求智慧来引导这些强大的工具服务于人类的繁荣，而非加剧分裂。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Unidentified Murder review – playful sendup of alien abduction and true crime influencers in Hong Kong
title.zh: 《不明谋杀》评论——香港外星人绑架和真实犯罪网红的戏谑模仿

summary.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling. Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done...
summary.zh: 在这部突破叙事界限的低成本喜剧冒险片中，儿时好友声称目睹了一名学童的失踪。由郭嘉曦和李振杰执导的这部规模不大、结构精巧的喜剧，以一种随心所欲的戏谑方式模仿了真实犯罪爱好者和伪网红，但其出发点是喜爱而非恶意。影片围绕一个（虚构的）25年前的案件展开，该案件吸引了整个香港的关注。

body.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done with affection rather than malice. It revolves around a (fictional) 25-year-old case that captivates the whole of Hong Kong. Back when they were seven, childhood friends Mark (Ling Man-lung) and Kit (Ronald Lam Tsz-kit) claimed to have witnessed the abduction by aliens of their classmate Ho in the woods of Tung Tau Hill. On the 25th anniversary of this supposed incident, the pair re-enter the internet’s consciousness after an interview on an online chatshow about unsolved mysteries. Cashing in on their viral fame, Mark’s girlfriend Man (Renci Yeung) hires actor Kim (Peter Chan Charm-man) to pretend to be Ho, all in the hope of racking up views on her social channels. Just when the cameras are all set up, Man watches in horror as the staged reunion leads to a real murder … or does it? The film unfolds in a series of increasingly tricksy complications and reversals. All of a sudden, apparent victims are revealed to be scheming masterminds, and vice versa. As most of the actions take place in the forest where the abduction supposedly occurred, the plot derives comic relief from the increasingly blurred line between truth and playacting. Largely shot with handheld cameras, it has a visual style that lends authenticity to representations of online media, though occasionally this distracts from the physical comedy performed by the cast. The constant twists also turn into bit of a competitive sport, meaning the film becomes more of a writing exercise than anything else. Continue reading...
body.zh: 儿时的朋友声称在这部低成本喜剧中目睹了一名小学生的失踪，这部喜剧突破了讲故事的极限。郭家熙和李俊杰的这部喜剧规模适中，结构复杂，是对真正的犯罪爱好者和想要成为影响者的反复无常的讽刺，是出于感情而不是恶意。它围绕着一个（虚构的）25 年前震惊整个香港的案件展开。七岁时，青梅竹马的Mark（凌文龙饰）和Kit（林中基饰）声称在东头山的树林里亲眼目睹了同学何氏被外星人绑架。在这起所谓的事件发生 25 周年之际，两人在一次关于未解之谜的在线访谈节目中接受采访后，重新进入了互联网的视野。马克的女友曼（杨仁慈饰）利用他们的病毒名气，聘请演员金（陈可辛饰）假扮何浩，希望能在她的社交频道上获得更多的关注。就在摄像机全部架好时，曼惊恐地看着这场上演的重聚导致了一场真正的谋杀……是吗？影片在一系列日益棘手的复杂情况和逆转中展开。突然之间，表面上的受害者被揭露为诡计多端的策划者，反之亦然。由于大部分情节都发生在据称发生绑架的森林中，因此事实与表演之间的界限越来越模糊，情节因此而变得喜剧化。它主要是用手持摄像机拍摄的，其视觉风格为在线媒体的表现提供了真实性，尽管有时这会分散演员们表演的肢体喜剧的注意力。不断的曲折也变成了一场竞技运动，这意味着这部电影更像是一场写作练习。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This film playfully satirizes our fascination with true crime and the influencers who amplify these stories. In a world saturated with sensational narratives, Philippians 4:8 reminds us to focus our minds on what is true, honorable, and excellent, rather than getting lost in speculation or manufactured drama. May we cultivate discernment in what we consume...
reflection.zh: 这部电影以一种戏谑的方式讽刺了我们对真实犯罪故事和放大这些故事的网红们的迷恋。在一个充斥着耸人听闻叙事的世界里，《腓立比书》4:8 提醒我们要将心思意念专注于真实、可敬、公义、清洁、可爱、有美名的事，而不是沉溺于猜测或人为制造的戏剧。愿我们培养辨别力，选择所消费和分享的内容，寻求真理与良善。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty in second national security case
title.zh: 香港民主派活动人士黄之锋承认在第二起国安案中认罪

summary.en: Joshua Wong, a prominent pro-democracy activist in Hong Kong, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to charges under the national security law, specifically conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against China. The charge carries a maximum penalty of life imprisonment.
summary.zh: 香港一位著名的民主派活动人士黄之锋周三承认触犯国安法，罪名是共谋寻求外国制裁中国，该罪名最高可判处无期徒刑。

body.en: Wong, 29, is accused of urging foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades and other hostile measures against China Joshua Wong , one of Hong Kong’s most prominent pro-democracy activists, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against Hong Kong and China, a national security charge that carries a maximum life sentence. Prosecutors have accused Wong, 29, of working with the exiled Hong Kong activist Nathan Law to urge foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades or other hostile measures against China. Continue reading...
body.zh: 29 岁的黄之锋被指控敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁和其他敌对措施。香港最著名的民主活动人士之一黄之锋周三承认密谋寻求外国对香港和中国实施制裁，这一国家安全指控最高可判处无期徒刑。检察官指控 29 岁的黄与流亡香港活动人士罗冠聪合作，敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁或其他敌对措施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Joshua Wong, a young activist known for his role in Hong Kong's democracy movement, has pleaded guilty to charges under the national security law. This situation brings to the fore the difficult tension between civic obedience and deeply held convictions. The apostles' unwavering stance, 'We must obey God rather than human beings,' offers a timeless...
reflection.zh: 香港一位以其在民主运动中角色而闻名的年轻活动人士黄之锋，已承认触犯国安法。这一局面凸显了公民服从与内心深处信念之间的艰难张力。使徒们坚定的立场——“顺从神，过于顺从人”——为这种良心冲突提供了永恒的视角。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Science & Nature Desk
title.zh: 自然科学

strap.en: Discoveries in nature, climate, health, and the wider cosmos.
strap.zh: 自然、气候、健康与宇宙万象的新发现。

title.en: Four in five researchers report harmful interactions during geoscience fieldwork. A new survey suggests a path forward.
title.zh: 五分之四的地球科学研究人员报告野外工作存在伤害性互动；新调查提出改进路径

summary.en: A survey of geoscience researchers reveals that 80% have experienced harmful interactions during fieldwork, including compromised safety and crossed personal boundaries. These incidents are often exacerbated by the isolation of remote locations and the uneven power dynamics between senior professionals and students.
summary.zh: 一项针对地球科学研究人员的调查显示，80%的人在野外工作中经历过伤害性互动，包括安全受损和个人界限被逾越。偏远地区的孤立环境以及资深专业人士与学生之间不平等的权力动态，往往加剧了这些事件的发生。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Fieldwork is a vital part of geoscience research, allowing scientists and students to directly observe, interact with and collect data about Earth processes that cannot be replicated in the lab.

Because fieldwork involves traveling to remote locations and living in close quarters under demanding conditions, it can also lead to circumstances in which personal boundaries are crossed or safety is compromised. Shared housing, uneven power structures between students and professionals, remote locations and long workdays can increase the likelihood of harmful field interactions.

Although the National Science Foundation, the largest agency funding field-based research, provides safety guidelines for fieldwork, many researchers in the geosciences report a range of problematic behaviors, from bullying to discrimination to sexual harassment.

Gold and team conducted an anonymous survey of 289 AGU members to assess the frequency of harmful field interactions (excluding severe cases of violence or misconduct), which types have the greatest impact and why incidents may go unreported. The researchers also asked participants what could be done to make geoscience field research safer and more inclusive. The findings are published in the journal AGU Advances .

In the survey, participants were asked whether they had experienced or witnessed harmful behaviors, including aggression and hostility, social harassment, undermining of work, inappropriate sexual behavior, assumptions and stereotyping, and violations of personal privacy.

Participants identified instances and provided additional details, such as whether they experienced or observed the harmful behavior, the relationship between perpetrator and victim, the career stage at which the event occurred, whether the field site was in a remote or accessible location, and whether the incident was reported.

Eighty percent of survey participants reported experiencing at least one harmful field interaction during fieldwork; the average respondent reported five harmful interactions.

Though identity-based harmful behaviors, such as inappropriate sexual behavior and assumptions or stereotyping, were commonly reported, respondents consistently identified behaviors related to professional conduct, such as gatekeeping, sabotage and devaluation of work, as having the most negative impact. Women and nonbinary researchers were disproportionately affected by devaluation of their work, bullying, unwanted sexual attention and invasions of privacy.

Career stage also affected study respondents: Early-career researchers were more likely to face...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 实地考察是地球科学研究的重要组成部分，它使科学家和学生能够直接观察、互动并收集有关实验室无法复制的地球过程的数据。 由于实地工作需要前往偏远地区并在苛刻的条件下居住在近距离，因此也可能导致跨越个人界限或安全受到损害的情况。共享住房、学生和专业人士之间不平衡的权力结构、偏远的地点和漫长的工作日都会增加有害现场互动的可能性。 尽管资助实地研究的最大机构美国国家科学基金会为实地工作提供了安全指南，但许多地球科学研究人员报告了一系列有问题的行为，从欺凌到歧视再到性骚扰。 Gold 和团队对 289 名 AGU 成员进行了匿名调查，以评估有害现场互动的频率（不包括严重的暴力或不当行为案例）、哪些类型影响最大以及事件可能未被报告的原因。研究人员还询问参与者可以采取哪些措施来使地球科学研究更安全、更具包容性。研究结果发表在《AGU Advances》杂志上。 在调查中，参与者被问及是否经历或目睹过有害行为，包括攻击性和敌意、社会骚扰、破坏工作、不当性行为、假设和成见以及侵犯个人隐私。 参与者指出了实例并提供了更多详细信息，例如他们是否经历或观察到有害行为、肇事者与受害者之间的关系、事件发生的职业阶段、现场是否位于偏远或可到达的位置以及事件是否被报告。 百分之八十的调查参与者表示在实地工作期间至少经历过一次有害的现场互动；平均受访者报告了五种有害的相互作用。 尽管基于身份的有害行为（例如不适当的性行为和假设或成见）经常被报道，但受访者一致认为与职业行为相关的行为（例如把关、破坏和贬低工作）具有最大的负面影响。女性和非二元性别研究人员尤其受到工作贬值、欺凌、不受欢迎的性关注和侵犯隐私的影响。 职业阶段也影响了研究受访者：早期职业研究人员更有可能面临……

reflection.en: Scientific discovery in the field often requires isolation and intense collaboration, but these conditions must not become a cover for harassment or the abuse of power. When four out of five researchers report harm, it is a call to move beyond mere observation and actively seek justice for those in vulnerable positions. True progress in understanding...
reflection.zh: 野外科学发现往往需要孤立的环境和高强度的协作，但这些条件绝不能成为骚扰或滥用权力的掩护。当五分之四的研究人员报告受到伤害时，这正是在呼吁我们不要仅仅停留在观察层面，而要积极为处于弱势地位的人“寻求公平”。要真正进步并理解雅伟的创造，必须建立一种尊重每一位参与者安全与尊严的文化。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: August was joint hottest month on record, says European climate agency
title.zh: 八月创纪录高温，欧洲气候机构称与七月并列

summary.en: August tied with July 2023 as the hottest month on record globally, driven by climate change and the El Niño phenomenon, with temperatures exceeding the critical 1.5C threshold above pre-industrial levels.
summary.zh: 根据欧盟气候服务机构的数据，八月与2023年七月并列成为有记录以来最热的月份，这归因于气候变化和厄尔尼诺现象，气温超过了工业化前水平1.5摄氏度的关键阈值。

body.en:
August was the joint-hottest month ever recorded, tying with July 2023, according to the EU's climate service.

The record was driven by a combination of climate change and the rising influence of El Niño, pushing heat into the atmosphere across the Pacific.

Temperatures for the month were 1.65C above pre-industrial levels - surpassing the critical 1.5C threshold agreed by countries to avoid the worst consequences of climate change.

While a single month above 1.5C does not mean it has been permanently crossed, it shows a trend towards breaching that limit.

The month also capped western Europe's warmest summer, with high temperatures pushing the season past the deadly heat of 2003.

Dr Samantha Burgess, strategic lead for climate at Copernicus, described August as "a remarkable month in the global climate record", and its impacts had been "increasingly being felt by communities, economies and ecosystems across the world".

The combination of record air temperatures, record ocean heat and Europe's exceptional summer showed how climate change was now driving extremes across "both the atmosphere and the oceans", she said.

UN climate chief Simon Stiell said the record clearly showed humanity's impact on the climate.

"The evidence is irrefutable: this is the spiralling price of humanity's fossil fuel addiction, and the global climate crisis it is fuelling," he said.

On top of the ongoing impact of the use of fossil fuels, the rise of a powerful El Niño is making matters worse, the researchers have said.

El Niño is a natural climate pattern in which a band of the eastern Pacific turns unusually warm, releasing vast amounts of stored ocean heat into the atmosphere and nudging global temperatures upwards for around a year.

The one currently being experienced is still strengthening and could become one of the most powerful on record, according to the Copernicus team.

The biggest impact of this natural phenomenon on global temperatures is expected to hit over the coming year, meaning the current run of records may have further to go.

That prospect follows a summer that drove western Europe to its warmest on record.

This was echoed in the UK, which had its hottest summer since records began in 1884 - a high mark the Met Office found had been made around 130 times more likely by human-caused climate change.

This figures carried "a very real human cost", said Dr Clair Barnes, an extreme weather researcher at Imperial College London.

The heat across the UK and Europe disrupted schools, strained hospitals, hit food production, fuelled fires and drought, and claiming "tens of thousands of lives", she said.

"Until we stop burning fossil fuels these records will continue to tumble, and the extremes will worsen faster than we are able to adapt. Crucially,...
body.zh: 根据欧盟气候服务机构的数据，8 月是有记录以来最热的月份，与 2023 年 7 月持平。 这一纪录是由气候变化和厄尔尼诺现象的影响不断加大共同推动的，厄尔尼诺现象将热量推入太平洋彼岸的大气中。 本月气温比工业化前水平高出 1.65 摄氏度，超过了各国为避免气候变化造成最严重后果而商定的 1.5 摄氏度临界阈值。 虽然单月气温高于 1.5 摄氏度并不意味着它已被永久突破，但它显示出突破该限制的趋势。 这个月也结束了西欧最温暖的夏季，高温使这个季节超越了 2003 年的酷热天气。 哥白尼气候战略主管萨曼莎·伯吉斯博士将八月描述为“全球气候记录中非凡的一个月”，其影响“越来越多地被世界各地的社区、经济和生态系统所感受到”。 她说，创纪录的气温、创纪录的海洋热量和欧洲异常的夏季结合在一起，表明气候变化正在如何推动“大气和海洋”出现极端现象。 联合国气候变化负责人西蒙·斯蒂尔表示，这一记录清楚地表明了人类对气候的影响。 他说：“证据是无可辩驳的：这就是人类对化石燃料成瘾的螺旋式上升的价格，以及它正在加剧的全球气候危机。” 研究人员表示，除了使用化石燃料造成的持续影响之外，强大的厄尔尼诺现象的兴起也使情况变得更糟。 厄尔尼诺现象是一种自然气候模式，东太平洋的一段区域变得异常温暖，将大量储存的海洋热量释放到大气中，并推动全球气温在一年左右的时间里上升。 据哥白尼团队称，目前正在经历的这一事件仍在加强，并可能成为有记录以来最强大的之一。 这种自然现象对全球气温的最大影响预计将在明年出现，这意味着目前的记录可能还会进一步延续。 这一前景是在西欧经历了有记录以来最温暖的夏季之后发生的。 英国也出现了这种情况，该国正经历自 1884 年有记录以来最热的夏季——英国气象局发现，人为气候变化的可能性增加了约 130 倍。 伦敦帝国理工学院极端天气研究员克莱尔·巴恩斯博士说，这个数字带来了“非常真实的人力成本”。 她说，英国和欧洲各地的高温天气扰乱了学校，使医院不堪重负，影响了粮食生产，加剧了火灾和干旱，并夺去了“数万人的生命”。 “在我们停止燃烧化石燃料之前，这些记录将继续下降，极端情况的恶化速度将超过我们能够适应的速度。至关重要的是……

reflection.en: The Earth, with its intricate systems and delicate balance, is a testament to its Creator. As we witness record-breaking heat, it calls us to remember that this planet is not ours to exploit, but a sacred trust to steward with wisdom and care. May we approach our responsibility with humility, recognizing Yahweh's ownership and seeking to live in harmony...
reflection.zh: 地球及其错综复杂的系统和微妙的平衡，是其创造主的明证。当我们目睹创纪录的高温时，这提醒我们，这片土地并非供我们予取予求，而是我们应以智慧和关爱来管理的圣洁信托。愿我们以谦卑的态度承担起责任，认识到雅伟才是这片土地的主宰，并寻求与祂的创造和谐共处。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy reveals the surface chemistry of bio-based hybrid materials
title.zh: X射线光电子能谱揭示生物基混合材料的表面化学

summary.en: Just a few atomic layers at the surface can strongly influence how effectively a material binds pollutants from water or how efficiently a photocatalyst responds to light. Researchers at the Fraunhofer Institute for Applied Polymer Research IAP use X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) to investigate the chemical...
summary.zh: 材料表面仅几层原子厚度的化学性质，会极大地影响其从水中吸附污染物的效率或光催化剂对光的响应效率。德国应用聚合物研究所（IAP）的研究人员利用X射线光电子能谱（XPS）来研究生物基碳材料和有机-无机杂化材料表面及界面的化学状态和相互作用。他们的见解可以支持针对性地开发未来工业应用的功能材料。

body.en: Just a few atomic layers at the surface can strongly influence how effectively a material binds pollutants from water or how efficiently a photocatalyst responds to light. Researchers at the Fraunhofer Institute for Applied Polymer Research IAP use X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) to investigate the chemical states and interactions at the surfaces and interfaces of bio-based carbon materials and organic-inorganic hybrid materials. Their insights can support the targeted development of functional materials for future industrial applications.

This research, by meticulously...
reflection.zh: 诗篇作者问道：“诸天述说雅伟的荣耀”（诗篇19:1）。约伯也提醒我们：“你可以问走兽，它们会教导你；天空飞鸟，它们会告诉你；或对大地说话，它会教导你；海中的鱼，它们会告诉你”（约伯记12:7-8）。这项研究通过一丝不苟地检查材料的基本构成，揭示了创造物中固有的复杂设计和功能，指向一位其智慧在最细微之处彰显的创造者。

title.en: Luck or merit? Not all inequality is equally acceptable
title.zh: 运气还是功劳？并非所有不平等都同样可以接受

summary.en: Economist Ingvild Almås of the University of Zurich is investigating why people accept financial inequality and under what conditions they support redistribution, such as through higher taxes on the wealthy. The research questions whether the source of wealth—lottery win versus hard work—affects people's perception of...
summary.zh: 苏黎世大学的经济学家 Ingvild Almås 正在研究人们为何接受财务不平等，以及在何种条件下他们支持财富再分配，例如对富人征收更高的税。该研究探讨了财富的来源——是彩票中奖还是辛勤工作——是否会影响人们对公平的看法。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Do you think it's fair that some people are better off financially than others? Does it perhaps matter whether those earnings stem from a lottery win or hard work? These are the kinds of questions economist Ingvild Almås of the University of Zurich is exploring.

She wants to understand why people around the world are willing to accept inequality—and under what conditions they support redistribution, such as through higher taxes on the wealthy.

"Inequality is an important global issue. A key question is how inequality is morally justified in society," says Almås.

Her recently published study in The Quarterly Journal of Economics , conducted in collaboration with Norwegian colleagues, shows significant differences among countries in this regard.

"People consider varying degrees of inequality to be acceptable and also have different justifications for doing so."

The study included 65,000 people from 60 countries, covering 80% of the world's population. For example, participants were asked to decide whether real workers on an online labor market platform should receive a bonus based on their performance or through a random lottery.

The study also examined the extent to which people support the redistribution of wealth—for instance, through higher taxes on the wealthy or other policy measures.

The result: On average, the global population is more likely to accept an unequal distribution of wealth if it is based on work rather than pure chance. This view is particularly strong in Switzerland, for example.

"We see a merit-based understanding of fairness primarily in countries with democratic political systems that are richer, more equal and more individualistic," says Almås.

Nevertheless, the Swiss population is open to a certain degree of redistribution, particularly in cases where inequality is based on luck.

However, not all countries share the view that prosperity achieved without one's own effort is unfair. There are striking differences: The researchers found a high level of acceptance of luck in non-Western countries such as China and India. The majority of the population in those countries was also opposed to redistributing prosperity gained by chance.

Almås attributes this attitude to cultural and other factors: "We will, in future work, study to what extent these differences in redistributive preferences are associated with different religious beliefs."

In addition to fairness considerations, there might be another reason to accept inequality—namely, that redistribution comes at a high cost to a country. For example, people may believe high earners work...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 您认为有些人的经济状况比其他人更好，这公平吗？这些收入是来自彩票中奖还是来自努力工作，这可能重要吗？这些都是苏黎世大学经济学家英格维尔德·阿尔马斯正在探索的问题。 她想了解为什么世界各地的人们愿意接受不平等，以及他们在什么条件下支持再分配，例如通过对富人加税。 “不平等是一个重要的全球问题。一个关键问题是不平等在社会上如何在道德上合理化，”阿尔马斯说。 她最近与挪威同事合作在《经济学季刊》上发表的研究表明，各国在这方面存在显着差异。 “人们认为不同程度的不平等是可以接受的，而且这样做也有不同的理由。” 该研究涵盖了来自60个国家的65,000人，覆盖了世界人口的80%。例如，参与者被要求决定在线劳动力市场平台上的真实工人是否应该根据他们的表现或通过随机抽奖来获得奖金。 该研究还考察了人们支持财富再分配的程度，例如通过对富人增税或其他政策措施。 结果是：平均而言，全球人口更有可能接受基于工作而不是纯粹机会的财富分配不平等。例如，这种观点在瑞士尤为强烈。 阿尔马斯说：“我们主要在拥有民主政治制度、更富裕、更平等、更个人主义的国家看到了对公平的基于绩效的理解。” 尽管如此，瑞士人口对一定程度的重新分配持开放态度，特别是在不平等是基于运气的情况下。 然而，并非所有国家都认为不靠自己的努力取得的繁荣是不公平的。其中存在显着差异：研究人员发现，中国和印度等非西方国家对运气的接受程度很高。这些国家的大多数民众也反对重新分配偶然获得的繁荣。 阿尔马斯将这种态度归因于文化和其他因素：“我们将在未来的工作中研究这些再分配偏好的差异在多大程度上与不同的宗教信仰相关。” 除了公平考虑之外，接受不平等可能还有另一个原因——即再分配会给一个国家带来高昂的成本。例如，人们可能相信高收入者工作......

reflection.en: This research delves into the human heart's perception of fairness, asking whether wealth gained by chance feels different from wealth earned through labor. It touches on our innate sense of justice and how we grapple with the uneven distribution of resources in society. Micah 6:8 calls us to 'act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.'...
reflection.zh: 这项研究深入探讨了人类内心对公平的感知，询问偶然获得的财富与通过劳动获得的财富在感受上是否不同。它触及了我们与生俱来的正义感，以及我们如何应对社会中资源分配不均的现实。 弥迦书 6:8 呼吁我们“行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的雅伟同行。”这节经文提醒我们，我们的社会，以及我们个人对财富和公平的看法，都应以公义、怜悯和对共同人性的认知为基础。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: The trapdoor spiders giving a leg up to science
title.zh: 为科学提供帮助的漏斗网蜘蛛

summary.en: Western Australia's trapdoor spiders are facing endangerment. Jackson Rendall is actively working to help them, driven by his fascination with their unique burrows and his volunteer work with pygmy blue-tongue lizards that inhabit these burrows, which led him to research on spiders at Flinders University.
summary.zh: 西澳大利亚的漏斗网蜘蛛正面临濒危。杰克逊·伦德尔正在积极帮助它们，他着迷于它们独特的巢穴，并曾作为志愿者帮助生活在这些巢穴中的侏儒蓝舌蜥蜴，这促使他到弗林德斯大学进行蜘蛛研究。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

WA's trapdoor spiders are endangered. Jackson Rendall is here to help—because he thinks they're "just really cool."

"Even if you don't appreciate the spiders themselves, you have to appreciate their burrows," says Jackson.

"I was volunteering with pygmy blue-tongue lizards , which are endangered lizards that live in spider burrows," says Jackson.

This work led him to a research group at Flinders University working on South Australia's spiny trapdoor spiders .

"I thought, 'I guess I'll give that a go,' then I realized how interesting they were," he says.

The research was answering some basic questions, like how deep the burrows go (about 16 cm [6 inches]).

They were also answering some thornier ones, like how many spiderlings hatch at once (about 30), whether size matters for male spider reproduction (probably not) and how long spider mating lasts (about 7 minutes).

Because if you're trying to save a species, you need to know how it makes babies.

Now in Perth as a Forrest Scholar with UWA's Centre for Evolutionary Biology, Jackson's Ph.D. is on WA's shield-backed trapdoor spider.

His focus is less on the "how" of spider reproduction and more on the "who." That is, are these hidden, immovable groups of spiders genetically diverse, or are they horrifically inbred?

"It was four months of fieldwork … just wandering around in the forest, looking at the ground," says Jackson.

"You're driving around the Wheatbelt, and you're like, 'Oh, that gives good vibes for finding spiders.' And you pull over, and sure enough, there's trapdoor spiders there."

Jackson might know it when he sees it, but it's hard to pin down exactly what "spider vibes" are—which is a problem when you're trying to describe which spider habitats need protecting.

"We're collecting tissue samples from the spiders, which is … a leg," says Jackson.

The legs drop on their own, like a lizard's tail , and can grow back when the spider molts.

It's exactly this kind of sample collection that a spider sex tape can help with. (If you skipped the video, spider mating involves a lot of leg tapping.)

"Knowing which legs are involved in mating actually helps inform which legs we take as tissue samples," says Jackson.

Jackson has collected more than 120 spider legs from WA's Northern Jarrah Forests so far.

Each one gets preserved in a jar of ethanol and sent to the Department of Biodiversity, Conservation and Attractions to have its DNA extracted.
