title.en: Yuja review – portrait of star pianist who is intellectually curious and deeply musically attuned
title.zh: Yuja乐评——这位求知欲强、音乐造诣深厚的钢琴家画像

summary.en: Musician is also rattled to find her appearance gets far more attention than her playing in this reflective documentary from Lorna Tucker As well as her film about her own difficult teenage years, British director Lorna Tucker is probably best known for her documentaries on famous women with big personalities:...
summary.zh: 在这部由洛娜·塔克执导的反思性纪录片中，音乐家发现自己的外表比演奏更受关注，这让她感到不安。除了她关于自己艰难青少年时期的电影外，英国导演洛娜·塔克可能最出名的是她拍摄的关于个性鲜明的名人的纪录片：薇薇恩·韦斯特伍德（ Westwood: Punk, Icon, Activist ）、凯瑟琳·赫本（ Call Me...

body.en: Musician is also rattled to find her appearance gets far more attention than her playing in this reflective documentary from Lorna Tucker As well as her film about her own difficult teenage years , British director Lorna Tucker is probably best known for her documentaries on famous women with big personalities: Vivienne Westwood ( Westwood: Punk, Icon, Activist ), Katharine Hepburn (Call Me Kate) and Greta Garbo ( Garbo: Where Did You Go? ). Her latest subject, pianist Yuja Wang, is another high-achiever – but not someone with quite the same name recognition unless you’re a devotee of classical music, a field in which she is ranked among the very best alive. Wang certainly has a flamboyant side, expressed in her highly expressive, virtuoso performances and her sartorial style on stage. In fact some shocking pull quotes illustrate how her dress sense has been bizarrely over-examined in the press; she has been likened to a stripper for her outfits, and the New Yorker, of all publications, once described her as “fat” , which hardly seems germane to any discussion of her ability to play Tchaikovsky or Ligeti. But Wang’s biography and the texture of her daily life are very different from that of Tucker’s previous subjects. She was a child prodigy from an artistic Beijing family who came of age just in time to break records for views on YouTube. Sure, her life here looks glamorous in one way, with a lush New York apartment she barely ever sees because she’s constantly on the road. But her life is also one of perpetual practice and striving for perfection, the loneliness of the long-distance soloist. It’s a regimen that leaves almost no time for relationships or family, or even many friendships with peers who understand what she is going through – apart from a few mentors or collaborators such as fellow pianist Emanuel Ax or composer Teddy Abrams, with whom she recently won a Grammy. Still, she comes across as an effervescent character, intellectually curious and deeply attuned to the music she plays. Continue reading...
body.zh: 音乐家还惊讶地发现，在洛娜·塔克 (Lorna Tucker) 的这部反思性纪录片中，她的外表比她的演奏受到更多关注。除了她关于自己艰难的青少年时期的电影外，英国导演洛娜·塔克 (Lorna Tucker) 最出名的可能是她关于具有大个性的著名女性的纪录片：维维安·韦斯特伍德 (维维安·韦斯特伍德) (韦斯特伍德：朋克、偶像、激进分子)、凯瑟琳·赫本 (叫我凯特) 和葛丽泰·嘉宝 (嘉宝：你去哪儿了？)。她最新的对象钢琴家王羽佳是另一位成就斐然的人，但除非你是古典音乐的爱好者，否则她的知名度不会很高，而她在古典音乐领域被列为当今最优秀的音乐爱好者之一。王确实有华丽的一面，这体现在她极具表现力、精湛的表演和舞台上的服装风格上。事实上，一些令人震惊的引述说明了媒体如何奇怪地过度审视了她的着装品味。她因服装而被比作脱衣舞娘，所有出版物中的《纽约客》曾将她描述为“胖子”，这似乎与她扮演柴可夫斯基或利盖蒂的能力的任何讨论都没有关系。但王的传记和她的日常生活质感与塔克之前的主题有很大不同。她是来自北京一个艺术家庭的神童，成年后正好打破了 YouTube 上的观看次数记录。当然，她在这里的生活在某种程度上看起来很迷人，她几乎从未见过纽约的一套豪华公寓，因为她经常在路上。但她的生活也是一种不断练习和追求完美的生活，一种长距离独奏者的孤独。这种生活方式几乎没有时间留给人际关系或家庭，甚至没有时间与理解她正在经历的事情的同龄人建立友谊——除了一些导师或合作者，比如钢琴家伊曼纽尔·阿克斯(Emanuel Ax)或作曲家泰迪·艾布拉姆斯(Teddy Abrams)，她最近与他们一起赢得了格莱美奖。尽管如此，她仍然给人一种热情洋溢的感觉，求知欲强，对她演奏的音乐有着深刻的理解。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary offers a glimpse into the life of pianist Yuja Wang, showcasing her intense dedication and intellectual curiosity in the demanding world of classical music. Her commitment to mastering her art, even when facing external distractions like undue attention to her appearance, speaks to a deep-seated passion for her calling. Colossians 3:23...
reflection.zh: 这部纪录片让我们得以一窥钢琴家王羽佳的生活，展现了她在古典音乐这个要求严苛的领域中，她那份强烈的奉献精神和求知欲。即使面对外表受到不当关注等外部干扰，她仍致力于精进技艺，这体现了她对自己使命的深切热情。 歌罗西书 3:23 提醒我们：“无论做什么，都要从心里去做，像是为主做的，不像为人做的。”...

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: ‘Musk’ Review: Alex Gibney’s Distressing Biography of an Uber-Wealthy Tech Bro Is Less Bombshell Than Summary of How We Got Here
title.zh: 《马斯克》影评：亚历克斯·吉布尼对一位超级富豪科技巨头的令人不安的传记，与其说是重磅炸弹，不如说是对我们如何走到今天的总结

summary.en: Venice: At nearly four hours, Gibney's documentary boasts a damning and exhaustively researched portrait of Elon Musk, even if the access proves to be less so.
summary.zh: 威尼斯：吉布尼的纪录片长达近四个小时，描绘了埃隆·马斯克（Elon Musk）令人震惊且经过详尽研究的形象，尽管其获得的访问权限似乎并未达到预期。

body.en:

No doubt the only definitive examination of the world’s richest megalomaniac — sooo , the world’s richest man — Alex Gibney’s documentary “Musk” boasts a running time that promises the stuff of bombshells. At just shy of four hours, the Oscar-winning director’s multilayered chronology of Elon Musk ‘s rise and what feels like just the tip of his ensuing fall (we’re still in it, anyway) might only prove revelatory to digitally disconnected technophobes, or those already living inside the bunker you’ll want to head into after watching this film . But it’s still a distressing, damning, alarming summary of how Musk rose to power — and an inquiry into the political-social framework that turned him into a cautionary myth for some, and a folk hero to others. Related Stories Summer Box Office Hit an All-Time High in 2026 — We’re So Back, Right? And 4 Other Takeaways ‘Company’ Review: Casey Affleck’s Nesting Doll Narrative Is Pretty but Directionless

In that sense, “Musk” is very much singing to the chorus of those already horrified and incensed by how he made free speech his ticket into the White House, only to weaponize it, using his takeover of X, née Twitter, to twist users either slavishly into his favor, or inure them to bottomless scrolls of hate speech and Grok-generated child porn. It’s quite possible that acolytes of the Musk cult will adopt this epic documentary as a validation of their beliefs, the same people who might have believed him when Musk said, while controversially hosting “ Saturday Night Live ” in May 2021, that he was actually putting people on Mars.

Due to the pile-up of NDAs in Musk’s trail and an almost certain fear of retaliation, there aren’t too many talking heads in Gibney’s movie that will surprise you. There’s no Grimes interview, sure, but there’s much candor from formerly conservative social media influencer Ashley St. Clair, as well as Musk’s wife Justine, whom he divorced in 2008 and with whom he had six children. (Including one who died of SIDS-related causes in 2002, when Musk told social media users that the baby died in his arms, only for an emotional Justine to here dispute that claim.) Elon’s father, South African businessman Errol Musk, gives one of those we-have-nothing-to-hide interviews that isn’t jaw-dropping, but it does offer uneasy Freudian insight into the...

reflection.en: Alex Gibney's nearly four-hour documentary on Elon Musk, described as a portrait of the world's richest man, prompts reflection on the pursuit of immense wealth. The Bible warns that the love of money can lead to many troubles, a theme that resonates when examining the lives of those who amass vast fortunes and the potential consequences that follow.
reflection.zh: 亚历克斯·吉布尼（Alex Gibney）近四个小时的埃隆·马斯克纪录片，被誉为对世界首富的描绘，引发了人们对追求巨额财富的思考。圣经警告说，贪财是万恶之根，当审视那些积累巨额财富之人的生活及其可能带来的后果时，这一主题便显得尤为贴切。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: Alex Gibney Warns Elon Musk’s DOGE Data Could Be Used ‘for an AI to Influence the Election’
title.zh: 亚历克斯·吉布尼警告埃隆·马斯克的DOGE数据可能被“用于人工智能影响选举”

summary.en: Oscar-winning documentarian Alex Gibney's new four-hour film, "Musk," premieres at the Venice Film Festival. Gibney discusses the film's portrayal of Elon Musk as a threat to democracy and free speech, suggesting Musk's data could be used by AI to influence elections.
summary.zh: 奥斯卡获奖纪录片导演亚历克斯·吉布尼的最新四小时电影《马斯克》在威尼斯电影节首映。吉布尼在片中将埃隆·马斯克描绘成民主和言论自由的威胁，并表示马斯克的数据可能被人工智能用来影响选举。

body.en:

Alex Gibney ‘s years-in-the-works, epically scary documentary “Musk” premieres at the Venice Film Festival on Tuesday to much buzz. The four-hour film , coming to theaters this October, draws a portrait of Tesla chairman and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk as a reckless destroyer of democracy and dismantler of free speech.

But it also spends a lot of time unpacking the South African tech bro’s relationship with President Donald Trump, and his stint as the head of the administration’s ad hoc Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE). Shuttered in 2026, the initiative was meant to streamline government operations through staff reductions and technological upgrades, but as Gibney’s film posits, it only increased instability (and probably the federal deficit) in the process. Tasked with heading up DOGE before his public breakup with Trump, Musk hired a Gen Z staff who, as the film shows, accessed and archived a trove of U.S. citizen data while scaling back or jettisoning government agencies and programs. Related Stories ‘Musk’ Teaser: The Wealthiest Man in the World Becomes Alex Gibney’s Latest Documentary Subject Sandra Hüller’s Star Keeps Rising, but She’s Still Adjusting to Life in the Public Eye

Gibney was joined by Wired reporter Zoë Schiffer and social media influencer Ashley St. Clair at a Venice Film Festival press conference ahead of Tuesday’s premiere. They both give testimony in the documentary, with St. Clair detailing how she cut ties with Musk (and the MAGA movement). At the press conference, she said he tried to buy her silence with a $40-million NDA package she rejected.

The press corps asked Gibney about the film’s wide-ranging implications for global democracy and how Musk, even while no longer a government agent, could influence the upcoming U.S. midterm election in November. The documentary “Musk” details how, after Elon Musk’s $43 billion acquisition of Twitter in 2022, he manipulated X’s artificial intelligence algorithms to skew the display of content in favor of his personal and political views. That could happen with the platform again as we head into the election, Gibney argued.

reflection.en: Humanity's drive to build and innovate is a powerful force, capable of great good but also of unintended, even dangerous, consequences. The story of Babel, where ambition outpaced wisdom, serves as a timeless caution. As we develop ever more powerful technologies, like AI, we must continually ask whether our creations are serving humanity or undermining the...
reflection.zh: 人类建造和创新的动力是强大的，既能带来巨大的益处，也可能产生意想不到甚至危险的后果。巴别塔的故事，其野心超越了智慧，是一个永恒的警示。当我们开发越来越强大的技术（如人工智能）时，我们必须不断反思我们的创造物是在服务于人类，还是在破坏真理和自由的根基。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」
